quests.name: Borrowing Sera's Mirror
quests.description:
Let's go to Heena.
I ran into Heena who was worrying about her face getting irritated by the strong sunlight. I have to get a mirror for Heena from her sister, Sarah.
Heena asked me to go to her sister and get a mirror for her. I walked my way to Sarah.

quests.name: Bringing a Mirror to Heena
quests.description:
I borrowed a mirror from Sarah who was doing her laundry. I have to take this mirror to Heena.
I borrowed a mirror from Sarah, who was doing her laundry, and brought it back to Heena.

quests.name: What Sen wants to eat
quests.description:
Let's talk to Nina.
I ran into Nina who was thinking about what to make for Dinner for her brother, Sen. I have to go and talk to Sen who is next to Nina, and find out what he wants to have for dinner.
I asked Sen, Nina's brother, what he wants to have for dinner. He answers he wants to have a Mushroom Soup.

quests.name: Returning to Nina
quests.description:
Sen wants to have Mushroom Soup for Dinner. Let's get back to Nina now.
I told Nina what Sen wants for dinner.

quests.name: Letter for Lucas
quests.description:
I heard Maria need a help...
I met Maria who was desperately looking for help. She gave me a letter and asked me to bring this to Lucas in Amherst...
I gave Maria's letter to Lucas in Amherst.
quests.parent: Please bring this letter to Lucas

quests.name: Lucas' Reply
quests.description:
I delivered Maria's letter to Lucas who was in Amherst. He wrote a reply, which I think I should bring back to Maria.
Maria looked relieved after reading the reply from Lucas. I wanted to read it too, but I think I did what I was supposed to do.
quests.parent: Please bring this letter to Lucas
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: Brown Skullcap (14.29%), Green Skullcap (14.29%), Red Headband (14.29%), Black Headband (14.29%), Green Headband (14.29%), Yellow Headband (14.29%), Blue Headband (14.29%)

quests.name: Bigg's Collection of Items
quests.description:
Let's start looking for Biggs.
I met Biggs at Southperry. He asked me if I can get him 10 orange mushroom caps and 30 blue snail shells and that he'll reward me with a nice item if I do so. He doesn't look too convinced that I can do this, but... it looks like a piece of cake to me.
I got Biggs from Southperry 10 mushroom caps and 30 blue snail shells. How is he going to do business out of this anyway Well, he did get me a decent weapon to use. I guess I can travel for a while with this...
quests.requirements: Blue Snail Shell x 30, Orange Mushroom Cap x 10
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: Fruit Knife (50%), Razor (50%)

quests.name: Pio's Collecting Recycled Goods
quests.description:
When I see Pio, he asks me to help collecting recycled goods.
I ran into Pio who is famous in Amherst for fixing broken goods. Pio tells me to break down scrap boxes from here and there in the village and bring back Rusty Screw and Old Wooden Board. I think I saw some scrap boxes in the village... Old Wooden Board 4031162 / 10 Rusty Screw 4031161 / 10
As Pio asked me, I broke down some useless boxes that were lying here and there in the village, and returned it to him. It was fun collecting them because I could find some useful stuff in them as well.
quests.requirements: Old Wooden Board x 10, Rusty Screw x 10

quests.name: Rain's Maple Quiz 1
quests.description:
I'm not a beginner anymore. Let's meet Rain and solve the Quiz!
I'm not a MapleStory Beginner. Let's solve Rain's Quiz.
Rain's First Quiz was, what is the hot-key to open the Item Inventory I'll make sure I remember the hot-key "I"...

quests.name: Rain's Maple Quiz 2
quests.description:
Let's solve Rain's 2nd Quiz.
What would be Rain's 2nd Quiz
I found out from Rain's Quiz that the wearable items can be equipped by double-clicking onthe item.

quests.name: Rain's Maple Quiz 3
quests.description:
Let's solve Rain's 3rd Quiz.
What would be Rain's 3rd Quiz It won't matter cause I'm good~
I found out "E" is the hot-key for opening the Equipment Window. I can take off what I'm wearing by double-clicking on the item in the Equipment Window.

quests.name: Rain's Maple Quiz 4
quests.description:
You can solve Rain's Quizzes if you carefully think about it.
Rain's 4th Quiz was finding the hot-key for picking up the items on the ground. That's easy~ it's " Z" of course~ But I found out I can also pick up items with the number key "0"...

quests.name: Rain's Maple Quiz 5
quests.description:
What would be the 5th Quiz
Rain gave me a Quiz about Job Advancements. For Warriors, Thieves, and Bowmen, you need to be at least level 10, while for Magicians, you can advance at Level 8.

quests.name: Rain's Maple Quiz 6
quests.description:
Finally, it's the 6th Quiz. I'm happy that my Maple knowledge can be used here like this. Why don't I go for the 6th Quiz
I learned that every time my level goes up, I get 5 Ability Points(AP) that I can upgrade my abilities. I can see the detail with the hot-key "S".

quests.name: Rain's Maple Quiz 7
quests.description:
Finally the last Quiz. Now I think I'm not a beginner~
Rain advised me to leave Maple Island and go for a greater journey. In Victoria Island, you can choose your job, and face a whole lot of new adventures. Ok...let's go to Maple Island's South Ferry...

quests.name: Mai's Training
quests.description:
Mai in Maple Island seems like a Martial -Art specialist, who can train the beginners to boost up the strength...
I decided to get trained under the Famous Sword-Master, Mai, in Amherst. I guess hunting the weakest monsters is a good idea. Should I hunt Snail, Blue Snail, and Spore in order Snail 10161# Blue Snail 10162# Shroom 10163# Ah, Mai told me to meet with Biggs in Amherst and try training together...
Mai trained me, and I feel I'm a lot stronger.
quests.requirements: Defeat Snail x 10, Defeat Blue Snail x 10, Defeat Shroom x 10

quests.name: Mai's Final Training
quests.description:
Mai's training is a simple monster-hunt. But it is very useful in getting used to hunting. Let's get Mai's training, which might be the last training in Maple Island.
Mai told me to hunt stronger monsters. Of course it is important to know your own strength, but to develop your strength, you need to try to hunt stronger monsters. Orange Mushroom 10171#
After getting Mai's traning, I became much stronger. I think I am going to leave Maple Island to get a job I like. Let's go to South Ferry and head to Victoria Island.

quests.name: Todd's How-to-Hunt
quests.description:
I hear Todd can teach us how to hunt...
Todd taught me to move towards upper right-hand side to attack and kill Jr. Sentinel, and talk to Peter... Jr. Sentinel 10181# Jr. Sentinel Shellpiece 4000142/1
I killed the monster just as Todd told me.
quests.requirements: Defeat Tutorial Jr. Sentinel x 1, Jr. Sentinel Shellpiece x 1

quests.name: Sam's Suggestion
quests.description:
Sam suggested me to meet Mai...
When I talked to Sam, he first told me to go to the East...and he told me to hunt 10 Snail...and meet Mai. Snail 10191#
As Sam told me, I hunted 10 Snail...and met Mai.

quests.name: Pio and the Recycling
quests.description:
I gathered up the recycling materials that Pio asked for, and he said he'll make me something nice in return...
Pio promised to make me a nice relaxing chair with the recylicing materials I gathered up for him.
I helped Pio gather up the recycling materials, and he made a nice comfortable chair.

quests.name: Fixing "Blackbull's" House
quests.description:
I heard that "Blackbull" is fixing his house...
Right here, in this dusty town of Perion, I ran into an oddly-dressed man named "Blackbull." He told me he needs to fix is house and wondered if I could help him out by getting him 30 tree branches and 50 firewoods. If I do him a favor, I get myself a nice shield that he has, but what if I say no I wouldn't ... be ... EATEN BY HIM ... no I really hope not...
I got "Blackbull" of Perion 30 tree branches and 50 firewoods. With these, he can finally fix his house. I got this shield as a reward ... and ... well, scratchmarks here and there, and it looks pretty old ... is this even usable
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: Steel Shield (90%), Red Triangular Shield (10%)

quests.name: Building a New House For "Blackbull"
quests.description:
I heard that "Blackbull" in Perion is building a new house...
I ran into "Blackbull" again, the guy I helped fix his house. He was surprised at how strong I looked, and asked me for a much harder favor. His cousins from Henesys are all trying to move to Perion, and so he needed to build a new house! To build a new house, he said he needed 100 pieces of rock from Stone Golem, 30 screws, 30 processed wood, and Blackbull's deed to the land. His son had the deed to the land, only to have it stolen by Curse Eye neaer Sleepywood...hmmm...I should be looking for those wandering around the deep forest...
To move all of "Blackbull"'s cousins to Perion, I got him all the items he requested: 100 pieces of rock from Stone Gollem, 30 screws, 30 refined wood, and 1 deed to the land. I got him all these...and yet what if he asks me to actually BUILD a house for him next time up Anyway for that, he gave me a little bit of EXP, 15,000 mesos, and a scroll for weapon with 10% success rate. Even my fame went up +2...not bad...

quests.name: Maya of Henesys
quests.description:
I hear that Maya is very sick...
I met this girl named Maya at the old, raggedy townstreet of Henesys. She's been suffering from illness for a long time, so she doesn't look too well to even live a normal life. Weird Medicine... what a strange name, and she said she'll get a little bit better by taking that... I better go to Lith Harbor and see this guy Teo...
Maya wanted me to go see Teo of Lith Harbor, so I did just that. He promised to give me the Weird Medicine only after I get him a Sparkling Rock.

quests.name: Finding Sophia
quests.description:
Around "The Victoria" in Lith Harbor, I met this heavily-bearded crewmember called Teo. He said he has the Weird Medicine but he wasn't willing to give it up for free. Instead he said he'll trade with me for a sparkling rock. I mean, he does look like he knows Maya pretty well, but he still wants to make a deal with me, knowing how sick she is ... That's strange... anyway, to get that sparkling rock, I need to head over to Perion and talk to the Sophia, the daughter of the owner of the department store there.
I finally met Sophia, who's working at the department store in Perion. To make the sparkling rock, she said she needs Arcon's blood.

quests.name: Making a Sparkling Rock
quests.description:
I finally met Sophia, who's working on her dream as an alchemist inside the department store in Perion. To make the sparkling rock, she said she needs 50 squishy liquid's, 50 leaves, 20 octopus legs and 1 Arcon's blood. Everything else looks reasonable enough except ... Arcon's blood ... Fortunately, Sophia knew where to get it. She told me to look for this man named Manji somewhere around Perion. Manji, huh ... where must he be ...
Sophia told me that Manji has the Arcon's Blood, which is what the sparkling rock is made of.

quests.name: Arcon's Blood?
quests.description:
I found Manji at Perion. Just as I thought, he was unwilling to give away Arcon's blood for free. He wants me to go to the underground tunnel in the middle of the island and gather up 40 Charms of the Undead for him ... by the way, who does he think he is, treating me like that I'm starting to regret saying yes to Maya in the first place ...
Manji asked for the Charms of the Undead in return to Arcon's Blood.

quests.name: Getting Arcon's Blood
quests.description:
I gathered up 40 Charms of the Undead from the underground tunnel and got them to Manji of Perion. Still cocky, still arrogant, but following through his promise, he hands over Arcon's blood to me. Maybe he isn't so horrible a guy afterall. Anyway, now I need to gather up 50 squishy liquids, 50 leaves, 20 octopus legs, and 1 Arcon's blood for Sophia.
I brought the Charms of the Undead to Manji and I finally got Arcon's Blood. I should hurry back to Sophia...
quests.requirements: Octopus Leg x 20, Arcon's Blood x 1, Squishy Liquid x 50, Leaf x 50

quests.name: Making Sparkling Rock
quests.description:
Sophia looks genuinely surprised that I gathered up every single material needed for that sparkling rock. Well, it wasn't easy at all ... anyway, she handed me the piece of sparkling rock made out of all the materials I got for her. Hmmm ... this sparkling rock ... it gives off a strange light, and then ... it starts glittering, and ... now I can understand why people want this ...!! Well, now that I have it, all I got left is trading it with Teo in Lith Harbor.
Sophia looks genuinely surprised that I gathered up every single material needed for that sparkling rock. Well, it wasn't easy at all ... anyway, she handed me the piece of sparkling rock made out of all the materials I got for her. Hmmm ... this sparkling rock ... it gives off a strange light, and then ... it starts glittering, and ... now I can understand why people want this ...!! Well, now that I have it, all I got left is trading it with Teo in Lith Harbor.

quests.name: Delivering the Weird Medicine
quests.description:
I traded the sparkling rock with Teo of Lith Harbor for the weird medicine. Now, all I need to do is get this to Maya, and I'm done, but the more I think about it, the more I regret saying yes. Anyway, this medicine looks quite tasty. If I ever find myself thirsty and without any water, maybe I should just drink it myself. Hahaha...
I went back to Henesys and handed Maya the weird medicine. Hopefully she'll get better after taking this. As a sign of thanks, Maya got me 5,000 mesos and a brown bamboo hat. This hat ... I mean, it looks like it's going to help when I'm walking under a blazing sun, but it looks so old and raggedy ... and if I put it on, it makes this weird noise that feels as if some insect is walking around and stuff ... am I going to be alright ...

quests.name: Pia and the Blue Mushroom
quests.description:
Let's start looking for Pia in Henesys
Underneath the watchtower at Henesys park, I met Pia, who was wearing a teddy bear costume. She was talking about how, on the way to Ellinia, she ran into a couple of blue mushrooms and had a hard time with them. She wanted me to show them who's the boss, and as a proof, she wanted 60 blue mushroom caps and 60 green mushroom caps ... but I can see why she's being attacked anyway ... anyone that walks around wearing those is bound to be attacked !!!
I got Pia, who had been chilling under the watchtower at Henesys Park, the stuff she requested, 60 blue mushroom caps and 60 green mushroom caps. For that, she got me the scroll for armor def. ... she said all I need to do is click on it at item window, and drag it to the armor. Simple, but ... what if this doesn't work
quests.requirements: Blue Mushroom Cap x 60, Green Mushroom Cap x 60
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: Scroll for Helmet for DEF (33.33%), Scroll for Helmet for DEF (33.33%), Scroll for Helmet for DEF (33.33%)

quests.name: Jane and the Wild Boar
quests.description:
Let's go look for Jane at Lith Harbor.
At around Lith Harbor near "The Victoria", I met this girl name Jane, who was sporting bunny ears. Jane expressed a desire to travel around the island, but her father just wouldn't let her. She thought if she got a hold of 100 wild boar teeth and 120 horney mushroom caps, then maybe her father would let her go afterall. And for that, she asked me if I could get her those ... I mean, isn't SHE supposed to collect them herself Anyway it doesn't sound too hard, so I should headover to the highland and start hunting down some wild boars ...
I got Jane 100 wild boar teeth and 120 horney mushroom caps that she requested. Seriously, though, will her dad approve of her traveling with this Not with the bunny ears she's wearing ... hmm ... anyway, in return, she got me something she's been keeping for a long time: a scroll for weapon for ATT. If this works, then... my weapon's going to be awesome!!

quests.name: Jane's First Challenge
quests.description:
I heard Jane has another goal...
I ran into Jane again at Lith Harbor, the same Jane that I helped get wild boar's canine teeth for her to travel. She said she got busted for lying that it was her that collected those items...anyway, she gave up on her dream to travel, and now is trying to become an alchemist. She needed some materials to experiment with...and...I'm pretty sure I'm getting those for her. Anyway, she said she needed 1 pure water, 30 medicines with weird vibe, and 20 malady's experimental frogs to try to make an Elixir. Oh, what the heck, I'll get them for her and see if it really works...
I got all the materials needed for Jane to make the elixir. If she does it well, then maybe I can get myself a nice elixir, but what if she fails...is the whole place going to blow up
quests.requirements: Pure Water x 1, Malady's Experimental Frog x 20, Medicine With Weird Vibes x 30

quests.name: Jane's Second Challenge
quests.description:
This time, Jane promised she'll make a better item, and wants me to get 1 Mushmom's spore, 3 of Drake's blood, 100 medicine with weird vibes, and 30 Malady's experimental frogs. She said something about making a Power Elixir, the one that can restore both HP and MP at once...
I got all the materials needed for Jane to make the elixir. If she does it well, then maybe I can get myself a nice elixir, but what if she fails...then I don't know if really want to take it...blehhh...
quests.requirements: Drake's Blood x 3, Mushmom Spore x 1, Malady's Experimental Frog x 30, Medicine With Weird Vibes x 100

quests.name: Jane's Final Challenge
quests.description:
This time, the last time, she promised to make me a mysterious scroll, and that she wanted me to get a moon rock, 20 dragon skins, and 10 saps of ancient tree for her. I guess I should ask the fairies at Ellinia for the moon rock, right
I got all the materials needed for Jane to make the scroll. Thankfully, the scroll for glove for ATT was made without a hitch, and she readily gave it to me. If the scroll really works, then I may have myself a dandy of a glove! Anyway, Jane expressed a strong desire to keep experimenting and become a good alchemist someday. Maybe next time I come back here, I may be able to buy an item from her that's not sold in store...nice...
quests.requirements: Dragon Skin x 20, Moon Rock x 1, Sap of Ancient Tree x 10
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: Scroll for Gloves for ATT (50%), Scroll for Gloves for ATT (50%)

quests.name: Alex's Request
quests.description:
I heard there is a runaway kid called Alex in Kerning City...
At the top of the building in Kerning City, I met this kid named Alex, who looked like a runaway kid. He left home a few days ago aftter a spat with his father. He'd been wandering around Kerning City ever since, but now, with no money and a severe case of boredom hitting him, he just wanted to go back home ... with the problem being that he was certain that a whole round of spanking would await him if he did, indeed, return home. So he asked me if I could convince his father Stan, who happened to be the chief of Henesys, to let him return home without any incident. Not only that, he asked me to get his late mother's article, her old gold watch, from him as a proof. If he had known this would happen, would he have done it nonetheless
As Alex has requested, I looked for his father in Henesys to get Alex's mother's old gold watch.

quests.name: Talking to Stan
quests.description:
At the entrance of Henesys Park, I met Alex's father Stan, the chief of Henesys. I couldn't even start up a conversation with him at first, but he did offer to speak to me only if I get him 50 Evil Eye's tails and 100 pig ribbons to fix this town. Jeez, why do I have to go through this much trouble just to talk to this grumpy old man Evil Eye Tail 4000007/50 Pig's Ribbon 4000002/100
I talked with Alex's father, Stan, to settle the misunderstandings. For the return, I got Alex's mother's gold watch.
quests.requirements: Evil Eye Tail x 50, Pig's Ribbon x 100

quests.name: Mother's Gold Watch
quests.description:
At the entrance of Henesys Park, I met Alex's father Stan, the chief of Henesys. I couldn't even start up a conversation with him at first, but once I got him 50 Evil Eye's tails and 100 pig ribbons he requested to fix this town, that was when he decided to listen. He was even more straight-forward and difficult to talk to than I first thought, but I finally convinced him to accept Alex back with open arms. I also got Alex's late mother's gold watch as the proof. Now, all I need to do is get this watch to Alex in Kerning City, right
I gave Alex his late mother's gold watch. Hopefully this will get him home ... as a sign of appreciation, he got me an earing he received from friends he met while traveling here and there. Well, Alex is now forgiven by Stan, but based on the look of his face, I don't know if he really is going to head home right now ... I should check it out the next time I head over to Henesys ...
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: Gold Earrings (25%), Red Cross Earrings (25%), Lightning Earrings (25%), Emerald Earrings (25%)

quests.name: Arwen and the Glass Shoe
quests.description:
I heard that Arwen the fairy from Ellinia has lost something...
Arwen the fairy from Ellinia told me that a couple of days ago, on the way to Perion, she was attacked by a monster covered in flame, and lost her very precious glass shoe in the process. Fairies love glimmering, shiny objects to the point of obsession, so obviously she wants it back badly ... I better hunt some monsters around Perion, and hopefully I can find it there.
I got Arwen from Ellinia the glass shoe she desperately wanted back. I got lucky, finding it from a nasty Fireboar ... phew. Anyway, as a sign of gratitude, she gave me a fairy item. It's really gorgeous and glimmering like a star ... dang, maybe I can use this to make something special ...
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: Piece of Ice (50%), Fairy Wing (50%)

quests.name: Luke the Security Guy
quests.description:
Let's meet Luke the Security Guy at the entrance of the Henesys Dungeon.
At the entrance of the dungeon, I met Luke the security guy. He wanted to make a healthy dish for his mom, and asked me if I could get him 100 pieces of Jr. Necki's skin, 10 wings of Stirge, and a bowl of salad. He claimed that he's too busy with all the security matters and stuff, but ... he looks like he's just falling asleep at work ...
I got Luke, who is protecting the entrance of the Dungeon, the stuff he asked for. Since he's making the "Snake Drink" and all ... I want a taste of that myself! In return, Luke got me a nicely refined jewel he found from around the area. It's not like a refined jewel drops from the sky ... did someone lose it while traveling Anyway I should drop by later when the "Snake Drink" gets done ...
quests.requirements: Salad x 1, Jr. Necki Skin x 100, Stirge Wing x 10
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: Diamond (12.5%), Garnet (12.5%), Amethyst (12.5%), AquaMarine (12.5%), Emerald (12.5%), Opal (12.5%), Sapphire (12.5%), Topaz (12.5%)

quests.name: A Clue to the Secret Book
quests.description:
I heard Mr. Wetbottom in Sleepwood is going through hard times... I should go check him out.
At a VIP sauna in Sleepywood, I met this bald man called Mr. Wetbottom. He has a son, and apparently he ran away from home one day with a book that he cares deeply for. He requested that I find his son and get the book back from him. For a reward, he's offering me a nice sauna robe. He also told me his son Ronnie hangs out at a tree tunnel around Ellinia, so maybe I can find him there. Anyway, is that book more important to him than his son What kind of a book is it anyway...
I found Ronnie in the tree tunnel, which Mr. Wetbottom asked me to do.

quests.name: Hungry Ronnie
quests.description:
Inside a tree tunnel around Ellinia I found Ronnie, the son of Mr. Wetbottom. He said the red book is off limits, but he seems to be starving. In the end, we made a deal that I get him 50 Lupin bananas, Rina's Unagi Special, and a fresh milk, and he gives me the book. According to Ronnie, I can find Rina at Henesys, and as for the fresh milk, I can get it from Rowen the fairy from Ellinia. I have a lot of traveling to do, but oh well...
I got Ronnie all the food he needed, and got the Secret Book that Mr. Wetbottom had been desperately looking for. It's a weird-looking book with a red cover... I have a feeling that I should not open this book... Anyway I should hurry up and get this to Mr. Wetbottom at the VIP sauna in Sleepywood before it's too late.
quests.requirements: Lupin's Banana x 50, Rina's Unagi Special x 1, Fresh Milk x 1

quests.name: Secret to Unagi Special
quests.description:
To get the Unagi special and a fresh milk, I need to gather up the ingredients for those. Rina of Henesys requested 50 Curse Eye tails and 5 pig's heads for the Unagi special. Rowen the fairy of Ellinia asked for a refined piece of glittering diamond for a fresh milk. Diamond, huh... how am I supposed to get that rare, expensive item
Inside the tree tunnel of Ellinia, I found Ronnie, the son of Mr. Wetbottom. He was adamant about not giving away the red book, but he seemed very hungry. I wound up making a deal with him where he would give me the red book after I get him 50 Lupin's Bananas, Rina's Special Unagi, and a fresh milk. According to Ronnie, Rina can be found at Henesys, and the fresh milk can be obtained through a fairy in Ellinia. This looks like quite a task, but oh well... I should get going.
quests.requirements: Pig's Head x 5, Curse Eye Tail x 50

quests.name: Cold Milk
quests.description:
To get the Unagi special and a fresh milk, I need to gather up the ingredients for those. Rina of Henesys requested 50 Curse Eye tails and 5 pig's heads for the Unagi special. Rowen the fairy of Ellinia asked for a refined piece of glittering diamond for a fresh milk. Diamond, huh... how am I supposed to get that rare, expensive item

I wound up making a deal with him where he would give me the red book after I get him 50 Lupin's Bananas, Rina's Special Unagi, and a fresh milk. According to Ronnie, Rina can be found at Henesys, and the fresh milk can be obtained through a fairy in Ellinia. This looks like quite a task, but oh well... I should get going.

quests.name: Returned Secret Book
quests.description:
I got Ronnie some yummy food for the Secret Book. I want to peek inside...
I got Mr. Wetbottom the precious Secret Book that he'd been desperately looking for. I asked him if he's worried about Ronnie at all, only to hear that he'll be in good hands with the fairies... well, it'd be best for Ronnie to be with the fairies, right Anyway, I got the sauna clothes in return for the book... I guess wearing these cumbersome armors around sauna is a ridiculous thing to do. Might as well enjoy it now and chill here at the sauna...
quests.rewards_items: Blue Sauna Robe, Red Sauna Robe

quests.name: Collecting 100 Cursed Dolls
quests.description:
I think Rowen the Fairy in Ellinia has something to ask me...
I ran into Rowen again, the same Rowen who I got a fresh milk from for Ronnie, the son of Mr. Wetbottom. She seemed to be keeping her guards up against humans then, but it looks like she's accepting me as Ronnie's friend...Rowen is assistant of the head magician of Ellinia, Grendel the Really Old, and he's been concerned about the cursed dolls that Grendel the Really Old made with his black magic a long long time ago. The dolls had been sealed up for a while, until a bunch of Lupin's took them and ran away. They have since turned into zombies, and have been destroying the forest. To return the forest to how it was before, someone needs to take down the Zombie Lupin's and take away the cursed dolls from them ... well, I readily accepted the request of collecting 100 cursed dolls, but am I going to be okay against those crazy monkeys
I took down a bunch of Zombie Lupin's on a forest near Ellinia, and collected all 100 cursed dolls for Rowen. In return, she gave me 7 ores. Will the forest really return to normal with this
quests.parent: Rowen the Fairy and the Cursed Doll
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: 7x Bronze Ore (16.67%), 7x Steel Ore (16.67%), 7x Mithril Ore (16.67%), 7x Adamantium Ore (16.67%), 7x Silver Ore (16.67%), 7x Orihalcon Ore (16.67%)

quests.name: Collecting 200 Cursed Dolls
quests.description:
Rowen asked me again, this time 200 cursed dolls. Well, that's easy...
I took down a bunch of Zombie Lupin's on a forest near Ellinia, and collected all 200 cursed dolls for Rowen. In return, she gave me 10 ores. Will the forest really return to normal with this
quests.parent: Rowen the Fairy and the Cursed Doll
quests.rewards_items:
10x Garnet Ore, Weighted random:
Any Class: 10x Amethyst Ore (16.67%), 10x AquaMarine Ore (16.67%), 10x Emerald Ore (16.67%), 10x Opal Ore (16.67%), 10x Sapphire Ore (16.67%), 10x Topaz Ore (16.67%)

quests.name: Collecting 400 Cursed Dolls
quests.description:
Rowen asked me again, this time 400 cursed dolls. 400 Hmmm...it's getting quite serious now...
I took down a bunch of Zombie Lupin's on a forest near Ellinia, and collected all 400 cursed dolls for Rowen. In return, she gave me 5 very-hard-to-find ores. Will the forest really return to normal with this
quests.parent: Rowen the Fairy and the Cursed Doll
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: 5x Gold Ore (50%), 5x Diamond Ore (50%)

quests.name: Collecting 600 Cursed Dolls
quests.description:
Rowen asked me again, this time 600 cursed dolls. 600 THAT'S A LOT....
I took down a bunch of Zombie Lupin's on a forest near Ellinia, and collected all 600 cursed dolls for Rowen. In return, she gave me the scroll for gloves. Will the forest really return to normal with this
quests.parent: Rowen the Fairy and the Cursed Doll
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: Scroll for Gloves for DEX (50%), Scroll for Gloves for DEX (50%)

quests.name: Collecting 1000 Cursed Dolls
quests.description:
Rowen asked me one last time, this time 1000 cursed dolls. Why does she need that much Is she trying to sell them all
I took down a bunch of Zombie Lupin's on a forest near Ellinia, and collected all 1000 cursed dolls for Rowen. In return, she gave me a nice hat. I've collected so many of those for her, but it looks like Zombie Lupin's aren't decreasing in any way shape or form ... what's going on Anyway, at least it seems that the fairies may not have such animosity towards humans now ... and that's fine with me hehe ...
quests.parent: Rowen the Fairy and the Cursed Doll
quests.rewards_items: Steel Nordic Helm, Dark Guiltian, Dark Distinction, Dark Pilfer

quests.name: Don Hwang's Request
quests.description:
I heard that I can get a job if I go see Nella at Kerning City...
I gave Nella 1000 mesos as a commission for hooking up Kerning City citizen's request. First request was to get the materials for Don Hwang, the owner of armor shop. The materials for making new armor are 50 Green Mushroom caps and 50 Bubbling's huge bubbles. It wouldn't be that hard, since I can easily find Green Mushrooms near the Ellina and Bubblings at the Subway.
I gave what Don Hwang asked for and I got bunch of lemons for return. I wonder what kind of armor would Don Hwang make. Nella said there are many more requests I can do. I should visit Nella every once in a while.
quests.requirements: Green Mushroom Cap x 50, Bubbling's Huge Bubble x 50

quests.name: Shumi's Request
quests.description:
I got the second request from Nella. Shumi wants to make a house for her little puppy. To make a puppy house, she needs 5 Processed Woods and 5 Screws. I need to get those ASAP.
I gave what Shumi asked for and I got bunch of cakes for return. Now, Shumi's little puppy has her own house~ I should get back to Nella for more requests.

quests.name: Andre's Request
quests.description:
I got the third request from Nella. Andre from the hair salon wanted some Seafood Soup. I should get 100 Octopus Legs and Pure Water for his Seafood Soup ingredients.
I gave what Andre asked for and I got the glove for return. I hope he enjoys his hearty bowl of Seafood Soup. I should get back to Nella for more requests.
quests.requirements: Octopus Leg x 100, Pure Water x 1
quests.rewards_items: Work Gloves, Venon, Blue Morrican, Blue Diros, Bronze Mischief

quests.name: Dr. Faymus's Request
quests.description:
Nella said I look much stronger than last time. First request is to get ingredients for Dr. Faymus, the owner of potion shop. He needs 100 Horny Mushroom Caps and 50 Jr. Necki Skins. Taking on Jr. Necki's might be little tough, but I will give it a try.
I gave what Dr. Faymus asked for and I got bunch of white potions for return. I wonder what kind of potion would Dr. Faymus make by using those materials. I should get back to Nella for more request.
quests.requirements: Horny Mushroom Cap x 100, Jr. Necki Skin x 50

quests.name: Chris's Request
quests.description:
I got the second request from Nella. Chris got his pillow stolen few days ago and he can't sleep well since then. To make a new pillow, he wants 50 stiff feathers and 20 leathers. I should get them ASAP.
I got what Chris asked for and I got refined steal and bronze. Chris can finally sleep well in his new pillow. I should get back to Nella for more requests.

quests.name: Cutthroat Manny's Request
quests.description:
I got the third request from Nella. Cutthroat Manny wants to get 200 Evil Eye Tails for his dinner. He wanted to make a bowl of Evil Eye Stew. Now that sounds delicious!
I gave what Cutthroat Manny asked for and I got shoes for return. Now... Cutthroat Manny doesn't have to worry about his dinner menu for a while. I should get back to Nella for more request.
quests.rewards_items: Blue Sneakers, Emerald Battle Grieves, White Magicshoes, Green Hunter Boots, Silver Chain Boots

quests.name: Luke the Security Man's Wish to Travel
quests.description:
I hear that Luke the Security Guy made up his mind on something...
I met Luke at the entrance of the dungeon again. The Snake Drink back then is gone now because his mom drank it all...anyway, Luke was ready to quit the boring life of a security man and wanted to travel...and to make a glove that befits the traveling, Mr. Smith of Perion suggested 1 black feather, 10 Orihalcon Plates, 50 dragon skins, 40 screws, and 3 horns of Taurospear!! That's insane...well, I'm guessing he wants me to collect them for him...oh, do the fairies of Ellinia know something about it
I got Luke all the materials he needed for the nice glove, and return, he gave me a very precious item that has been passed down from generaition to generation, an old bronze normal Helm. I feel like I'm losing out on this deal...but I can't get mad at him since it's been passed down from generation to generatoin. I heard Mr. Thunder can make this helmet even better...I should go there sometime later..
quests.requirements: Orihalcon Plate x 10, Taurospear Horn x 3, Dragon Skin x 50, Screw x 40, Black Feather x 1

quests.name: First Material for Building a New House
quests.description:
Let's go meet Ronnie in the woods in Ellinia.
Ronnie from the forest of Ellinia asked me a favor of gathering up materials to build a house for the newborn fairies that are to come down the road. 50 of orange mushroom caps, leaves, squishy liquid, and red snail shells each ... I guess I can get most of these from the monsters around the prairie ...
I got all the items Ronnie requested, but when do I get rewarded for this What How many more times do I have to do this
quests.parent: Ronnie & the Fairies Building a New House.
quests.requirements: Red Snail Shell x 50, Orange Mushroom Cap x 50, Squishy Liquid x 50, Leaf x 50

quests.name: Second Material for Building a New House
quests.description:
This time Ronnie wanted 50 of octopus legs, Curse Eye tails, wild boar tooth, and the charm of the undead EACH. These are probably available by the monsters around the deep forest, highland, and ant tunnels.
I got them all for Ronnie. Please don't tell me he wanted all these for free...!
quests.parent: Ronnie & the Fairies Building a New House.
quests.requirements: Octopus Leg x 50, Charm of the Undead x 50, Wild Boar Tooth x 50, Curse Eye Tail x 50

quests.name: Third Material for Building a New House
quests.description:
This time Ronnie wanted 50 each of Drake's skull, Stone Gollem's pieces of rock, the skin of Croko, and Lupin's banana. I can probably get those from the monsters at the ant hole, prarie, and at swamp...this is getting quite difficult now...
I got them all for Ronnie. I'm still not getting anything How many more times do I have to do this
quests.parent: Ronnie & the Fairies Building a New House.
quests.requirements: Lupin's Banana x 50, Drake Skull x 50, Stone Golem Rubble x 50, Croco Skin x 50

quests.name: Last Material for Building a New House
quests.description:
Ronnie asked for the last time. This time he wanted 50 each of medicine with weird vibe, dark stone gollem's pieces of rock, Wild Kargo's eyes, and Tauromacis's horns, along with 1 diamond. I can sort of get this, but for me to hunt at subway, deep forest, the ant tunnel ... it sucks!!
I got all the materials Ronnie needed for the last time. Is this it For the reward, he gave me a pair of shoes he got as a gift from the fairies that found it somewhere around the forest. Somehow, he can't put the shoes on, so I'm getting it ... hopefully it works ... haha
quests.parent: Ronnie & the Fairies Building a New House.
quests.requirements: Diamond x 1, Dark Stone Golem Rubble x 50, Wild Kargo Eye x 50, Medicine With Weird Vibes x 50, Tauromacis Horn x 50
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: Pink Goldrunners (25%), Green Goldrunners (25%), Orange Goldrunners (25%), Blue Goldrunners (25%)

quests.name: Maya's First Collection
quests.description:
Let's go to Maya in Henesys
I got a favor request from Maya of Henesys, who has been collecting various items. She wanted 50 each of snail shells, blue snail shells, mushroom spores, and tree branches. Maybe..well it looks like I can get these from the monsters around the prarie...
I got all the items Maya requested, but when do I get rewarded for this What How many more times do I have to do this
quests.requirements: Blue Snail Shell x 50, Tree Branch x 50, Mushroom Spore x 50, Snail Shell x 50

quests.name: Maya's Second Collection
quests.description:
This time Maya wanted 50 each of fireboar teeth, Bubbling's huge bubbles, pig ribbons, and tablecloths. Apparently, I can get those by hunting down the monster around the plateau, subway station, and prairies ... well, that's easy!
I got them all for Maya. Please don't tell me she wanted all these for free...
quests.requirements: Fire Boar's Tooth x 50, Pig's Ribbon x 50, Tablecloth x 50, Bubbling's Huge Bubble x 50

quests.name: Maya's Third Collection
quests.description:
This time, Maya requested 10 Lupin Dolls and 50 each of Cold Eye's tail, Tortie's shell, and Iron Hog's Steel Hoof. Apparently I can get those through monsters at the highland, beach, and prarie. This is getting harder now...
I got them all for Maya. I'm still not getting anything How many more times do I have to do this
quests.requirements: Iron Hog's Metal Hoof x 50, Cold Eye Tail x 50, Lupin Doll x 10, Tortie Shell x 50

quests.name: Maya's Last Collection
quests.description:
Maya requested, for the last time, 50 each of Clang's claws, Dark Stone Gollem's pieces of rock, the eyes of Wild Kargo, and Tauromacis's horns, along with one diamond. Apparently I can get those through monsters at the beach, deep forest, and deep into the ant tunnel ... this is RIDICULOUS! It's too hard !!
I got all the items Maya requested for the last time...or is it As a sign of appreciation, she gave me a pair of shoes her grandma made for Athena Pierce, the chief of this town. It may be really old, but it still looks solid like brand new!!
quests.requirements: Diamond x 1, Dark Stone Golem Rubble x 50, Wild Kargo Eye x 50, Clang Claw x 50, Tauromacis Horn x 50
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: Red Gore Boots (33.33%), Blue Gore Boots (33.33%), Green Gore Boots (33.33%)

quests.name: Looking for the Red Cape
quests.description:
Let's go to Pia in Henesys
I ran into that same teddy-bear-costume-wearig Pia at the Henesys Park. I did her a favor and took care of the blue mushrooms before. This time, she wants to make a present for a friend in Ellinia who wants to go out on a journey. The claw that she wants to make for her consists of 15 silver plates, 50 dragon skins, and 40 screws...and for the friend, she also wanted me to get back the Red Cape that Rina of Henesys borrowed. If I get her all these...am I going to be richly rewarded
I decided to go to Rina to get the Red Cape back, which she has borrowed from Pia.

quests.name: What Pia has Borrowed
quests.description:
I went to see Rina at Henesys, and instead, she tells me she took that red cape because Pia didn't return the items she borrowed from her. She said, if she gets her items back, then the cape is hers again...the borrowed stuff are 1 black crystal, 1 ancient scroll, and 30 horns of Tauromacis.
I went to Rina to get Pia's cape, but Rina told me that she is keeping the cape until Rina brings back what she borrowed from Rina. She said she will return the cape if she gets back what Pia has borrowed from her.
quests.requirements: Black Crystal x 1, Tauromacis Horn x 30, Ancient Scroll x 1

quests.name: Pia's Present For a Friend
quests.description:
I got Rina 1 black crystal, 1 ancient document, and 30 horns of Tauromacis, and in return, I got Pia's red cape back. With that and 15 silver, 50 dragon skins, and 40 screws, I should go back to Pia...
I got Pia of Henesys Park all the materials she requested for her friend's claw, and in return, got myself a thief-only clothes...wow...since that was made just for me, I should take good care of these, right Anyway, did that friend of Pia's leave by now Who knows I may see him sometime...
quests.requirements: Dragon Skin x 50, Screw x 40, Red Cape x 1, Silver Plate x 15
quests.rewards_items: Umber Mantis, Umber Mantis Pants, Dark Scorpio, Dark Scorpio Pants

quests.name: Hero's Gladius
quests.description:
Let's look for Manji in Perion
I ran into Manji from Perion again, the same Manji that I met while I was helping the little Maya get her medicine. He was shocked by my stronger appearance, and wanted to ask me for a favor. Long long ago, he was in danger of being attacked by Balrog, only to be saved by the legendary hero Tristan. He died in place of Manji, and for that, he's been keeping that sword to this day. Too bad the sword has been soaked in Balrog's evilness and is as ragged as possible. It's too embarrassing to even call it a sword now. Anyway, he gave me the Old Gladius and wanted me to reawaken it for him. If it indeed gets reawaken, it becomes the Hero's Gladius ...I should go see Chrishrama of Sleepywood just the way Manji said it...
It seems that this Gladius which Manji told me is one fine sword. I had to make a hard decision choosing one bwtween the Gladius and the Skull Earring which Manji offered me, but I will not regret.
quests.rewards_items:
Pick one:
Any Class: Hero's Gladius, Skull Earrings

quests.name: Rewakening the Gladius
quests.description:
I found Chrishrama of Sleepywood, and showed him the Old Gladius that Manji gave me. He claimed to have made it himself, and that he needs a star rock, 1 piece of ice, 1 ancient scroll, and 1 flamed feather. I've never heard of any of those, so I don't know how I'm going to even start with this...Chrishrama said they only way I can get is to talk to Mike who's guarding the entrace of the dungeon.
I got all the materials needed to reawaken the sword to Chrishrama. He couldn't believe his eyes, but went on with it, and reawoke the sword into Hero's Gladius. It gives off a mystic light...and it's a really nice sword! Hmmm...I don't know if I should really give it to him...
quests.requirements: Flaming Feather x 1, Old Gladius x 1, Piece of Ice x 1, Star Rock x 1, Ancient Scroll x 1

quests.name: "Mar" the Fairy and the Water of Life
quests.description:
At Ellinia, I ran into a fairy that's been busily studying the magic of life. Her name is "Mar" and after taking a look at my pet that's been turned into a doll, she told me she can make it come back alive with The Water of Life and The Scroll of Life. I heard that she knows Cloy of Henesys... since it looks like a pet trainer named Trainer Bartos of Henesys knows something about the scroll of life, I should head over there...
After easily passing the test from Trainer Bartos of Henesys, I got a hold of The Water of Life and The Scroll of Lifel, and got that to "Mar" the fairy. With her magical power and the items I got her, she turned the doll back into a living pet. I can hang out with him for a while longer now ... sweet ...

quests.name: Sabitrama and the Diet Medicine
quests.description:
Let's go look for Sabitrama in Sleepywood.
In front of Sleepywood Hotel, I met Sabitrama, a medicinal herb trader who seems to be the younger brother of Chrishrama. He said he found a place where he can finally find the herb that he needed for this medicine he's working on...and that he asked if I could go in that forest and grab an herb called Pink Anthurium. It consists of green grass and a small pink flower ... I better remember this well and get him the exact same one. I heard the place is near Ellinia ... I should go there and talk to this guy Shane ...
Thankfully I got the flower that Sabitrama wanted from the Forest of Patience, and as a sign of appreciation, he gave me a scroll for the overall armor. Oh, and he also said that from here on out, I can enter the Forest of Patience without having to pay Shane of Ellinia. Based on what I've heard, the diet medicine Sabitrama's working on is for Shane's fiance ... I better get back in the Forest of Patience when I have some time ...

rewards.name: Scroll for Overall Armor for DEF
Scroll for Overall Armor for DEF

quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: Scroll for Overall Armor for DEF (50%), Scroll for Overall Armor for DEF (50%)

items.label: Scroll for Overall Armor for DEF

items.name: Scroll for Overall Armor for DEF
items.label: Scroll for Overall Armor for DEF

quests.name: Sabitrama's Anti-Aging Medicine
quests.description:
I heard that Sabitrama in Sleepywood is making a new medicine...
I ran into Sabitrama again in front of the Sleepywood hotel, the same one I helped get herbs before. This time, he said he found a place where I can get the important herb that he needed for his new medicine. He asked me if I could go into that forest and grab Double-rooted Red Ginseng for him. The root is in two, and red ... I should remember it well and find the same one once I get to the top. The place where this may be at is Shane of Ellinia ...
Thankfully I got the one that Sabitrama asked me to get, and for that, I got rewarded with a mysterious rock. And from here on out, I don't have to pay Shane everytime I go in the Forest of Patience. From what I hear, that anti-aging medicine Sabitrama is working on may be what Shane needed ... if I have time, I should go back in there ...

quests.name: John's Pink Flower Basket
quests.description:
Let's go meet John at Lith Harbor.
At Lith Harbor, I met a fisherman named John. He wanted to get his wife a nice flower basket for their upcoming anniversary. He asked me if I could get him 10 Pink Violas for her. According to him, a mysterious statue can lead me to where the flower is. Sleepywood ... SLEEPYWOOD That's FAR !!!
I got John all 10 Pink Violas. With these, he can make a beautiful flower basket for his wife on their anniversary. As a sign of appreciation, John got me a whole bunch of screws left over from ships here and there. By the way, if there are this many screws that have fallen out of ships, then how in the world are they even working ... Are they carrying passengers on it

quests.name: John's Present
quests.description:
Let's go see John at Lith Harbor again.
I ran into John the fisherman again at Lith Harbor. This time, he wanted to get his wife Blue Viola for her birthday. He asked me to get 20 Blue Violas for him. The scent of Blue Violas last over 500 years...and according to John, they can be found through the mysterious statue again, where the flower may be found. Man ... do I HAVE to go in there again
I got John all 20 Blue Violas. It has a nice scent to it, but 20 of them Makes my head spin...As a sign of appreciation, John got me a nice glove he found inside a ship. I mean, it looks like someone accidentally left that glove in there...is he allowed to give it to me like that What if I wear this around town and run into the actual owner of it
quests.rewards_items: Work Gloves, Dark Briggon, Dark Noel, Gold Scaler, Gold Arbion

quests.name: John's Last Present
quests.description:
I heard John has one final thing to ask me...
I ran into John the fisherman again at Lith Harbor. This time, he told me his mother passed away recently, and he wanted to get her some White Violas for her. He asked me to get 30 White Violas for him. The scent of White Violas last over 1000 years...and according to John, they can be found through the mysterious statue again, where the flower may be found. Man ... do I HAVE to go in there again
I got John all 30 White Violas. It has a nice scent to it, but 30 of them Makes my head spin...As a sign of appreciation, John gave me a set of his mother's earrings. These earrings look like they are made of some common flowers, but it seems there's something to it...

quests.name: Shumi's Lost Coin
quests.description:
Let's start looking for Shumi in Kerning City.
I met this girl name Shumi at Kerning City. She was devasted about losing the lucky coin that she borrowed from a friend and that she was asking me to find it for her. She also told me a bunch of guys draped in white cloth took it from her at the subway, so they may be found at the constuction site B1, deep in the station ... I should get in there first ...
I found the lost coin that Shumi of Kerning City was looking for, and returned it to her. A precious coin borrowed from her friend, huh ... as a reward, she gave me a whole bunch of the return scrolls ... not bad at all!! She also said other items can be found at construction site B1 ... I should check it out later ...
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: 30x Return Scroll - Nearest Town (14.29%), 30x Return Scroll to Lith Harbor (14.29%), 30x Return Scroll to Ellinia (14.29%), 30x Return Scroll to Perion (14.29%), 30x Return Scroll to Henesys (14.29%), 30x Return Scroll to Kerning City (14.29%), 30x Return Scroll to Sleepywood (14.29%)

quests.name: Shumi's Lost Bundle of Money
quests.description:
Let's go look for Shumi in Kerning City.
I ran into Shumi again at Kerning City. She seemed really worried about how she lost her rent money because a Stirge flew over and snatched a bundle of money away from her. Man ... do I have to walk back in there again ... can I just pay the rent for her Anyway like last time, I need to go back in there, this time to construction site B2 and find the bundle of money she lost. Aye, better go in there now...
I got Shumi from Kerning City the lost bundle of money. I guess she can pay her rent now...and as a reward, she got me 100 Mana Elixir's...she also said I may find other items at the construction site B2...I should go check it out sometime...

quests.name: Shumi's Lost Bundle of Money
quests.description:
Let's go look for Shumi in Kerning City.
I ran into Shumi again at Kerning City. A while ago, she got a favor from JM From the Streetz to get an elixir for him, only to have the sack of money fall down and lose it all in the process. I guess I can find it at the deep part of the subway station, the construction site B3, again.
I got Shumi of Kerning City the lost sack of money. With that, she can finally get the stuff JM requested. As a sign of thanks, she gave me scroll for shoes for speed. Since there are other items that can be found at construction site B3 , maybe I should head back in there sometime...
quests.rewards_items:
30x Elixir, Weighted random:
Any Class: Scroll for Shoes for Speed (33.33%), Scroll for Shoes for Speed (33.33%), Scroll for Shoes for Speed (33.33%)

quests.name: Special Taste of Florina Beach
quests.description:
A beautiful girl by the name of Riel from Florina Beach seems to be in need of help...
Riel introduced me to a part time job, where I have to collect 10 Coconuts. Why don't I start collecting those delicious looking Coconuts over there on the right Coconut 4000136/10
I brought back fresh coconuts just like Riel said. Riel told me I can come back for work anytime I want. I guess I won't be starving here in Florina Beach.

quests.name: Special Taste of Florina Beach II
quests.description:
Riel in Florina Beach askes me a question about Florina Beach. Piece of cake~ I can answer that before I start my work.
I have to prepare the recipe for 15 people, and bring it to Riel in Florina Beach. Coconut 4000136/15 Lorang Claw 4000043/150 Lupin's Banana 4000029/15
I answered all the questions that Riel gave me. I passed Riel's tests and she took the recipe for 15 people.
quests.requirements: Lupin's Banana x 15, Coconut x 15, Lorang Claw x 150

quests.name: Special Taste of Florina Beach III
quests.description:
I have to bring recipe for 30 people to Riel in Florina Beach. Coconut 4000136/30 Lorang Claw 4000043/150 Clang Claw 4000044/150 Lupin's Banana 4000029/30
I worked part-time gathering recipes for cooking meals for the tourists coming to Florina Beach.
quests.requirements: Lupin's Banana x 30, Coconut x 30, Lorang Claw x 150, Clang Claw x 150

quests.name: Special Taste of Florina Beach
quests.description:
I need to collect some of the recipes to develop the Special Taste of Florina Beach. I heard that 10 Coconut, 10 Lorang Claw, 10 Clang Claw, and 10 Lupin's Banana are necessary. Will Valen's new recipe succeed~
I'm familiar with working on Florina Beach. I visited Riel one more time and helped her out. Why is she so desperate to help Valen
quests.requirements: Lupin's Banana x 10, Coconut x 10, Lorang Claw x 10, Clang Claw x 10

quests.name: Mrs. Ming Ming's First Worry
quests.description:
I hear that Mrs. Ming Ming in Henesys is worried about something...
I ran into Mrs. Ming Ming in Henesys, who flushed with concerns here and there. She said there is not enough decoration for the village festival, and asked me to get 50 Bubbling's Large Bubble, 20 Slime Bubbles, and 100 Pig's Ribbons. Bubblings Large Bubbles : 4000037/50 Slime Bubbles : 4000010/20 Pig's Ribbons : 4000002/100
I brought back all the stuff Mrs. Ming Ming asked me for, but I'm sure these decorations are not the only things needed for the festival...
quests.requirements: Pig's Ribbon x 100, Slime Bubble x 20, Bubbling's Huge Bubble x 50

quests.name: Mrs. Ming Ming's Second Worry
quests.description:
I heard Mrs. Ming Ming in Henesys has a new worry...
I met Mrs. Ming Ming again in Henesys who was preparing for the village festival. She said she needs food to prepare for the festival, and asked me to collect 20 Pig's heads, 60 Octopus Legs, and Estelle's Special Sauce. To get the special sauce, I think I'll have to go find Estelle near Ellinia.
I met up with Estelle near Ellinia to get her Special Sauce, but she apparently she doesn't want to give it to me for free...

quests.name: Estelle's Request
quests.description:
I ran into Estelle near Ellinia. She was making a necklace for her mother's birthday present. If I can get her 1 Garnet, she was willing to give me the special sauce.
I got 1 Garnet for Estelle, who I met near Ellinia, for making her mother's birthday present. She gave me Estelle's Special Sauce. I better collect other materials and return to Mrs. Ming Ming.

quests.name: Searching for Fossils
quests.description:
I heard that Winston the archeologist is searching for something in the Rocky Mountains on the East side of Perion...
Winston the archeologist who I ran into on the rocky mountains on the east side of Perion said he lost the fossils he collected near Perion. He asked me to bring back 100 Animal Fossil and 100 Plant Fossil which Green Mushroom and Axe Stump took. How can he lose something so important like that He is careless than he looks... Animal Fossil 4031146/100 Plant Fossil 4031147/100
I found the fossil which Winston lost.
quests.requirements: Plant Fossil x 100, Animal Fossil x 100

quests.name: Delivering a Box of Fossil
quests.description:
Winston the Archeologist said that it is not safe to put the valuable fossils in the tent. He asked me to take the fossil and deliver it to Dr. Betty in Ellinia. He also wrote a letter of introduction for me to show him.
Winston the Archeologist in Perion said that it is not safe to put the valuable fossils in his tent. He asked me to deliver it to Dr. Betty in Ellinia. Dr. Betty said it is going to be really busy from now. He asked me to stop by again and give him a hand afterwards. Fossils huh... Should I give it a try
quests.requirements: Winston's Recommendation x 1, Fossil Box x 1

quests.name: Research on Plant Fossils
quests.description:
Dr. Betty, a biologist near Ellinia is looking for an assistant.
Dr. Betty asked me to work as an assistant for a while. My first task from her is to collect 20 Plant Samples. I can see various plants covering the woods in Ellinia. Plant Sample 4031150/20
My first job as Dr. Betty's assistant was to collect some plants in the woods in Ellinia and sample them. It wasn't that hard I guess.

quests.name: Research on Animal Fossils
quests.description: Dr. Betty in Ellinia told me that she needs 1 Stuffed Drake Skull for her research. She asked me to find her daughter near Henesys, and bring it back to her. Where would Anne be

quests.name: Transporting Drake's Skull
quests.description:
I received the Stuffed Drake Skull from Anne, Dr. Betty's daughter. Now I have to deliver this carefully to Dr. Betty...
I collected some plant samples and Drake's Skull to help Dr. Betty's research on fossils. I can't wait to see the results...I'll go and see Dr. Betty, because he said he would tell me when I go back.

quests.name: Progress on Fossil Research
quests.description:
I heard Dr. Betty has finished the research on plants. Maybe I should go and see how it is.
I met Dr. Betty again. Doctor told me the research was finished, and explained it to me. Then Doctor told me to take the Research Report and deliver it to Dr. Winston in Perion. Dr. Betty also informed me that if I take 100 Leafs, 50 Firewoods, 1 Stump's Teardrop, and 1 pair of Weighted Earrings, Dr. Winston would be really happy. Leaf 4000005/100 Firewood 4000018/50 Stump's Teardrop 4031153/1 Weighted Earrings 1032000/1
I delivered Dr. Betty's Fossil Research Report to Dr. Winston in Perion. Along with the report, I also gave him the leaves, firewoods, Stump's tear, and earrings. In return, Dr. Winston gave me the Leaf Earrings.
quests.requirements: Weighted Earrings x 1, Firewood x 50, Fossil Report x 1, Stump's Teardrop x 1, Leaf x 100

quests.name: Stranger's Request
quests.description:
I heard there is someone in Naora Hospital in Kerning City...
I met Jane Doe in Naora Hospital in Kerning City. Jane Doe wanted to see how the surgery went, but there was no mirror. Jane Doe asked me to hunt down a Wild Boar and collect 20Broken Mirror Glass... Broken Mirror Glass 4031155/20
For the Stranger I met in Naora Hospital, I actually collected Broken Mirror Glass and brought back to her.

quests.name: Stranger's Identity
quests.description:
The Stranger I met in Naora Hospital was shockingly a Ghost! She was waiting for Naora, not knowing that she herself is dead... This Stranger wouldn't believe that she is dead. She told me that she needs 100 Charms of the Undead in order to live again, and asked me to find it. Can she really live again with just these... Charm of the Undead 4000008/100
Jane Doe who I met in Naora Hospital was a Ghost. She was staying in the Hospital, not knowing that she's dead. She couldn't live again with Charm of the Undead. It seems that she already knew she couldn't make it...I really hope she returns to heaven.

quests.name: Camila's Gem
quests.description:
I heard that Camila in Henesys is worrying about something...
I met Camila in Henesys. Camila asked me to deliver Sparkling Glass Marble to Utah for her, because she is afraid. I heard I could get to Utah's Pig Farm through The Forest East of Henesys...
I delivered Camila to Utah. I'm sure they are really close freind, since they give what's most precious to them. I wish I could meet a friend like that during my journey...
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: 30x Cake (70%), Pig Illustrated (30%)

quests.name: Find the Maple History Book
quests.description:
Jay of Henesys has something to ask regarding the Maple History Book.
Jay of Henesys asked if I could find Maple History Book I, Maple History Book II, Maple History Book III and give them to Tigun the Advisor of Ludibrium. Maple History Book I was the one that went missing in on the way to Orbis; Maple History Book II being kept at a treasure chest at Grendel the Really Old's house in Ellinia; and Maple History Book III, apparently being stolen by the Chronos
I gathered up all 3 Maple History Books, gathered them up, and handed them to Tigun the Advisor of Ludibrium.
quests.requirements: Maple History Book I x 1, Maple History Book II x 1, Maple History Book III x 1

quests.name: Find the Maple History Book 2
quests.description:
I found all 3 Maple History Books, and gave them all to Tigun the Advisor. He gave me Medal of Honor and told me to go see Jay.
I showed Jay the Medal of Honor that Tigun gave me, and in return, he gave me 1012109:#. As a sign of thanks for finding the history book, Jay gave me 1012109:#.

quests.name: Estelle's Special Sauce
quests.description:
I received the special sauce from Estelle near Ellinia. I guess I have to return to Mrs. Ming Ming with 20 Pig's Head and 60 Octopus' Legs. Pig's Head : 4000017/20 Octopus' Legs : 4000006/60 Estelle's Special Sauce : 4031154/1
I got all the materials that Mrs. Ming Ming asked me to get, and gave it to her. I can't wait to see the village festival!
quests.requirements: Octopus Leg x 60, Pig's Head x 20, Estelle's Special Sauce x 1

quests.name: The Path of Warrior
quests.description:
What do I have to do to make the job advancement as a warrior I'll have to go see Olaf of Lith Harbor.
Olaf of Lith Harbor tells me I can choose to become a warrior if I'm at least on level 10. He tells me I'll need to see Dances with Balrog of Perion ... but how do I get there I'll have to check on the world map. (W)
I have learned what it takes to become a true warrior through Dances with Balrog. Hope this is the right path I'm taking...

quests.name: The Path of Bowman
quests.description:
What do I have to do to make the job advancement as a bowman I'll have to go see Olaf of Lith Harbor.
Olaf of Lith Harbor tells me I can choose to become a bowman if I'm at least on level 10. He tells me I'll need to see Athena Pierce of Henesys ... but how do I get there I'll have to check on the world map. (W)
I have learned what it takes to become a true bowman through Athena Pierce of Henesys. Hope this is the right path I'm taking...

quests.name: The Path of Thief
quests.description:
What do I have to do to make the job advancement as a thief, just like Dark Lord of Kerning City I'll have to go see Olaf of Lith Harbor and find out myself.
Olaf of Lith Harbor tells me I can choose to become a thief if I'm at least on level 10. He tells me I'll need to see Dark Lord of Kerning City ... but how do I get there I'll have to check on the world map. (W)
I have learned what it takes to become a true thief through Dark Lord of Henesys.

quests.name: The Path of Magician
quests.description:
What do I have to do to make the job advancement as a magician I'll have to go see Olaf of Lith Harbor and find out myself.
Olaf of Lith Harbor tells me I can choose to become a magicianr if I'm at least on level 8. He tells me I'll need to see Grendel the Really Old of Ellinia ... but how do I get there I'll have to check on the world map. (W)
I have learned what it takes to become a true magician through the chief of all wizards, Grendel the Really Old. Hope this is the right path I'm taking...

quests.name: A Lesson on Job Advancement
quests.description:
What do I have to do to choose a job of my liking I'll have to see Olaf of Lith Harbor.
I'll have to listen to Olaf carely as he describes the in's and out's of each and every job, because he'll quiz me on it afterwards.
I answered all the questions Olaf asked. I'll have to be at least on level 10 in order to become a warrior, thief, or a bowman, and level 8 to become a magician. Warrior-hopefuls will need to head over to Perion for job-advancement, Kerning City for thief-hopefuls, Ellinia for magician-hopefuls, and Henesys for bowman-hopefuls.

quests.name: The Stump Horror Story
quests.description:
Ayan of Perion says she can't take one step out of town. I wonder why...
I met Ayan of Perion. Apparently, she cannot remember anything about her childhood, and she lives everyday in fear of Stumps. So scared, in fact, that she can't even dare to look at it. Accompanied by this paralyzing fear of Stumps, she cannot take one step out of Perion, and asks me to take them out for her sake. Are they really THAT scary Stump 20821#
I took out Stumps for the sake of Ayan in Perion. She can finally venture outside without having to worry about them!

quests.name: Icarus's Hang Glider
quests.description:
Apparently there's someone at Kerning City by the name of Icarus that stands on top of a building just staring at the sky 24/7.
I got to meet Icarus on top of a building at Kerning City. He seems like a nice guy who has an unquenchable thirst for flying, and he wants to create a Hang Glider to fulfill his dream of flying. He asks me if I can gather up the materials for the Hang Glider, and even though the process of making the Hang Glider seems dubious at best, I can't say no to his sincere desire to fly. I'll need to get him 50 Stirge Wings, 10 Processed Woods, and 50 Stiff Feathers. Stirge Wing 4000042/50 Processed Wood 4003001/10 Stiff Feather 4003004/50
I got the materials needed for Icarus to make the Hang Glider and realize his dream of flying. I just wonder if Stirge's wings are enough to make the Hang Glider. I don't know if this will really work, though, so I'll check up on him around the time when the Hang Glider should be ready to take flight.
quests.requirements: Processed Wood x 10, Stirge Wing x 50, Stiff Feather x 50

quests.name: Icarus and the Balloon
quests.description:
I wonder how Icarus's doing with the glider...maybe I should go check up on him at Kerning City.
Icarus had failed to create a working Hang Glider, and is now attempting to create a flying balloon on his never-ending quest for flight. This looks just as preposterous as his last attempt, but I don't think I can stop him. To make the flying balloon, he needs 100 Tablecloths and 10 Alligator Skin Pouchs. Hope this works... Tablecloth 4000035/100 Alligator Skin Pouch 4031164/10
I got the materials needed for Icarus to make the flying balloon and realize his dream of flying. I don't know if his "flying balloon" will indeed fly, but there's a chance that it may indeed work. I'll check up on him around the time when the flying balloon should be ready to take flight and see if he's for real this time.
quests.requirements: Alligator Skin Pouch x 10, Tablecloth x 100

quests.name: In search of Wing the Fairy
quests.description:
I wonder how Icarus's doing with the flying balloon...maybe I should go check up on him at Kerning City.
Icarus had failed to make the flying balloon, but his never-ending quest for flight remains. This time he wants to deviate from the scientific approach to flight and opts for the magical approach, and asks me to see his best friend Wing the Fairy at Ellinia, the town of fairies. Apparently Wing the Fairy knows the way to make 'Flying Medicine'...I'll need to see that fairy at Ellinia for Icarus's sake.
quests.next_quest_name: The Ingredients for the Flying Pill

quests.name: The Ingredients for the Flying Pill
quests.description: I meet Wing the Fairy at Ellinia, and he doesn't seem to like people in general. How is he best friends with Icarus in the first place Anyway, he says in order to make Flying Medicine, he'll need 50 Medicine With Weird Vibess and 20 Witchgrass Leafs. So that's all it takes Medicine With Weird Vibes 4000036/50 Witchgrass Leaf 4031165/20
quests.requirements: Witchgrass Leaf x 20, Medicine With Weird Vibes x 50

quests.name: Delivering the Flying Pill
quests.description:
Wing the Fairy of Ellinia asked me to take the Flying Pill to Icarus. So this little pill is all it takes to fly I need to get this to Icarus ASAP.
I got Icarus the Flying Pill that Wing the Fairy of Ellinia made. I hope it works for him.
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: Icarus Cape (1) (33.33%), Icarus Cape (2) (33.33%), Icarus Cape (3) (33.33%)

quests.name: The Reason Behind the Mushroom Studies
quests.description:
I should go see Bruce in Henesys...
I got to meet Bruce, who has been studying the monsters and animals in general in Henesys. His bright smile and the easy-going demeanor belies the painful fact that his daughter has been missing for some time, and that he's been studying the mushroom monsters for the sake of finding a clue on his daughter's whereabouts. He asks me if I can help him out, and I just can't say no to a worthy cause like this... Mushroom Spore 4000011/10 Orange Mushroom Cap 4000001/40
I helped Bruce gather up the materials necessary for his studies. Will these help him find his daughter
quests.requirements: Orange Mushroom Cap x 40, Mushroom Spore x 10

quests.name: I Need Help on My Homework!
quests.description:
Whenever I walk past Wing the Fairy of Ellinia, he seems to be asking for help. I wonder what it is...
Wing the Fairy of Ellinia seems to have a general disdain for humans. Definitely not the kind of attitude I expect from someone in need of help. He asked me if I can get him 30 tree branches, 30 squishy liquids, and 10 slime bubbles. He needs them so he can make a potion for his homework. Tree Branch 4000003/30 Squishy Liquid 4000004/30 Slime Bubble 4000010/10
I helped Wing the Fairy of Ellinia with his homework. I have no idea how that potion works, though.
quests.requirements: Slime Bubble x 10, Tree Branch x 30, Squishy Liquid x 30

quests.name: I'm Bored 1
quests.description:
I should go see Icarus, who's at the top of a building in Kerning City. He seems to be bored out of his mind.
I got to talk to Icarus of Kerning City. Just what exactly is he doing staring aimlessly at the sky anyway He seemed to be really bored, and asked me if I can answer his set of questions.
I answered all the questions that Icarus of Kerning City asked. That was easy.

quests.name: I'm Bored 2
quests.description:
I answered all the questions that Icarus of Kerning City asked. That was easy.
I answered all of Icarus's questions, but he still seemed bored out of his mind. He asked me if I could get him a toy that he could play around with. Tree Branch 4000003/40 Squishy Liquid 4000004/40
I had fun playing around with Icarus.
quests.requirements: Tree Branch x 40, Squishy Liquid x 40

quests.name: I Need to Find My Daughter 1
quests.description:
I wonder how Bruce is doing in Henesys these days...
I met up with Bruce in Henesys, and he had great news: He finally found his daughter!!! There was one problem, however: She seems to be suffering from amnesia, Bruce gave me a toy that his daughter played around while growing up, and asked me if I can give that to her.
I found Ayan and gave her the toy sword.
quests.parent: I Need to Find My Daughter
quests.next_quest_name: I Need to Find My Daughter 2

quests.name: I Need to Find My Daughter 2
quests.description:
Amazingly, Ayan recovered from amnesia with the help of the toy sword. That's just amazing!!! The only thing left now is for Ayan and Bruce to finally meet up, but first, I got to get this letter from Ayan to Bruce.
I'm so glad that Ayan got her memory back. I'm even gladder that Bruce got to finally see his daughter again! What a moment...
quests.parent: I Need to Find My Daughter

quests.name: Taking Out the Alligators 1
quests.description:
I heard something happened to the tribesmen of Perion. I should go talk to Ayan about this.
I met up with Ayan in Perion. She told me that a few days ago, a group of tribesmen went hunting in the swamps and wound up being ambushed by a group of alligators. She was worried about the sudden surge of alligators taking over the swamps and asked me to take them out before they spawn out of control. I'll have to kill 250 Ligators and 40 Jr. Neckis while taking 20 Jr. Necki Skin along the way. Ligator 20942# Jr. Necki 20941# Jr. Necki Skin 4000034/20
The tribesmen of Perion got ambushed by the alligator herd at the swamps, so Iyan asked if I could help take care of the alligators. I responded by taking out 250 Ligators and 40 Jr. Neckis. Hopefully this will put some peace back into the swamp.

quests.name: Taking Out the Alligators 2
quests.description:
Ayan of Perion is desperately looking for me. Is something wrong
I found Ayan, and she seemed to be in a state of panic. She was walking around the swamp when she ran into a bigger, stronger, and more dangerous group of alligators than the previous ones. She ran back to Perion and had been looking for me ever since, so I could help her out once more. This time, I'll need to kill 120 Crocos and take 50 Croco Skins along the way. Croco 20951# Croco Skin 4000033/ 50
I took out 120 Crocos from the swamps, just like the way Ayan asked me to. I'll have to revisit that spot from time to time and take out the alligators before they spawn out of control.
