quests.name: A Spell that Seals Up a Critical Danger I
quests.description:
Apparently a strange vibe has been permeating deep inside the dungeon of Victoria Island. I should meet up with the Insignificant Being for details.
I need to gather up 33 Cold Steam from Cold Eye that'll be used in a spell that can only be conducted by the Insignificant Being. Cold Steam 4031212/33
The Insignificant Being finally gave me a chance. Where can I gether up the items needed for the spell
quests.parent: A Spell that Seals Up a Critical Danger

quests.name: A Spell that Seals Up a Critical Danger II
quests.description:
The Insignificant Being said he needs to gather up the ingredients necessary to use as a spell to seal up the danger that's been spread all over the deep regions of the Dungeon.
I need to gather up the items that the Insignificant Being needs to seal up the curse. The items are: 33 Wild Kargo's Spirit Rocks, 18 Tauromacis Spirit Rocks, and 18 Taurospear Spirit Rocks ... Wild Kargo's Spirit Rock 4031213/33 Taurospear's Spirit Rock 4031215/18 Tauromacis's Spirit Rock 4031214/18
I gathered up the spirit rocks for Wild Kargo, Taurmacis, and even Taurospear. Is there more left
quests.parent: A Spell that Seals Up a Critical Danger
quests.requirements: Wild Kargo's Spirit Rock x 33, Tauromacis's Spirit Rock x 18, Taurospear's Spirit Rock x 18

quests.name: Camila's Lost Letter
quests.description:
Apparently, Camila of Henesys lost something...
She was devastated that her friend, who lives far from here, sent her a letter, only to be stolen by the notorious Curse Eye's. She was crying as she asked me for help. I may have to find the letter for the sake of Camila, but where is that girl The Letter to Camila 4031239/1
I recovered Camila's letter that had been stolen from the Curse Eye's. It should be fun writing letters to people far from me...
quests.parent: Looking for the Korean Folk Town…
quests.next_quest_name: Two Ways to Get to Korean Folk Town

quests.name: Two Ways to Get to Korean Folk Town
quests.description:
The letter that was sent to Camila was written by her pen pal, and it said she might not be able to write her again. Camila sensed something wrong might have happened to her friend, and asked me if I could visit her at Korean Folk Town, where she lived, and check on her.
At Korean Folk Town, I was able to meet Camila's pen pal, Kong Ji. She looked ecstatic after I gave her Camila's reply letter.
quests.parent: Looking for the Korean Folk Town…

quests.name: Korean Folk Town : Through the Sky
quests.description:
How about going to the Korean Folk Town through the sky
Through Camila's request, I have decided to travel to Korean Folk Town through the skypath and meet her pen pal, Kong Ji. Camila said she'll give me a few essential items for the trip. What must those be
Through Camila's request, I have decided to travel to Korean Folk Town through the skypath and meet her pen pal, Kong Ji. Okay, so I first go from Ellinia to Orbis, then to Ludibrium And once I get there, I'm supposed to walk my way down there through Helios Tower. That's pretty far...
quests.rewards_items: Ticket to Orbis (Regular), Ticket to Ludibrium (Regular)

quests.name: Korean Folk Town : Through the Ocean
quests.description:
How about going to the Korean Folk Town through the ocean
Through Camila's request, I have decided to travel to Korean Folk Town through the ocean and meet her pen pal, Kong Ji. Camila said she'll give me a few essential items for the trip. What must those be
Through Camila's request, I have decided to travel to Korean Folk Town through the ocean and meet her pen pal, Kong Ji. Okay, so I first go from Ellinia to Orbis, then from Orbis Tower all the way down to Aqua Road I think she told me to take the Dolphin Taxi at Aquarium...
quests.rewards_items: Ticket to Orbis (Regular), Orbis Rock Scroll, 3x Dolphin Taxi Coupon

quests.name: Nella's Dream
quests.description:
Apparently, Nella of Kerning City had a weird dream ...
I heard a really weird dream story from Nella, who lived in Kerning City. She ran into a cat in the middle of a green forest full of trees... and she can't tell if it's a dream or for real.
In the middle of the forest in Ellinia, I found the mysterious cat that Nella had seen in her dream.

quests.name: Fanzy's Red Furball
quests.description:
The mysterious cat that I ran into in the middle of Ellinia forest introduced엘리니아itself as Fanzy, and it's a cat that is raised by a fairy living in Ellinia Forest. A few days ago, while hanging out in the forest, it lost the Red Ball of Yarn that's been given by its master. Fanzy really wanted me to find it for it, so in the middle of the forest, I better find Slime, fight to get Red Ball of Yarn back, then bring them back to Fanzy with my pet by my side for a handsome reward... Red Ball of Yarn 4031273 / 1
I brought the Red Ball of Yarn back from Slime to Fanzy, and to my delight, Fanzy increased the closeness level between my pet and me.

quests.name: DANGER! <1-G. Mushroom>
quests.description:
I heard there's a warning sign on monsters somewhere Deep in the Forest...
Eliminate 99 Green Mushrooms, then find "The Rememberer." Green Mushroom 21051#
I tried eliminating the Green Mushrooms all-together, but the number didn't seem to decrease at all.

quests.name: DANGER! <2-H. Mushroom>
quests.description:
I heard there's a warning sign on monsters somewhere around Ant Tunnel...
Eliminate 99 Horny Mushrooms, then find "The Rememberer." Horny Mushroom 21061#
I tried eliminating the Horny Mushrooms all-together, but the number didn't seem to decrease at all.

quests.name: DANGER! <3-Z. Mushroom>
quests.description:
I heard there's a warning sign on monsters somewhere around Ant Tunnel...
Eliminate 99 Zombie Mushrooms, then find "The Rememberer." Zombie Mushroom 21071#
I tried eliminating the Zombie Mushrooms all-together, but the number didn't seem to decrease at all.

quests.name: POLLUTED! <1-Evil Eye>
quests.description:
I heard there's a warning sign on monsters somewhere around The Cave of Evil Eye...
Eliminate 99 Evil Eyes, then find "The Rememberer." Evil Eye 21081#
I tried eliminating the Evil Eyes all-together, but the number didn't seem to decrease at all.

quests.name: POLLUTED! <2-Curse Eye>

quests.name: Planting Trees
quests.description:
I heard Winston is looking for ways to liven up the barren grounds of Perion.
Thanks to the excavation project, Perion and its surrounding areas have been rapidly deteriorating. To liven up the area, Winston wanted me to get him Seedlings to plant around the area. Get Winston 54 Seedlings from Ghost Stumps at Excavation Sites. Seedling 4000195/54
I defeated Ghost Stump and collected Seedling. Winston promised to liven up the currently-barren Perion by planting lots of trees around the area, and he'll be the first to start it.

quests.name: Shawn the Excavator's Request
quests.description:
Winston, who resides at the East Rocky Mountain, said Shawn the excavator asked him for a favor...
Lately, the excavation site has been hit with an unknown monster. As a result, Winston requested that I study the reason behind the monster's creation. To conduct the research, I'll have to collect 5 each of Wooden Board and Slate that Wooden Mask and Rocky Mask use. Wooden Board 4000196/5 Slate 4000197/5
He said studying Wooden Board and Slate will take some time. I better wait til it gets done with.

quests.name: Eliminate Monsters from the Site
quests.description:
Winston asked me to wait while he's analyzing Wooden Board and Slate.
Winston seemed shocked to find out what he had found out through studying Wooden Board and Slate, but he didn't want to divulge the information on me. He wanted me to first eliminate the monsters, so I'll do that. Wooden Mask 21182# Rocky Mask 21181#
Winston claimed the monsters have decreased dramatically, but I disagree. Not only that, but I felt a strange vibe around the excavation site. What would that be...
quests.requirements: Defeat Rocky Mask x 300, Defeat Wooden Mask x 200

quests.name: Notice from the Excavation Team
quests.description:
Someone's telling me there's an urgent notice posted on the bulletin board at the excavation camp.
I read the notice posted on the board at Excavation Site <Camp>. Apparently, many of the excavators were attacked by the Army of Skeletons around the tomb site, and wanted someone to eliminate 200 Skeleton soldiers, 100 Skeleton officers, and 40 Skeleton commanders. In addition, the board stated that as evidence, whoever eliminated those monsters will have to bring 60 ribs, 40 pelvic bones, and 20 horse skulls. Skeleton Soldier 21193# Officer Skeleton 21191# Commander Skeleton 21192# Rib 4000206/60 Pelvic Bone 4000207/40 Horse Skull 4000208/20
I eliminated the skeletons at the tomb site and collected their bones to show them to Shawn the excavator.

quests.name: Missing Staff Sergeant Charlie
quests.description:
Let's go meet Master Sergeant Fox.
Inside El Nath, I found Master Sergeant Fox, who seemed to have crashlanded here. He asked if I can find 3 of his men and if they are doing their job whereever they are. The ones I need to meet up are Staff Sergeant Charlie, Corporal Easy, and Sergeant Bravo, and they should be around Ossyria. He'd prefer that I meet them in the order of their ranks... that sounds pretty difficult to me ...
quests.next_quest_name: A Request from Staff Sergeant Charlie

quests.name: Missing Sergeant Bravo
quests.description:
Inside El Nath, I found Master Sergeant Fox, who seemed to have crashlanded here. He asked if I can find 3 of his men and if they are doing their job whereever they are. The ones I need to meet up are Staff Sergeant Charlie, Corporal Easy, and Sergeant Bravo, and they should be around Ossyria. He'd prefer that I meet them in the order of their ranks. I found Staff Sergeant Charlie at Orbis. Now I have to find Sergeant Bravo next.
I found Sergeant Bravo in the middle of a snowfield far from El Nath. He said he's been doing his duties and that, while investigating around the area, he found this piece of an ancient document that he wants me to deliver to Master Sergeant Fox.

start_items.name: A Piece of an Ancient Scroll

quests.name: Missing Corporal Easy
quests.description:
Inside El Nath, I found Master Sergeant Fox, who seemed to have crashlanded here. He asked if I can find 3 of his men and if they are doing their job whereever they are. The ones I need to meet up are Staff Sergeant Charlie, Corporal Easy, and Sergeant Bravo, and they should be around Ossyria. He'd prefer that I meet them in the order of their ranks. I found Staff Sergeant Charlie and Sergeant Bravo. Now I have to find Corporal Easy next.
I found Corporal Easy in the middle of an old-looking tower far from El Nath. He said he's been doing his duties and that, while investigating around the area, he found this piece of an ancient document that he wants me to deliver to Master Sergeant Fox.

start_items.name: A Piece of an Ancient Scroll

quests.name: Returning to Master Sergeant Fox
quests.description:
Master Sergeant Fox asked me to meet Staff Sergeant Charlie, Sergeant Bravo, and Corporal Easy in order. I met them all just as Master Sergeant Fox told me. I should be returning to him right away.
Just like the way Master Sergeant Fox requested, I met his men in order of ranks and got the 3 pieces of an ancient document to him. He was really happy about it, and gave me the scroll made out of those pieces. He also wished that I could drop by sometime later and see how the other men are doing...maybe I should...
quests.requirements: A Piece of an Ancient Scroll x 3

quests.name: The Descendent of the Author of the Book of Ancient
quests.description:
I should go see Alcaster of El Nath right now...
I met Alcaster, the archeologist, at El Nath. He said he had heard about the Book of Ancient, which tells about the Great World War, happened hundreds years ago. Interesting... The only living descendant of the author of the "Book of Ancient" Hella who lives in Orbis. I better go to find her right now~
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

quests.name: Hella's Missing
quests.description: Alcaster told me to go to Hella's house in Orbis, to no avail. She wasn't anywhere to be found, as I had to resort to talking to her housekeeper, Elma. According to her, Hella hadn't been home in months, and no one knows where she went or why. She did tell me to go see her best friend, Jade of El Nath, so I should go there immediately.
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

quests.name: Where's Hella?
quests.description: Jade suspected that Hella may have gone on a search to find the keepsake of her late mother, and told me to go see Hella's housekeeper again.
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

quests.name: One Clue
quests.description: Elma the Housekeeper told me she heard Hella mention something about an old lady. She also told me to go talk to Jade again if I want to know more about her.
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

quests.name: Looking For the Old Lady
quests.description: Jade said the "old lady" may be Spriuna, who lives in a small house around where the Orbis park monsters walk around, and recommends that I go see her immediately.
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

quests.name: Spiruna's Black Crystal
quests.description: Spiruna promised to tell me everything that she knows, as long as I find the Black Crystal that she lost in the snowfield while on a search for some materials for spells. Now where in the snowfield must that be...
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

quests.name: The Cracked Black Crystal
quests.description: I found Spiruna's Black Crystal underneath a rock at the snowfield, but it has some serious cracks on it. Anyway I should give this back to Spiruna immediately.
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

quests.name: To Restore the Crystal
quests.description: Just as I expected...Spiruna went livid over the cracked Black Crystal, and blames it all on me!!! Maybe I should seek some help from that lady standing next to her.
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

quests.name: A Word from the Assistant
quests.description: Spiruna's assistant quietly tells me that at this point, nothing will bring her back to her senses, unless I bring an item called Fairy Dust, the only item that'll restore the cracked black crystal to its original state. Kriel the Fairy of Orbis Department Store may have it.
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

quests.name: To Acquire the Fairy Dust
quests.description: Kriel the Fairy wanted to make a deal with me, and I complied. For her to give up the Fairy Dust, I'll have to get her 100 Star Pixie Starpieces, 50 Lunar Pixie Moonpieces, and 30 Luster Pixie Sunpieces. I'll have to go on a serious Pixie hunting spree for a while. Luster Pixie's Sunpiece 4000061/30 Star Pixie's Starpiece 4000059/100 Lunar Pixie's Moonpiece 4000060/50
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient
quests.requirements: Luster Pixie's Sunpiece x 30, Star Pixie's Starpiece x 100, Lunar Pixie's Moonpiece x 50

quests.name: Acquiring the Fairy Dust
quests.description: I got Kriel the Fairy all the items she asked for, and got the Fairy Dust in return. Now all I need to do is get this to Spiruna and see what happens.

quests.name: The Truth Comes Out...
quests.description: Spiruna was utterly ecstatic over receiving the Fairy Dust, and proceeded to tell me everything she knew about Hella. Oh my goodness ... are you kidding me That assistant there is the Hella I've been looking for all this time
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

quests.name: Hella is Found!
quests.description: Hella requested that I get this pendant to Jade. She also mentioned something about an old diary that she found at home years ago, and it mentioned the existence of the Book of Ancient, and that the owner lost it somewhere deep in the valley of the snowfield. Jade should fill up the rest for me. I got to go see him right now and inform him of her whereabouts.
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: Scroll for Shoes for DEX (25%), Scroll for Shoes for DEX (25%), Scroll for Shoes for Speed (25%), Scroll for Shoes for Speed (25%)

quests.name: The Small Grave That's Hidden
quests.description: I gave Jade the pendant from Hella, and I could immediately sense that he was pleased to know that his friend is alright after all. That small grave Jade mentioned should be somewhere in the snowfield.
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

quests.name: An Old Ring
quests.description: I found an anonymous grave somewhere deep in the valley of the snowfield. I also removed an old ring from the corpse's finger. Maybe Alcaster knows what to do with it.
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

quests.name: The Secrets Behind the Ring?
quests.description: Alcaster took time observing the ring, and felt an incredible force emanating from it. He recommended that I go see Scadur the Hunter around El Nath.
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

quests.name: Collecting Wolf Skin
quests.description: Scadur mentioned that the price of wolf skin has gone up the roof these days, and wanted to make a deal with me. 100 Hector Tails and 100 White Fang Tails will be enough for him to return the ring to me, along with telling me everything he knows regarding the situation. . Hector Tail 4000051/100 White Pang Tail 4000052/100
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient
quests.requirements: Hector Tail x 100, White Pang Tail x 100
quests.next_quest_name: Looking for the Wiseman in Perion

quests.name: Looking for the Wiseman in Perion
quests.description: I handed Scadur the wolf skins he asked for, and he gave me back the old ring. He reminisced the old days where heard about the ring through the four wisemen he had met as a young man. He recommended me to go visit Victoria Island and meet up with all four of the wisemen, starting with the one in Perion.
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient
quests.next_quest_name: Dances with Balrog and His Recovery

quests.name: Dances with Balrog and His Recovery
quests.description: I went to Perion and met up with Dances with Balrog. After I showed him the ring, he conceded that he may have an item that'll provide enough clues to help me ultimately find the Book of Ancient. Of course, he also didn't want to just give it away like that. Since he's spent too much energy trying to help other warriors, he wanted 2 Power Crystals to recover his strength, in return for handing me the item that holds the clue.
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient
quests.next_quest_name: Looking for the Wiseman in Ellinia

quests.name: Looking for the Wiseman in Ellinia
quests.description: I handed Dances with Balrog 2 Power Crystals and received the 1st old piece of map. The map is cut in four pieces, each piece held by a wiseman. He wanted me to gather up all four pieces of the map, find the Book of Ancient through it, and seal it up for good. Next up: The wiseman in Ellinia.
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient
quests.next_quest_name: Grendel the Really Old and His Recovery

quests.name: Grendel the Really Old and His Recovery
quests.description: The wiseman of Ellinia, Grendel the Really Old, promised to give me the map piece in exchange for 2 Wisdom Crystals.
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient
quests.next_quest_name: Looking for the Wiseman in Henesys

quests.name: Looking for the Wiseman in Henesys
quests.description: I met my end of the bargain by handing Grendel the Really Old the 2 Wisdom Crystals, and he met his end of the bargain by handing me the 2nd old piece of the map. Next up: The wisewoman at Henesysk.
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

quests.name: Athena Pierce and Her Recovery
quests.description: The wiseman of Henesys, Athena Pierce, promised to give me the old piece of map in exchange for 2 DEX Crystals.
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient
quests.next_quest_name: Looking for the Wiseman in Kerning City

quests.name: Looking for the Wiseman in Kerning City
quests.description: I met my end of the bargain by handing Athena Pierce the 2 DEX Crystals, and she met her end of the bargain by handing me the 3rd old piece of map. Last up: The wiseman at Kerning City.
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

quests.name: Dark Lord and His Recovery
quests.description: The wiseman of Kerning City, Dark Lord, promised to give me the map piece in exchange for 2 LUK Crystals.
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient
quests.next_quest_name: All the Map Pieces in One Place

quests.name: All the Map Pieces in One Place
quests.description: I have obtained all 4 map pieces from the four wisemen in Victoria Island, and this map supposedly locates where the Book of Ancient is currently hidden. I should get back to Alcaster now.
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

quests.name: Restoring the Map
quests.description: So I need the Memory Powder to put the map pieces back as one...I better talk to Corporal Easy of Alpha Platoon and see if he has it.
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

quests.name: Acquiring the Memory Powder
quests.description: Corporal Easy promised me to hand me the Memory Powder in exchange for 3 Toenails of Werewolf. Apparently those Werewolves reside deep in the snowfield... Werewolf Toenail 4000053/3
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient
quests.next_quest_name: The Map is in One Piece

quests.name: The Map is in One Piece
quests.description: I got the Memory Powder from Corporal Easy. Now I need to get this to Alcaster.
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient

quests.name: The Secrets Behind the Statue
quests.description: With the Memory Powder, Alcaster was able to attach the four map pieces and turn it into a map. According to the map, the Book of Ancient lies somewhere around Orbis Tower at some statue.
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient
quests.next_quest_name: The Book of Ancient is Back!

quests.name: The Book of Ancient is Back!
quests.description:
I can't believe I finally have a hold of the Book of Ancient. Now I need to turn this over to Alcaster...
A lot of time and effort were put into this, but the Book of Ancient is finally back in Alcaster's hands as he will begin working on the process of sealing up the book for good. As a sign of appreciation, he rewarded me with a special cape. I really hope he finds a way to seal up the book for good.
quests.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: Blue Justice Cape (25%), Red Justice Cape (25%), White Justice Cape (25%), Black Justice Cape (25%)

quests.name: Alcaster and the Dark Crystal
quests.description:
I should go check up on Alcaster in El Nath soon.
Alcaster of El Nath told me in order to seal up the Book of Ancient, he'll need a Dark Crystal and a Star Rock. So here I am, looking for those two. The Dark Crystal is supposedly only available through evil-minded monsters, and the ores can be refined through Spiruna of Orbis Park.
I got Alcaster the Dark Crystal and the Star Rock. He may have been drained and exhausted from sealing up the Book of Ancient, but he seems peaceful at heart
quests.requirements: Star Rock x 1, Dark Crystal x 1
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: Blue Magic Cape (25%), Red Magic Cape (25%), White Magic Cape (25%), Black Magic Cape (25%)

quests.name: Traces of Nick
quests.description:
I should go see Scadur the Hunter in El Nath.
I got to see Scadur again, first time we really got to talk since the whole Book of Ancient fiasco. He told me a story of how, a long time ago, a bunch of monsters from the dead mine claimed the life of his wife, enraging his son Nick. 3 years later, he went into the dead mine, hoping to avenge his mother's death, but haven't been heard since. He wanted me to find Nick's Ring somewhere at the innermost part of the lava cave. He also wants me to grant his dying wish, which would be collecting 100 Cerebes' teeth. This will be VERY tough to do ...
I went into the innermost part of the lava cave, where I found a chipped part of a statue. I have a feeling something is in here.
quests.parent: Nick, the Son of Scadur the Hunter

quests.name: Nick's Ring
quests.description:
At the bottom of a chipped part of the statue was what appeared to be Nick's ring. A name is engraved on it, and I suppose Scadur can read out the name for me. Cerebes Tooth 4000079/100 Nick's Ring 4031060/1
I found Nick's ring at the lava cave, and I also collected a number of Cerebes's teeth, getting them all to Scadur. Hopefully Nick will be satisfied with this. I got a cape from Scadur that's been passed down from generation to generation ... this ain't bad at all!
quests.parent: Nick, the Son of Scadur the Hunter
quests.requirements: Nick's Ring x 1, Cerebes Tooth x 100
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: Blue Gaia Cape (25%), Red Gaia Cape (25%), White Gaia Cape (25%), Black Gaia Cape (25%)

quests.name: Collecting Huckle's Magic Ingredients
quests.description:
I heard there is an old man called Huckle inside a hidden secret room in Orbis Tower...
I met an old man named Huckle at the hidden room in the middle of Orbis Tower. He's been living in there for 30 years, studying the physics of the self-moving stones. He wants me to gather up 45 Jr. Sentinel Shellpieces, 20 Ice Sentinel Shellpieces, and 20 Fire Sentinel Shellpieces. Alright, let's do this ...
I got Huckle, the old man living in the hidden room at the Orbis Tower, the items he had requested, and in return, got the Statue-Teleporting Scroll. It allows me to teleport between the statue at the 20th floor of Orbis Tower, and the 1st floor. Huckle looks like he needs more samples, so I guess I'll need to keep looking for those ...
quests.requirements: Fire Sentinel Shellpiece x 20, Jr. Sentinel Shellpiece x 45, Ice Sentinel Shellpiece x 20

quests.name: A Request from Staff Sergeant Charlie
quests.description: I found Staff Sergeant Charlie at Orbis, and he asked me to get him 2 refined Orihalcon Plates while giving me an item which is to be given to Master Sergeant Fox.

quests.name: A Request from Sergeant Bravo
quests.description: I found Sergeant Bravo at the snowfield, and he asked me to get him 2 refined Adamantium Plates while giving me an item which is to be given to Master Sergeant Fox.

quests.name: A Request from Corporal Easy
quests.description: I found Corporal Easy somewhere around the Orbis Tower, and he asked me to get him 2 refined Sapphires while giving me an item which is to be given to Master Sergeant Fox.

quests.name: Delivering a Mysterious Item
quests.description:
I should go see Wing the Fairy, who should be in Ellinia.
I met up with Wing the Fairy of Ellinia. He grabbed me and asked me if I wanted to explore to a new world and train myself there. Unfortunately, that's not what he really meant by it. He just wanted me to be the delivery person and get this item to his friend Kriel the Fairy in Orbis.
I went to Orbis and gave Kriel the Fairy a bottle of Tears of Kelvelos.

quests.name: Helping Kriel Out
quests.description:
I need to go see Kriel the Fairy at Orbis.
Kriel the Fairy seemed to be swamped with work, and asked me if I could help her out. She wanted me to walk around town, collect empty bottles, and collect materials needed to make weapons for magicians. Empty Potion Bottle 4031198/20 Solid Horn 4000073/200 Nependeath Seed 4000058/50
I'm glad I got to help Kriel the Fairy out.

quests.name: The Nependeath Juice
quests.description:
I should go see Alfonse Green, who should be somewhere near Orbis.
I met up with Alfonse Green, and needless to say, he is a big fan of the Nependeath Juice. He asked me if I could make one for him. To make one, I'll need to acquire the Sap of Nependeath, and I'll need Ericsson for that.
I met up with Ericsson.
quests.parent: The Chaos behind Alfonse Green and the Nependeath Juice

quests.name: Ericsson Loves Cats
quests.description:
I should go see Ericsson.
Ericsson was way too busy playing around with his cats and not have enough time making the sap of Nependeath. What can I do to make one
I got the Lunar Wristband for Ericsson's beloved kitty, Nero.
quests.parent: The Chaos behind Alfonse Green and the Nependeath Juice

quests.name: A Present for Nero
quests.description:
I need to see Elma the Housekeeper, who is in Orbis.
She said the only way to convince Ericsson is by making a present for his kitty. After a long though, I have decided to make a Lunar Wristband for Nero the Cat. Star Pixie's Starpiece 4000059/100 Lunar Pixie's Moonpiece 4000060/80
I got Nero's present through Elma. Now if only I can convince Ericsson...
quests.requirements: Star Pixie's Starpiece x 100, Lunar Pixie's Moonpiece x 80

quests.name: Ericsson's Reward
quests.description:
I need to look for Ericsson.
I got Ericsson a present for his cat, and he was so ecstatic over it that he promised to make me a Sap of Nependeath. Nependeath Seed 4000058/200 Dark Nependeath Seed 4000062/100
I got the Sap of Nependeath from Ericsson. I should take this to Elma the Housekeeper immediately!
quests.parent: The Chaos behind Alfonse Green and the Nependeath Juice
quests.requirements: Dark Nependeath Seed x 100, Nependeath Seed x 200

quests.name: Elma's Nependeath Juice
quests.description:
I should ask Elma the Housekeeper to make a glass of Nependeath Juice.
Elma promised me to fix me a nice Nependeath Juice, but she'll need the following ingredients to do so... Sap of Nependeath 4031200/1 Sweet Syrup 4031201/1 Nependeath's Honey 2022039/1 Coconut 4000136/20
Elma fixed me a tasty-looking Nependeath Juice. I better get this to Alfonse Green quickly!
quests.parent: The Chaos behind Alfonse Green and the Nependeath Juice
quests.requirements: Nependeath's Honey x 1, Coconut x 20, Sweet Syrup x 1

quests.name: Estelle and the Syrup
quests.description:
I should go check out Estelle, who should be somewhere around Ellinia.
Estelle asked me to gather up the ingredients necessary to make syrup. She promised to hook me up with a very tasty syrup if I get those for her. Lupin's Banana 4000029/60 Sap of Ancient Tree 2012002/30 Pig's Head 4000017/10
Estelle fixed me a bottle of sugary sweet syrup.
quests.requirements: Lupin's Banana x 60, Pig's Head x 10, Sap of Ancient Tree x 30

quests.name: Alfonse's Smile
quests.description:
I better go see Alfonse right now. I'm sure he's been dying to see me!
I got Alfonse Green exactly what he wanted, the Nependeath Juice.
I've never seen anyone so happy over a glass of juice as Alfonse Green was with his glass of Nependeath Juice.
quests.parent: The Chaos behind Alfonse Green and the Nependeath Juice

quests.name: Lisa's Letter of Recommendation
quests.description:
I should go see Lisa of Orbis.
I've decided to go see Scadur of El Nath with the help of Lisa.
He said he needed my help in order to make a new fur coat.
quests.next_quest_name: Acquiring Materials for the Fur Coat

quests.name: Acquiring Materials for the Fur Coat
quests.description:
I better go introduce myself to Scadur of El Nath with this letter of recommendation from Lisa.
Apparently Scadur had been waiting to change his fur coat for quite some time, for his is worn out. He asked me if I could gather up the finest set of materials for his new fur coat. Hector Tail 4000051/300 White Pang Tail 4000052/300 Yeti Horn 4000049/100 Sapphire Ore 4020005/60
I helped Scadur make the finest fur coat available in Ossyria.

quests.name: Moppie the Lone Dawg
quests.description:
I should go see Moppie, who seemed tired and weary of waiting for his master.
I saw Moppie in Orbis, and he seemed unresponsive to my commands. You could tell he's been waiting for his master for a long time judging from the wrinkly, dirty, unruly hair he features. I wanted to help him out, but I cannot understand whatever Moppie is uttering. I need someone as a translator so I can talk to him, but ... should I ask for a person, or a fairy
I had no idea what Moppie was saying, so I got to ask Lisa for some help.

quests.name: Fairy's Horn Flute
quests.description:
According to Lisa, there is a way to communicate with Moppie the dog, as long as the horn flute is there. They are usually featured by the fairies.
With the fairies' horn flute, I can talk to Moppie with ease...and Lisa promised to make one for me, as long as I gather up the necessary materials for it. Solid Horn 4000073/100 Stiff Feather 4003004/20 Leather 4000021/10
The horn flute for the fairies is finally made. Wow, this thing feels weird...
quests.requirements: Solid Horn x 100, Stiff Feather x 20, Leather x 10
quests.rewards_items: Horn Flute, Blue Moon, 10x All Cure Potion

quests.name: Fairy's Horn Flute II
quests.description:
Lisa of Orbis made me a horn flute. Hopefully this will help me finally understand what Moppie is saying ...
Should I try this horn flute on Moppie
I used the horn flute for fairies on Moppie, and I could finally understand what he's saying!!

quests.name: Lisa's Special Medicine
quests.description:
Thanks to the horn flute, I can clearly comprehend what Moppie is saying. What kind of help is Moppie looking for...
Thanks to the horn flute, I could finally understand what Moppie was saying. Apparently he was just sitting at the same spot waiting for his master until one day, he decided to take matters into his own hands (or paws) and wandered out of town. He was attacked by a monster, and he's been hurt ever since. I need to find someone that can help Moppie get healthy again.
I found that someone that can make the ultimate medicine for Moppie.

quests.name: Lisa's Special Medicine II
quests.description:
To cure Moppie, I need Lisa's Special Medicine...
To make Lisa's Special Medicine, I'll need 40 Orange Potions, 20 Blue Potions, 1 Antidote, and ... 1 Fierry's Tentacle. Obtaining the Fierry's Tentacle is going to be difficult. Orange Potion 2000001/40 Blue Potion 2000003/20 Antidote 2050000/1 Fierry's Tentacle 4000068/1
Lisa's Special Medicine is finally made! The sweet scent of it just makes it look that much more appealing to me, and I'm sure it will for Moppie.

rewards.name: Scroll for Pet Equip. for Speed

quests.requirements: Orange Potion x 40, Blue Potion x 20, Antidote x 1, Fierry's Tentacle x 1
quests.rewards_items: Scroll for Pet Equip. for Speed

quests.name: Lisa's Special Medicine III
quests.description:
With Lisa's Special Medicine, Moppie's injuries should be taken care of in an instant ... I better get to Moppie ASAP.
With Lisa's Special Medicine, Moppie's injuries should be taken care of in an instant...I better get to Moppie ASAP.
Thanks to Lisa's Special Medicine, Moppie is completely healed!

quests.name: A Request from Moppie
quests.description:
I should check up on Moppie, as he is waiting for his master who left him with the words "I'll be back" as he went on his studies.
I should find Moppie's master, Huckle, since he was the one that Moppie with the words "I'll be back" as he went on his studies. Huckle should be somewhere safe in Orbis Tower working on his studies ... but where exactly
I found Huckle, who was diligently working on his studies at the Orbis Tower. He looked like he hadn't bathed in weeks.

quests.name: Food-Hunting for Moppie
quests.description:
Moppie's master Huckle had completely forgotten about his trusty dog as he was conducting his studies in Orbis Tower. He felt so horrible that he wanted to at least feed Moppie with something...
Huckle asked me for a favor, and wanted me to get some fish for Moppie, his favorite dish. I better head downstairs at the bottom of Orbis Tower and collect the fish that Jr. Pepe has. A 100 should be fine. Jr. Pepe's Fish 4000088/100
I gathered up 100 of Jr. Pepe's Fishes and got them to Moppie as a favor from Huckle.
quests.rewards_items: 10x Hot Dog Supreme, 30x Pet Food, 4x Orbis Rock Scroll

quests.name: Food-Hunting for Moppie II
quests.description:
Moppie's master, Huckle, wants to ask me for another favor...
Huckle has little to no time outside his studies, and wanted me to get Moppie some fish again, and this time, he wants me to gather up 200 of them! Jr. Pepe's Fish 4000088/200
I gathered up 200 of Jr. Pepe's Fishes and got them to Moppie as a favor from Huckle.
quests.rewards_items: 15x Hot Dog Supreme, 4x Orbis Rock Scroll, 30x Pet Food

quests.name: Food-Hunting for Moppie III
quests.description:
Moppie's master, Huckle, wants to ask me for another favor...now what
Huckle has little to no time outside his studies, and wanted me to get Moppie some fish again, and this time, he wants me to gather up 300 of them! Jr. Pepe's Fish 4000088/300
I gathered up 300 of Jr. Pepe's Fishes and got them to Moppie as a favor from Huckle, but...
quests.rewards_items: Scroll for Shoes for Speed, 30x Pet Food, 4x Orbis Rock Scroll, 20x White Potion

quests.name: Nero's Necklace
quests.description:
I heard somewhere around Orbis Park, there's a guy strolling along with a black cat on his head. I should check him out.
I met Ericsson at Orbis Park, and despite his intimidating appearance, seemed like a genuinely nice guy who has an affinity for cats. He was concerned about the fact that his cat Nero wandered around and came back without the necklace that he personally made for him. Ericsson asked if I could buy the materials necessary for him to make a new necklace for Nero at the store. Golden Bell 4031191/1 Red Ribbon 4031192/1
As a favor from Ericsson of Orbis Park, I purchased the necessary materials for Ericsson to make a new necklace for Nero.
quests.requirements: Golden Bell x 1, Red Ribbon x 1

quests.name: Protect Nero!
quests.description:
I should check Ericsson out at Orbis Park.
Ericsson had been livid towards the monsters right outside Orbis that have made life miserable for Nero. He wanted me to teach those monsters a lesson by taking out 50 Jr. Cellions, 50 Jr. Lioners, and 50 Jr. Grupin while bring back 50 Solid Horns with me.
Ericsson was livid towards the fact that the monsters outside Orbis had been making his cat Nero's life miserable, so with his blessing, I proceeded to teach those monsters a lesson or two.

Scroll for Pet Equip. for Speed

quests.name: Hughes's Hobby
quests.description:
I should go visit Hughes the Fuse, the weird scientist living at the basement of Orbis Tower.
At a small dinky room in the basement of the Orbis Tower, which also happened to have flooded, I met up with Hughes the Fuse. I accidentally broke Hughes the Fuse's favorite toy baby seal. He proceeded to really get angry and demanded that I take out 50 Scuba Pepe's and 10 Toy Baby Seals. Toy Baby Seal 4000154/10 Scuba Pepe 30651#
I accidentally broke Hughes's Toy Baby Seal, so I got him some Toy Baby Seal as well as kill off some Scuba Pepe's. Fortunatelly, Hughes seems to be okay by now.
quests.requirements: Defeat Scuba Pepe x 50, Toy Baby Seal x 10

quests.name: Hughes's Weird Invention
quests.description:
Hughes the Fuse, the mad scientist who lives at the basement of Orbis Tower, apparently has invented something incredible.
I went to the basement of the Orbis Tower to see the mad scientist, Hughes. He claimed to have invented an equipment that will allow us to breathe underwater. Not bad... He said with a few materials, he can also make one for me. I better start gathering up.... Snorkle 4000153/50 Air Bubble 2022040/50 Steel Plate 4011001/5 Screw 4003000/30
I went to the basement of the Orbis Tower where Hughes lives, gave Hughes all the materials needed, and got Oxygen Tank in return, to breathe underwater.
quests.requirements: Screw x 30, Air Bubble x 50, Steel Plate x 5, Snorkle x 50

quests.name: A Healthy Snack for the Huskies
quests.description:
I should go see Nanuke, who's at the Whale Island that's covered in snow.
I met Nanuke, who lived with his huskies at the snow-covered Whale Island. Nanuke asked me if I could get him 50 Seal Meats for his huskies. Seal Meat 4000157/50
With Nanuke's request, I brought 50 Seal Meats over to the snow-covered Whale Island for his huskies.

quests.name: Hughes's Research Material
quests.description:
I heard Hughes ran out of materials to conduct research ... I should go check him out.
The mad scientist living at the basement of Orbis, Hughes, wanted me to gather up some materials for his new research. Seal Skin 4000155 / 20 Seal Tooth 4000156 / 20
I got him Seal Skin and Seal Tooth for his research.
quests.requirements: Seal Tooth x 20, Seal Skin x 20

quests.name: The Lost Sap of Nependeath
quests.description:
I lost the sap of Nependeath. I better go talk to Ericsson about it.
Fortunately Ericsson had some left over from the last time he made them. He wasn't very pleased with the fact that I lost it, but...I think he'll make me another batch.
I got a new batch of sap of Nependeath from Ericsson.

quests.name: Shammos's Request
quests.description:
I should go meet up with Shammos, who lives somewhere around El Nath.
I met Shammos at the basement of Chief's Residence. Apparently a plan from back then had backfired and rendered him to where he is today ... it seems like he was planning up something sinister, and the four chiefs found out about it and sealed him up. Anyway, he looks really intimidating, and he seems to be cooking up something terrible again. He's not telling me what it is, but he wants me to head over to Perion to get the item he needs. Am I doing the right thing by helping him out
I met up with Manji, who knows a thing or two about the The Contract of Darkness.
quests.next_quest_name: The Secrets Behind the Contract of Darkness

quests.name: The Secrets Behind the Contract of Darkness
quests.description:
I met up with Manji, who knows something about the The Contract of Darkness.
Manji told me some things about the The Contract of Darkness. I couldn't believe what I was hearing. The Contract of Darkness can bring the dead's back to life, and the source of its energy is apparently The Contract of Darkness. That's why the zombies have been wandering around as if they are alive. The unfathomable force of The Contract of Darkness ... I need to find it and take them to Shammos. The Contract of Darkness 4031218/1
I gathered up the The Contract of Darkness and gave them back to Shammos.
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: Scroll for Shoes for DEX (16.67%), Scroll for Shoes for DEX (16.67%), Scroll for Shoes for Jump (16.67%), Scroll for Shoes for Jump (16.67%), Scroll for Shoes for Speed (16.67%), Scroll for Shoes for Speed (16.67%)

quests.name: The Bottled-up Letter
quests.description:
I got a hold of a letter of help from someone who had been sent somewhere near the current at Aquarium. I wonder where exactly the writer is...
I picked up a letter of help from someone. Through the dry sand inside the glass bottle, I was able to find Robinson, who had been asking for help for a while. He seemed tired from the long solitary stay at the island, and he wanted to me to get him a bottle, too. Pure Water 2022000/1
I wound up giving Robinson, who had been trapped in this island for a long time, a nice clean bottle of water. How did he end up getting lost in the first place

quests.name: Robinson's ID
quests.description:
I met Robinson in the middle of the island right at the center of the ocean, and he said that he used be a pilot for the army of Omega Sector, but while in a combat against the aliens, he ran away from the scene, only to be swept by strong currents that led you to where you were. He wishes to get back to the Omega Sector, but currently we have no idea where we are, and he's been covered with scars. As a result, he asked me if I can go to the Omega Sector, notify Kay of his troubles, and ask for some relief. Where is the Omega Sector
I went to see Kay at the Omega Sector, and handed him a card of Robinson's ID. He said everyone's been wondering of his whereabouts, and wanted me to describe the position of the island in detail.

quests.name: Sending Relief
quests.description:
Kay of the Omega Sector complained of the lack of members available due to the battle against the aliens, and asked me if I could give this warp capsule, specially made in Omega Sector, to Robinson. A warp capsule that takes the person to the Omega Sector regardless of the place of origin That's awesome!! I want to take it myself for a split second, until I found out that only the Omega Sector members can use it. Darn it...
Kay needed help from me, since he couldn't send the rescuers to save Robinson, and so I got the specially-made warp capsule and gave it to Robinson. Now he can go back to the Omega Sector and get himself fixed.
quests.rewards_items: Great Red Helmet, Red Guiltian, Red Distinction, Red Pilfer, Red Starry Bandana

quests.name: Carta the Sea Witch
quests.description:
Muse, who works at the Aquarium Zoo, asked me for help, and wanted me to go see her at the Aquarium. What does she need from me...
Muse, who works at the Aquarium Zoo, asked me to go see her. Muse said she wanted to find out the whereabouts of her boyfriend Gail, who has volunteered to be part of the exploration team that heads deep in the underwater, and asked me if I could go talk to Carta the sea witch about him.
At the request of Muse, I went to see Carta the sea witch. Carta lived inside the cave at Deep Sea Gorge I.

quests.name: Carta's Demand
quests.description:
At the request of Muse, I went underwater to meet up with the Sea Witch, Carta. Unfortunately, when I got there, she said she can't foresee the future.
Carta flat-out claimed she couldn't predict the future, but she said she can at least see what the person in question is doing right now. She also said that since the spell is really difficult to pull off, so I'll need to gather up the items if I want to find out what's in store for Gail. She requested that I get 3 Cold Tears and 10 Sea Dusts from Bone Fish, and 1 Pianus's Scream that can be obtained through Pianus while it's dying. Cold Tear 4031256/3 Sea Dust 4031251/10 Pianus's Scream 4031253/1
I gathered up all the items Carta asked me to get.
quests.requirements: Sea Dust x 10, Pianus's Scream x 1, Cold Tear x 3

quests.name: Carta's Fortune-Telling
quests.description:
I gathered up all the materials that Carta asked me get. Maybe I can now find out what happened to Gail.
According to Carta, something terrible indeed happened to Gail. What can possibly happen underwater Anyway, I should let Muse of this immediately. I hope he takes it well...
I told Muse the result of Carta's fortune-telling. What does it mean by the dark fog that surrounds Gail Muse was trying to act calm, but I could tell she's feeling nervous about Gail. Is Carta's stuff really worth believing

quests.name: The Blocked Path of the Ocean
quests.description:
I should be able to see Taeng the Explorer deep in the underwater... somewhere around The Grave of a Wrecked Ship.
I met Taeng the Explorer in between The Grave of a Wrecked Ship at an empty ship that's been wrecked. He said he's been looking for the traces of his missing men. He came down here to check out the irregular activities that have been taking place here, and one day he lost contact with his men. Not only did he lose them, but he said the path to the bottom of the ocean is blocked too, so he asked me for help on looking for traces of his men. I should wander around looking for items that can be used as evidence. If the items the men have used are still here, then maybe the sharks that have been roaming around The Grave of a Wrecked Ship is the one to blame... I should find a flashlight, a camera and a notebook, and give them back to Taeng the Explorer.
Taeng the Explorer, whom I've met at The Grave of a Wrecked Ship, asked me to find traces of his men that have disappeared. I was able to gather up the flashlight, the camera, and the notebook that his men used at the time of the attack. Unfortunately, I wasn't able to find any of the missing men.

Scroll for Cape for Weapon Def.
Scroll for Cape for Magic Def.

quests.description:
If I ever lost the Nependeath Juice, at least I know who to talk to... Elma.
I went to see Elma to get another glass of Nependeath Juice that I lost.
I got a new glass of Nependeath Juice from Elma.

quests.name: Kenta's Research 1
quests.description:
Kenta, the animal instructor at the Aquarium Zoo, has a quandary. I should go talk to him and see what's up.
Kenta, a veteran animal instructor at the Aquarium Zoo, seemed to be concerned over the fact that the animals at Aqua Road have been acting strangely since the storm that occurred not too long ago. I couldn't see the difference myself, but I'm sure the expert sees it differently. Kenta wanted to investigate this phenomenon, and asked me to gather up the DNA samples of the animals at Aqua Road.
I gave Kenta, the animal trainer at Aquarium, the DNA samples of some of the animals at Aquarium. If it's indeed true that some animals have started to act differently since the storm, then how is he going to prove it through research I'm anxious to find out...
quests.requirements: Cicle's DNA Sample x 1, Cico's DNA Sample x 1, Pin Boom's DNA Sample x 1
quests.rewards_items: 30x Magic Potion, 30x Sniper Potion, 30x Dexterity Potion, 30x Speed Potion, 30x Warrior Potion

quests.name: Kenta's Research 2
quests.description:
I wonder how Kenta, the animal instructor at Aquarium Zoo, is doing these days... I want to find out what he got out of his research. I better go see him.
I met up with Kenta, the animal instructor at Aquarium Zoo, again. He mentioned that he was on the verge of finding out what was wrong, but was missing something. He then asked me to gather up another set of DNA samples. Flower Fish's DNA Sample 4031262 / 1 Masked Fish's DNA Sample 4031263 / 1 Bubble Fish's DNA Sample 4031264 / 1
I helped Kenta, the animal instructor at Aquarium Zoo, out again. This time, I gathered up the DNA samples of the fishes at Aqua Road. Maybe this will lead to clear-cut results.
quests.requirements: Flower Fish's DNA Sample x 1, Masked Fish's DNA Sample x 1, Bubble Fish's DNA Sample x 1

quests.name: Kenta's Research 3
quests.description:
Has Kenta, the animal instructor at Aquarium Zoo, been getting the results he wanted I better go find out...
I met up with Kenta, the animal instructor at Aquarium Zoo, again. This time, he mentioned that the fishes near Aquarium have generally transformed more than others, and that he wanted to find out the conditions of the living organisms at the east coast and west coast. He wanted me to gather up another set of DNA samples for him. Pooper's DNA Sample 4031265 / 1 Sparker's DNA Sample 4031266 / 1 Freezer's DNA Sample 4031267 / 1
I helped Kenta, the animal instructor at Aquarium Zoo, out again. So the animals in Aqua Road have been slowly changing in a negative way without anyone noticing... why is that happening Can Kenta find out
quests.requirements: Sparker's DNA Sample x 1, Freezer's DNA Sample x 1, Pooper's DNA Sample x 1

quests.name: Kenta's Advice
quests.description:
I should go see Kenta, the animal instructor at Aquarium Zoo, with my pet.
Kenta, the animal instructor at Aquarium Zoo, mentioned that if the pet's loyalty increases, then the pet will start walking in the same pace as its master, and offered a chance to increase the loyalty level of my pet. He gave me a task of finding 5 pieces of paper hidden away somewhere in Aqua Road with my pet, and increase the closeness of my pet by at least 15. He even gave me a clue in that I should look into a box at the bottom of the ocean... okay, now off to find the papers! Piece of Paper A 4031274 / 1 Piece of Paper B 4031275 / 1 Piece of Paper C 4031276 / 1 Piece of Paper D 4031277 / 1 Piece of Paper E 4031278 / 1
I looked through the box at the very bottom of Aqua Road and wound up finding the 5 pieces of paper, with my pet accompanying my every move. Then I went back to Aquarium Zoo to see Kenta, and while going through the mission, the loyalty level had already been increased. My pet is now walking in the same pace as I am... wow...
quests.requirements: Piece of Paper A x 1, Piece of Paper B x 1, Piece of Paper C x 1, Piece of Paper D x 1, Piece of Paper E x 1

quests.name: Nanuke's Ingredients
quests.description:
Deep in the snow at the Snowy Whale Island, Nanuke found something he really wants to eat... I wonder what it is...
Deep in the snow at the Snowy Whale Island, Nanuke wanted to eat something that he'd never eaten before in his life. Apparently, his friend Muse, who lives at Aquarium, offered to make him a tasty new dish, so long as he gathers up the ingredients for her. The problem is... those ingredients are really difficult to gather up. I better go gather up 150 Ink Bottles and 80 Frozen Shark's Fins for Nanuke, so I can deliver them to Muse. Ink Bottle 4000183 / 150 Frozen Shark's Fin 4000181 / 80
Deep in the snow at the Snowy Whale Island, Nanuke wanted to eat something that he'd never eaten before in his life. He also said if I gather up 150 Ink Bottles and 80 Frozen Shark's Fins, then Muse will make a tasty meal for him... So I gathered up the ingredients and met up with Muse. Muse wanted me to wait while she makes the tasty dish for Nanuke, and asked to see her later.
quests.requirements: Frozen Shark's Fin x 80, Ink Bottle x 150

quests.name: Muse is Cooking
quests.description:
Is Muse done cooking
Muse made what seemed like a very tasty dish from the ingredients I got for her. I couldn't see the dish because it was inside a box, but judging from the tasty aroma that filled the room, I knew this was indeed a winner. Muse warned me that this was best eaten when hot, and wanted me to get this to Nanuke before it turned cold. Basically, I have 1 hour to deliver this to Nanuke. Can I do this
I delivered the food that Muse made to Nanuke on time. I had to really run to make it here in 1 hour. Phew, at least seeing Nanuke chow down on the dish made it all worthwhile.

quests.name: Spiruna's Prophecy
quests.description:
I heard that Spiruna, who resides at the Cloud Park of Orbis, made a disturbing prophecy. She may not have the best of personalities, but she's a prophet who correctly saw the future. What must it be that she saw...
I ran to the Cloud Park of Orbis just to hear the disturbing prophecy from Spiruna herself. She said nonchalantly that Orbis will crash to the ground soon. I asked her of the ways to save Orbis, only to hear her say it's all going to be in vain, and decided not to help me out. I can't let Orbis crash down like that! I better go talk to Spiruna again.
I went to see Spiruna again, but she sat down, motionless, as if she was meditating right then and there. Will Orbis crash and burn just like that But then, a girl standing next to Spiruna is looking at me as if she has something to say on this matter. Who must she be...

quests.name: Lightening Up Orbis
quests.description:
I ran into a mysterious girl at Spiruna's house. She mentioned that the reason Orbis is sinking is because there are too many monsters around at the Cloud Terrace these days. She requested that I take out 100 each of Jr. Cellion, Jr. Lioner, and Jr. Grupin. Jr. Cellion 30871# Jr. Lioner 30872# Jr. Grupin 30873#
Just the way the mysterious girl at Spiruna's house requested, I took out a 100 each of Jr. Cellion, Jr. Lioner, and Jr. Grupin. Doing this may have slowed down Orbis's inevitable crash, but that still means it'll crash later. By the way, who is this girl She must be aware of the danger that's befallen Orbis. I should talk to her again...
quests.requirements: Defeat Jr. Cellion x 100, Defeat Jr. Lioner x 100, Defeat Jr. Grupin x 100

Any Class: 5x Steel Ore (16.67%), 5x Bronze Ore (16.67%), 5x Mithril Ore (16.67%), 5x Orihalcon Ore (16.67%), 5x Adamantium Ore (16.67%), 5x Silver Ore (8.33%), 5x Gold Ore (8.33%)

quests.name: Pixies' Cloud Pieces
quests.description:
I talked to the mysterious girl at Spiruna's house again. She mentioned that Spiruna has finally found the main reason Orbis is sinking. Orbis floats in the air thanks to the mythical, magical power that's laden in the clouds, but the Pixie's have been soaking up that magical power from the clouds to their advantage. The Pixies use that power to increase their magical powers, and by doing so, the clouds have been weakened to the point of Orbis making its freefall. To start the fixing, she wanted me to gather up 30 Cloud Pieces from Star Pixie, Lunar Pixie, and Luster Pixie for her. Cloud Piece 4031309 / 30
Just the way the mysterious girl at Spiruna's house requested, I gathered up 30 Cloud Pieces from the Pixie's and gave them to her.

quests.name: The Sprayer Elma Borrowed 1
quests.description:
The key tool used to fix the Orbis clouds is the Cloud Sprayer, but ever since Elma the Housekeeper borrowed it some 50 years ago, the sprayer hasn't been seen since. 50 years, and still no return I better go see Elma the Housekeeper.
I met up with Elma and received the Cloud Sprayer that she borrowed 50 years ago. I should go back to Spiruna's house now.

quests.name: The Sprayer Elma Borrowed 2
quests.description:
I received Cloud Sprayer from Elma the Housekeeper. It looks like a significant amount of time has passed since I came here. I better get back to Spiruna's house immediately. Cloud Sprayer 4031308 / 1
I received the Cloud Sprayer from Elma the Housewife. The cloud fixing should be a breeze now with this in store. This better stop the freefall of Orbis.

quests.name: The Ocean View : Kriel's Offer
quests.description:
Kriel, a fairy that resides in Orbis, surely has never been underwater before, right I mean, she has wings that are good for navigating the friendly skies, and definitely not for navigating underwater. Anyway, I should go see Kriel the Fairy.
Kriel, a proud owner of a set of wings, was blowing off travelers that weren't fortunate enough to have them. I don't think she has a clue that there are numerous breathtaking places that just cannot be reached by flying. According to Lisa, Kriel's not to enthused with the fact that she can only hear about the rumors of Aqua Road and not being able to go there in person. Anyway, Lisa suggested that I buy Kriel "The Official Aqua Road Photo Album" from Muse. Muse, huh... Another trip underwater... Aquaroad Photo Album Aquaroad Photo Album 4031310 / 1
I gave Muse 100 snow crystals and purchased the Official Aqua Road Photo Album, then gave it to Kriel for the viewing. After seeing her admit how beautiful Aqua Road is, I must say I felt validated by it, but it also seems like she set the whole thing up for this from the get go. Oh well, at least Kriel's happy, and that's good enough for me.
quests.rewards_items:
Weighted random:
Any Class: Scroll for Shoes for Jump (25%), Scroll for Shoes for Jump (25%), Scroll for Shoes for Speed (25%), Scroll for Shoes for Speed (25%)

quests.name: Aqua Road Photo Album
quests.description:
I heard Muse of Aquarium sells Aquaroad Photo Album...
I met with Muse, the person who sells Aquaroad Photo Album. Unfortunately, she mentioned that the photo album is sold out. After relentlessly asking her questions about it, she relented and told me she'll give me the photo album that she kept for herself. In return, she wanted me to show her Snow Crystal Sphere, since she's never seen snow before in her life. Snow Crystal Sphere is made by Alcaster of El Nath.
After receiving the request from Muse to see the Snow Crystal Sphere, I headed off to El Nath to see Alcaster.

quests.name: Snow Crystal 1
quests.description:
Alcaster seems to be pretty busy. I better pay another visit.
Alcaster mentioned that, in order to make Snow Crystal Sphere, I'll have to bring 100 Snow Crystals to him. Snow Crystal can be found through the monster called Leatty, which lives in the Orbis Tower... Snow Crystal Snow Crystal 4031311/100
I got all 100 Snow Crystals and gave them to Alcaster. Alcaster promised me to make Snow Crystal Sphere soon, and wanted me to wait for a while.

quests.name: Snow Crystal 2
quests.description:
Is Snow Crystal Sphere made I better go see Alcaster and find out for myself.
I finally got Snow Crystal Sphere from Alcaster. I have a feeling Muse's going to LOVE seeing this. I better head back to Aquarium and see Muse.
I gave Muse the Snow Crystal Sphere, and in return, got myself the Official Aqua Road Photo Album. Now it's time for me to show this to Kriel in Orbis.

quests.name: The Lost Photo Album
quests.description:
I think I lost the Official Aqua Road Photo Album that Muse gave me. I better go see her again.
Muse said she can make another one for me, but this time, it'll cost me 10,000 mesos. 10,000 mesos Man, that's expensive...
I gave Muse 10,000 mesos for the Official Aqua Road Photo Album.

quests.name: Cleaning up Eos Tower
quests.description:
I should go see Marcel, who's in charge of the security for Eos Tower of Ludibrium.
Marcel of Ludibrium asked me if I could take care of huge, nasty ratz, 50 of them to be exact. Ratz 32001#
I took care of the Ratz just like the way Marcel of Ludibrium asked me to do, but I'm sure there are still quite a number of nasty monsters at Eos Tower.

quests.name: Cleaning Up the Inner Parts of Eos Tower
quests.description:
I should go see Marcel now...
Marcel asked me to take care of 50 Trixters and 50 Black Ratzs living in Eos Tower. Trixter 32011# Black Ratz 32012#
I took care of the 50 Trixters and 50 Black Ratzs, just the way Marcel wanted, but it seems like there's more outside...

quests.name: Cleaning Up the Outer Parts of Eos Tower
quests.description:
I should go see Marcel now...
Marcel asked me to take care of 30 Propellys and 30 Tweeters living on the outer parts of Eos Tower. Propelly 32021# Tweeter 32022#
I took care of the 30 Propellys and 30 Tweeters like Marcel asked, but I have a gut feeling that another set of powerful force is lurking around this tower.
quests.requirements: Defeat Propelly x 30, Defeat Tweeter x 30

quests.description:
I should go see Marcel at Ludibrium.
Marcel of Ludibrium asked me to take care of 25 Block Golems and 15 King Block Golems that seem prevalent around Eos Tower. King Block Golem 32031# Block Golem 32032#
I took care of the Block Golems and King Block Golems that Marcel of Ludibrium asked me to do.

quests.description:
I should go see Marcel, who should be in Ludibrium.
Marcel of Ludibrium asked for one last favor, this time, for me to take down the ultimate monster in Eos Tower, the leader of the monsters inside, Rombot. It is found every once in a while in the middle of Eos Tower, at a secret passage. Rombot 32041#
I took out the leader of all Block Golems, Rombot, just the way Marcel of Ludibrium asked me to do. Hopefully this will bring peace to Eos Tower.

quests.name: The Lost Guard
quests.description:
A lost guard is found somewhere around Eos Tower...
I found the lost guard at the 93rd floor of Eos Tower. He needs to get to 59th floor to go back to work, but is too scared to go with the monsters around, and wants me to gather up 30 worn-out goggles and 30 propellers. Propeller 4000103/30 Worn-Out Goggle 4000123/30
I ran back to the lost guard at the 93rd floor of Eos Tower and gave him the proof of eliminating the monsters in the vicinity of where we were. In return, I was able to get the Scroll of Eos Rock, which activates the Eos Rock located in a number of places at the Tower. By activating the rock, it'll enable us to teleport to the next Eos Rock. And since he needs to get down to 59th floor, I'm sure there's more mess to come...

quests.name: Nemi's Lunchbox Delivery
quests.description:
I should go see Nemi, who's in Ludibrium...
Nemi of Ludibrium gave me a lunchbox and asked me if I could make a special delivery to her dad, Manager Karl. Apparently, he forgot to bring his lunchbox to work today. She said her dad should be somewhere around the Toy Factory.
I met Manager Karl, who was at the toy factory, and gave him the lunchbox Nemi packed for him, but it looks like he wants to ask me for something...

quests.name: Nemi's First Ingredient
quests.description:
I should go see Nemi, who's in Ludibrium...
I met up with Nemi again at a small house in Ludibrium. She was preparing dinner for her dad, who should be home from work soon, and she wanted to make him a nice bowl of soup. She asked me if I could get her 10 slices of Savory Cheese by taking out the Ratz in Eos Tower. Savory Cheese 4031129/10
I got Nemi the 10 slices of Savory Cheese that she wanted. I wonder what kind of soup she's making for her dad...

quests.name: Nemi's Second Ingredient
quests.description:
I should go see Nemi, who's in Ludibrium...
I met up with Nemi again at a small house in Ludibrium. This time, she was preparing a lunchbox for her dad, and she wanted to get him some eggs for lunch. She asked me if I could get her 15 Small Eggs by taking out the Tweeters. They are a bunch of pink birds that should be flying around the outer wall of Eos Tower. Small Egg 4000116/15
I got Nemi the Small Eggs that she wanted. I wonder what kind of lunch she's making for her dad...

quests.name: Nemi's Dilemma
quests.description:
I should go see Nemi, who's in Ludibrium...
I met up with Nemi again at a small house in Ludibrium. Lately she had been experiencing some weird things where the food had been disappearing right after being made, and was suspecting that the rats might have done it. That's why there's a toy mouse called Ratz, which is a toy mouse with rat traps, but instead of catching rats, they became alive as monsters. At Nemi's request, I'll have to take out Ratz and collect 45 Rat traps, and give them back to her. Rat Trap 4000095/45
I collected all the rat traps that Nemi needed in Ludibrium. I can't believe the amount of rat traps she made, judging from the fact that every single Ratz in Eos Tower is her creation.

quests.description:
I should go see Manager Karl, who should be somewhere around the Toy Factory

quests.name: The Drumming Bunny
quests.description:
I should go see Roly-Poly Worker 5 at Eos Tower
I met up with Roly-Poly Worker 5 again at Eos Tower. He was complaining about the Drumming Bunnies that seem to be bothering him at the 60th floor, and requested that I collect 100 Toy Drums for him. If I get this for him, then there may be more work in store... Toy Drum 4000127/100
Just the way the Roly-Poly Worker 5 asked, I took out the drumming bunnies and collected the toy drums. He said his work got easier when I'm around, and he wants me to help him out on some other stuff. Maybe I should chill here and help these guys out for a change.

quests.name: Eliminating the Drumming Bunny
quests.description:
I should go see Roly-Poly Worker 5 at Eos Tower
I met up with Roly-Poly Worker 5 again at Eos Tower. He thanked me for helping him out last time, and mentioned that I should have heard it from General Maester, but we'll have to take away the force of darkness and put it back to the way it used to be. He requested that I eliminate the Drumming Bunnies at the 60th floor of Eos Tower and collect 1000 Toy Drums for him. Toy Drum 4000127/1000
Just the way the Roly-Poly Worker 5 asked, I took out the drumming bunnies and collected the toy drums. I think this really took out the wild bunnies as well as taking away the force of darkness. Here's hoping that those bunnies turn back to the old, adorable bunnies they used to be.

quests.description:
I should go check out Roly-Poly 6 at Eos Tower
I met up with Roly-Poly 6 at Eos Tower. He wanted me to find a tool that he lost right where a ton of monsters are. I have a feeling Bloctopus might have taken it...
I found the lost tool for Roly-Poly 6. I'm hoping this will allow him to fix things at Eos Tower now.

quests.name: Helping Fix Eos Tower
quests.description:
I should go check out Roly-Poly 8 at Eos Tower
I met up with Roly-Poly 8 again at Eos Tower. He seemed worried that there's a lot of places to fix at Eos Tower, only to have the monsters stop him from doing so. He asked if I could take out 30 King Bloctopuses and collect 25 Plastic Crowns in the process. I can do this... King Bloctopus 32241# Plastic Crown 4000100/25
I took out a bunch of King Bloctopuss and collected 4000100s just the way the Roly-Poly 8 of Eos Tower asked. How long is this maintenance job going to last anyway This should get done soon so I don't have to do them any more favors.

I met up with Roly-Poly 10 again at Eos Tower. He asked if I could get him 30 Yellow Toy Blocks and 15 Blue Toy Blocks to fix the tower. I think I can get those by taking out the Block Golems... Yellow Toy Block 4000101/30 Blue Toy Block 4000102/15
I gave Roly-Poly 10 the yellow blocks and blue blocks needed to fix this place up. A toy block used to fix a castle...where else can this happen but here in Ludibrium

quests.name: The Girl Who Lost Her Memory
quests.description:
I heard something happened to Korin of Ludibrium... I better go check up on her.
I met a girl named Korin at a small house nearby Ludibrium. Korin had been missing for 10 months, and she did not remember anything that occurred during that time. She wanted me to find these men wearing the black suit that visited her the other day, and ask him whatever happened to her the last 10 months. A man wearing black suit... I don't think he'd be at Ludibrium nor Eos Tower.
I met Korin, who was suffering from partial loss of memory, at Ludibrium. I was able to meet Agent Marco at the Omega Sector. He's the man wearing the black suit who held the clue regarding her lost memory.
quests.next_quest_name: The Man in the Black Suit

quests.name: The Man in the Black Suit
quests.description:
I met Agent Marco at the Omega Sector. I asked him some questions regarding Korin, and I was able to find out that she had been kidnapped by a group of aliens that invaded the Omega Sector. He also said that in order to recover Korin's lost memories, I'll have to defeat the Mateons and collect 5 Memory Pieces that contain her lost memories... I'll have to head over to the Boswell Field quickly. Piece of Memory 4031090/5
I defeated the aliens that took Korin's memories, gathered up the memory pieces, and gave them to Agent Marco. He then put the pieces together and made it into one whole piece.

quests.name: The Recovered Memory
quests.description:
After defeating a bunch of Mateons at the Boswell Field, I went through their stuff and found 5 Memory Pieces that contained Korin's lost memories. I gave them to Agent Marco, and he proceeded to put the 5 together into one whole piece of Korin's Memory. Now all I have left to do is give this piece of memory back to Korin.
I gave Korin her lost memories through the man in Omega Sector wearing black suits, Agent Marco. She was initially disoriented after recovering her memories, but she promised to fully enjoy life the way she used to before the kidnapping. Hopefully that'll never happen again.

quests.name: Toy Soldier's Walnut
quests.description:
I should go see Delv the Toy Soldier, who's at Eos Tower.
Delv the Toy Soldier, firmly protecting the gates of the 100th floor on Eos Tower, asked me for a favor by getting him 20 tasty walnuts as a way to fight the boredom of guarding the gate and doing little else. He said a black rat monster called Dirty Ratz might offer up the walnuts... Tasty Walnut 4031093/20
I got Delv the Toy Soldier, firmly protecting the gates of the 100th floor on Eos Tower, the 20 tasty walnuts he requested as a way to fight the boredom of guarding the gate and doing little else. He was very thankful and asked if I could go talk to his buddy Olson next to him if I have some free time to burn.
quests.rewards_items: Blue Sneakers, Silver Battle Grieves, Blue Magicshoes, Green Hunter Boots, Iron Chain Boots

quests.name: Dollhouse
quests.description:
I should go see Olson the Toy Soldier, who's at Eos Tower
I ran into Olson the Toy Soldier at the 100th floor on Eos Tower, doing his job as the security guard next to Delv. Olson told me a story of a monster sneaking in through the cracks of time and stealing a pendulum from the clocktower, culminating with the monster disguising itself as a dollhouse somewhere inside. I need to locate the one that's different from the sea of dollhouses in here.
Inside the secret room of Eos Tower, I located the monster disguised as a dollhouse, destroyed it, recovered the pendulum, and gave it to Mark the Toy Soldier. This should get the Ludibrium Clocktower to start working again.

quests.name: The Broken Clocktower
quests.description:
I should go see Olson the Toy Soldier, who's at Eos Tower
Olson the Toy Soldier from the 100th floor of Eos Tower wanted me to get the Pendulum obtained from the monster disguised as the dollhouse to Grandpa Clock at the Lost Time somewhere inside the Clocktower. Apparently the Grandpa Clock should be able to fix him.
I found Grandpa Clock standing around somewhere in the lost time, but he looks very lethargic, as if he's about to stop.
quests.parent: A Delivery to a Lost Time

quests.name: Grandpa Clock's Crisis
quests.description:
After obtaining the Pendulum by destroying the dollhouse the monster disguised as, I went down to the Lost Time to find Grandpa Clock. But it seemed like instead of him helping me fix the clocktower, he was about to die first, so he wanted me to take down some monsters called Tick-Tock and pick up the All-purpose Clock Spring that they possess. I better get them before Grandpa Clock dies.
I got the All-purpose Clock Spring from Tick Tock. I need to get this to the Grandpa Clock before it's too late.
quests.parent: A Delivery to a Lost Time

quests.name: Delivering the #t4031094#
quests.description:
At the Lost Time in the Ludibrium Clocktower, I gave Grandpa Clock the All-purpose Clock Spring from Tick-Tock's. I'm glad I got to give this to him before too late. Now I should wait to hear a word from Olson.
At the Lost Time in the Ludibrium Clocktower, I gave Grandpa Clock the Pendulum, an essential part of the clocktower. Now all I have to do is wait for the Grandpa Clock to fix the clocktower. Will this work
