quests.name: The Clocktower Headache
quests.description:
I should check on Grandpa Clock, who is working hard at the Lost Time.
Deep in the Lost Time of Ludibrium, I met up with Grandpa Clock. He seemed to be annoyed by the fact that the tiny Ticks have been going inside the clocktower and destroy parts of it, making his job much harder than it should have been. For the sake of Grandpa Clock, I'll need to take out 100 Ticks. Tick 32341#
I took care of the request Grandpa Clock made, by taking out the Ticks. The Ticks were another one of the reasons the clocktower seemed to have something wrong at all times, so this should give Grandpa Clock a good night's sleep.

quests.name: The Clock Workers' Batteries
quests.description:
I should check on Grandpa Clock, who is working hard at the Lost Time.
I met up with Grandpa Clock deep inside the abandoned time of Ludibrium. Grandpa Clock admitted since he's an old fella, the spring was needed to rewind himself back to life, but the younger clock workers these days are all battery-operated, only to have some of them not have adequate batteries and thus not working the way it should be. I should collect 200 cheap batteries for the sake of those clocks in need of them. Cheap Battery 4000111/200
I got the cheap batteries needed for the new battery-operated worker clocks. Grandpa Clock seemed ecstatic over the prospect of those workers finally showing life and lessening his work burden in the process. Anyway, what exactly are they doing in there...
quests.rewards_items: Orange Sporty T-Shirt, Purple Shadow, Pink Starry Shirt, Maroon Jangoon Armor, Brown Jangoon Armor, Red Starlight, Red Moonlight, Brown Piette, White Piettra, Marine Shadow

quests.name: Assembling a Toy
quests.description:
I should go see Hans the Assembler at Toy Factory.
I ran into Hans, the toy assembler at the Toy Factory in Ludibrium. He made a proposal where if I get him some parts for a toy, then he'll assemble it and make something fun out of it. This is sweet! The things I'll need are 20 cheap batteries from the Robo, 20 metal hearts of Master Robo, and 30 cogs of Chronos. Cheap Battery 4000111/20 Mechanical Heart 4000112/20 Cog 4000115/30
At the toy factory in Ludibrium, I gave Hans the parts needed to assemble a toy. Hans put together the parts and made a very unique sack out of it. He said he put some toys inside, but... I don't know, something may pop up that'll scare the daylight out of me. I better be careful with it...
quests.requirements: Cheap Battery x 20, Mechanical Heart x 20, Cog x 30

quests.name: Rocky's Parts
quests.description:
I better go talk to Rocky the Repairman
I met up with Rocky the Repairman at the Toy Factory in Ludibrium Clocktower. Rocky seemed to be swamped with work due to a sudden increase in monsters destroying parts here and there. He was worried about running out of essential parts, so he asked me if I could gather up 50 cogs and 30 screws. . Screw 4003000/30 Cog 4000115/50
At the Toy Factory in Ludibrium, I gave Rocky the cogs and screws needed for him to fix anything that is broken. Hopefully that was enough to undo the damages done by those pesky monsters.

quests.name: Mac the Mechanic's Maintenance Manual
quests.description:
I'll need to have a word with Mac the Mechanic.
I met up with Mac the Mechanic at the Toy Factory in Ludibrium. Mac was panicking because of the fact that all the blueprints and Maintenance Manual of the factory were stolen by Toy Trojan. If I destroy the boxes around the Toy Factory, I may find a hidden path that'll lead me to a clue.
I found the documents Mac the Mechanic lost, and he seemed very much relieved by it. Something's strange, though. Why would the toy soldiers feel the need to steal this in the first place...

quests.name: The Missing Mechanical Parts
quests.description:
I better go see Cheng the Assistant, who should be somewhere around Toy Factory
At the Toy Factory in Ludibrium, I found Cheng the Assistant riding around on a white wooden horse. Chang was concerned about the sudden disappearance of the mechanic parts all over the factory, and wanted me to find those parts for him. I should head over to Toy Factory <Main Construction1> Part 4 with help from Cheng, where the parts are hidden. I need to gather up 10 Mechanical Parts and bring them back to Cheng.
I found the 10 missing parts in the Toy Factory and gave them back to Cheng the Assisntant. Hopefully this will help the Factory run as smoothly as it should be.

quests.name: Scroll of Life
quests.description:
Somewhere around Ludibrium, I saw a small fairy that was glowing all over her body. Her name was Wisp, and is a part of Mar the Fairy. She saw my pet in a state of doll and claimed that she can turn my doll pet back into a real-life pet with water of life and mcdonald's. The Scroll of Life is apparently at Cloy's House in Ludibrium, which should be empty at this point.
I found the scroll of life at Cloy's house in Ludibrium. I gave this, along with the Water of Life, to Wisp and he helped turn my pet back alive. I need to have some play time with my pet now!

quests.name: Cleaning Up Helios Tower
quests.description:
Helios Tower opened recently for public, and apparently Marcel has been going through some trouble thanks to the growing number of Retzs at the tower.
Marcel, the security guard of Ludibrium, approached me and asked for a favor. He was concerned about the growing number of Retz at the Helios Tower, which has recently opened for travelers. According to him, the Retzs have been blocking the travelers' path, as well as destroying the elevators in the tower, and he wanted me to eliminate some Retzs for him. Retz 32411#
With a request from Marcel, the security guard of Ludibrium, I went into Helios Tower and eliminated 20 Retzs, the striped rats that have been destroying the elevators at the tower.

quests.name: Chief Stan's Letter
quests.description:
Chief Stan wants to ask me for something... I wonder what it is...
I met with Chief Stan, who was at Henesys in Victoria Island. He handed me what appeared to be an old, sealed letter, and wanted me to deliver it to Dr. Kim of Omega Sector. He said to get to Omega Sector, I'll need to first get on board on a ship ride from Ellinia to Orbis, followed by the ride to Ludibrium from there.
I met Dr. Kim at Omega Sector, and handed him the sealed letter that Chief Stan gave me. This place seems to be full of facilities designed in anticipation of the alien invasion... I should talk to Dr. Kim whenever I have a chance...

quests.name: Dr. Kim's Comments : Blueprint for New Robot
quests.description:
Dr. Kim of Omega Sector has apparently come up with something incredible...
Dr. Kim of Omega Sector gave me the Blueprint Machine for the new robot that's currently in development, and he requested that I show this to Chury, Hoony, and Gunny. I should meet up with Chury first; he's at the Omega Sector Silo.
Dr. Kim gave me a mission to show Chury the blueprint of the new robot that he's currently making, and I did just that. Chury seemed impressed by it.
quests.next_quest_name: Dr. Kim's Comments : A Meeting with Chury

quests.name: Dr. Kim's Comments : A Meeting with Chury
quests.description:
I met Chury at the Silo of the Omega Sector and showed him the Blueprint Machine, which contains the blueprint of the new robot, that I got from Dr. Kim. Chury wanted to show this to Hoony, so he asked me if I could show the Blueprint Machine to Hoony, as well as provide him with 20 Space Foods, for he had been away at the Field for a while. Space Food, huh... I think I can find them through Barnard Gray the alien. I'll run into on the way to the Field. Space Food 4000117/20
I met up with Chury somewhere around the Omega Sector Silo. Chury wanted me to show the Blueprint Machine to Hoony, as well as give him some food. In turn, I gave Hoony some Space Food to last him a while, and showed him the Blueprint Machine.
quests.next_quest_name: Dr. Kim's Comments : A Meeting with Hoony

quests.name: Dr. Kim's Comments : A Meeting with Hoony
quests.description:
I met Hoony at a Field around Omega Sector, and showed him the Blueprint Machine, as well as provide him with 20 Space Foods. Hoony said that he fixed Gunny's Laser Gun that he was asked to fix and requested me if I could give him his Laser Gun as well as show him the Blueprint Machine. He should be somewhere around the Field. Where could he be...
Hoony wanted to show the Blueprint to Gunny. He was already on his way to give Gunny a new weapon, so he asked me if I could give him the new gun, as well as show him the Blueprint. After much searching around, I was able to finally find him and gave him the gun.
quests.next_quest_name: Dr. Kim's Comments : A Meeting with Gunny

quests.name: Dr. Kim's Comments : A Meeting with Gunny
quests.description:
I met up with Gunny at a field around Omega Sector, handed him his Laser gun, and showed him the Blueprint Machine. Gunny appreciated my effort and requested that I report this all to Dr. Kim. This Command Center warp capsule seems like a useful item.
As Dr. Kim requested from the Command Center in the Omega Sector, I showed the blueprint of the new robot to Chury, Hoony, and Gunny, while simultaneously solving their problems. Dr. Kim was very pleased with the results, and wanted me to drop by again sometime, for he could use my help.

quests.name: An Important Robotic Part
quests.description:
I should go see Dr. Kim at the Command Center in the Omega Sector.
From the Command Center in the Omega Sector, Dr. Kim requested that I receive 3 important mechanical parts from Cheng the Assistant at the Toy Factory of Ludibrium. Man ... when am I going to find time to go all the way up to Ludibrium
Dr. Kim of the Command Center in the Omega Sector gave me a mission to receive some stuff from Cheng the Assistant of the Toy Factory. The parts I received seem to be very important for something.

quests.name: Delivering the Robotic Parts
quests.description:
I met with Cheng the Assistant at the Toy Factory in Ludibrium, and he handed me 3 boxes full of robotic parts, which will be used to make the robot. Now I should just hand them over to Dr. Kim at the Command Center in the Omega Sector.
At the Toy Factory in Ludibrium, Cheng the Assistant gave me 3 boxes of robotic parts so I could deliver them to Dr. Kim of the Command Center in the Omega Sector. After delivering the goods to Dr. Kim, he gave me a Warp Capsule, which will enable me to transport to Ludibrium in an instant. Hmmm... this looks like something I can use!
quests.requirements: Box of Parts #1 x 1, Box of Parts #2 x 1, Box of Parts #3 x 1

quests.name: Retrieving the Robotic Parts
quests.description:
I should go see Dr. Kim at the Command Center in the Omega Sector.
I met with Dr. Kim again at the Command Center. Dr. Kim was furious over the fact that someone stole 3 boxes full of robotic parts. He requested that I check into the hidden place at the Boswell Field, break all the Alien boxes, and recover the 3 missing boxes. Parts #1 4031141/1 Parts #2 4031142/1 Parts #3 4031143/1
I retrieved the 3 boxes full of robotic parts that were stolen by the Aliens, and gave them back to Dr. Kim at the Command Center. This should speed up the development of the new robot.
quests.requirements: Parts #1 x 1, Parts #2 x 1, Parts #3 x 1
quests.rewards_items: 3x Command Center Warp Capsule, 3x Ludibrium Warp Capsule

quests.name: Eliminating Aliens
quests.description:
I should go see Dr. Kim at the Command Center in the Omega Sector.
Dr. Kim of the Command Center notified me that a powerful new Alien has appeared somewhere around the Boswell Field, and wanted me to eliminate it for them. He said he had to ask me for help since the new robot isn't ready just yet... I need to head over to the hidden place at the Boswell Field and defeat at least 5 MT-09's. MT-09 34081#
I managed to eliminate all 5 MT-09's that Dr. Kim of the Command Center requested. I really hope that the new robot is made soon, so I don't have to ever do this again.

quests.name: Where is Dogon's HQ?
quests.description:
I should go see Chury of Omega Sector.
I met with Chury at the Silo of the Omega Sector again, and he requested that I find a secret base of an apparent alien-worshipper. I'll need to find Dogon's HQ, which is hidden somewhere around the Fields nearby Omega Sector, find Dogon's Report from the box at the Dogon's HQ, and give them to Chury.
I gave Chury, who was waiting for me at the Silo of the Omega Sector, the Dogon's Report that I found from Dogon's secret base. I can't believe someone is actually helping aliens... now THAT's quite shocking.

quests.name: Hoony's Toothache
quests.description:
I should go see Hoony of Omega Sector.
I met with Hoony again at a field around Omega Sector. Hoony seemed to have an affinity for sweets, and it did not do his teeth any good. Now, he needed Pain Reliever to relieve the excruciating pain on his teeth. My job now is to get the Pain Releiver from the Omega Sector, and give it to Hoony.
I purchased the Pain Reliever from Dr. Pepper at the Omega Sector Silo, and gave it to Hoony, who was at a field around Omega Sector. Seriously, enough with the sweets!

rewards.name: Scroll for Pet Equip. for Speed

quests.rewards_items: 3x Scroll for Pet Equip. for Speed

quests.name: Chief Gray's Sign
quests.description:
I should go see Gunny of Omega Sector.
I met up with Gunny again at a field around Omega Sector. Lately Gunny has been on a mission to trace Chief Gray's every move, but due to the fact that he gets lost easily, he had been having trouble locating it. I'll need to defeat Chief Gray's for Gunny and collect 5 signs that they wear with them, so I can give them to Gunny. Chief Gray's Sign 4000125/5
I collected Chief Gray's signs and gave them to Gunny, who's at a field around Omega Sector. With this sign, Gunny may be able to have an easier time tracing Chief Gray.

quests.name: Eliminating Grays
quests.description:
I better go see Black Mesoranger, who should be somewhere around Kulan Field.
At a field around Omega Sector, I met this strangely-dressed man who called himself Black Mesoranger. He requested that I eliminate the alien that's been taking over Kulan Field, the Barnard Gray, 30 of them to be exact. Barnard Gray 34121#
I successfully completed the mission from Black Mesoranger by defeating the Barnard Grays. It seems, however, that there will be much more dangerous aliens monsters around Kulan Field

quests.name: Eliminating Chief Gray
quests.description:
I better go see Black Mesoranger, who should be somewhere around Kulan Field.
I met with Black Mesoranger again at a field around Omega Sector. She wanted me to take out Chief Grays, considered as a high rank among the Grays, as well as collect 3 of their notes from them. Chief Grays are very rare among all Grays and they are few and far between. How am I going to find them Note 4031102/3
I took 3 notes from the Chief Grays and gave them to Black Mesoranger, who was at a field around Omega Sector. Apparently, these notes contain the history of the Grays... hopefully these notes can be deciphered soon!

quests.name: The History of Zeta Leticulan
quests.description:
I better go see Black Mesoranger, who should be somewhere around Kulan Field.
I met Black Mesoranger again at a field around Omega Sector. She said the notes have been deciphered, and they revealed that the original planet in which the Grays lived in has been affected with lethal contaminants. Ever since then, they've been looking for a new place to live in, and the Earth turned out to be an ideal place for them. She said that she needed to see which lethal containments aliens couldn't stand that currently infest their original planet, and requested that I extract the skin cells of Barnard Gray, Zeta Gray, Ultra Gray, and Chief Gray. Barnard Gray's Cell 4031103/1 Zeta Gray's Cell 4031104/1 Ultra Gray's Cell 4031105/1 Chief Gray's Cell 4031106/1
I extracted the cells of Barnard Gray, Zeta Gray, Ultra Gray, and Chief Gray, and handed them to Black Mesoranger, who was at a field around Omega Sector. If the pollutants are poisonous enough for them to leave the planet for good, then our planet may not be safe for much longer...

quests.name: The Alarm Clock
quests.description:
I should go see Pink Mesoranger, who's somewhere around the Boswell Field...
I met up with Pink Mesoranger at the Boswell Field near Omega Sector, and she looked very concerned over her never-ending habit of oversleeping. She asked if I could get her 20 Table Clocks that are dropped from monster Tick-Tock. I better start heading down to the bottom of the Ludibrium Clocktower. Table Clock 4000114/20
I gathered up Table Clocks for Pink Mesoranger, who was stationed somewhere around Omega Sector, so she can overcome her chronic oversleeping. But then again, she always had trouble waking up, so I may have to find something more powerful for her...

quests.name: Assembling the Alarm Clock
quests.description:
I should go see Pink Mesoranger, who should be around Boswell Field.
I met Pink Mesoranger again at a field around Omega Sector. I was expecting her to tell me that she's been waking up on time, only to find out that all of her clocks have been destroyed. She said she needed a special alarm clock, and to make it will require 2 Special Batteries, 10 Cogs, and 10 Table Clocks. To obtain the special batteries, I'll have to defeat Master Robo at the Ludibrium Clocktower. Special Battery 4031115/2 Table Clock 4000114/10 Cog 4000115/10
To make a special alarm clock for Pink Mesoranger, stationed at a field around Omega Sector, I gathered up a bunch of Special Batteries, Cogs, and Table Clocks as materials. I sure hope this clock does not break on her.
quests.requirements: Special Battery x 2, Table Clock x 10, Cog x 10

quests.name: A Sleeping Monster
quests.description:
I should go see Pink Mesoranger, who's somewhere around Boswell Field.
I ran into Pink Mesoranger again at Boswell Field, near the Omega Sector. She said that the items I gathered up for her last time has been sent to Kevin the Soldier of Omega Sector, and that he should be ready with the Super Alarm Clock. My task is to get it from him for her. I hope she'll be able to wake up on time with this baby.
I received a request from Pink Mesoranger to receive the Alarm Clock from Kevin the Soldier for her. The clock looks very well-made.
quests.next_quest_name: The Completion of the Alarm Clock

quests.name: The Completion of the Alarm Clock
quests.description:
I received the Super Alarm Clock from Kevin the Soldier, who was at the Omega Sector, for Pink Mesoranger. Now all I have to do is deliver this to her.
Kevin the Soldier made the super alarm clock for Pink Mesoranger, stationed at a field around Omega Sector, and I delivered it to her. Hopefully this will enable her to wake up on time.
quests.rewards_items: 3x Command Center Warp Capsule, 3x Ludibrium Warp Capsule

quests.name: Trading with Alien Gray
quests.description:
I better go take a look at Alien Gray, who's somewhere around Kulan Field.
I ran into Alien Gray at Kulan Field around Omega Sector. He claimed that it's the Omega Sector, not them, that's been the bad one, and it asked me to help it invade the Sector by getting a number of materials from the Omega Sector Silo. I really don't feel good about helping it, but... oh well... I'll need to enter the Omega Sector Silo and bring out 3 Secret Documents. Secret Document 4031116/3
I got the 3 secret documents out of the Silo and handed them to Alien Gray, which was at Kulan Field of Omega Sector. I was richly rewarded for my effort, but I can't believe I fell for Gray's lies... I better hope the Omega Sector does not find out about the fact that I actually helped out the aliens...

quests.name: The Effort to Make-up
quests.description:
I better go see Yellow Mesoranger at the Safety Zone.
I met with Yellow Mesoranger at a field around Omega Sector. She alerted me that she's aware of the fact that I helped out Alien Gray, and that if I am to dispel the notion that I'm on the alien's side, I'll have to make an effort to make-up for my blunders. In order to regain their trust, I'll have to eliminate the aliens. Ultra Gray 34201#
I may have helped out Alien Gray in a moment of chaos, but after successfully completing the mission Yellow Mesoranger gave me, I think I regained some of her trust. It just seems like the aliens do not want to peacefully coexist with us.

quests.name: Collecting Meteorite Samples
quests.description:
I better go see Yellow Mesoranger at the Safety Zone.
I met up with Yellow Mesoranger again at a field around Omega Sector. Displaying her faith in me, she requested that I pick up 6 Meteorite Samples that's been scattered all over Kulan Field for further investigation. If I take care of this mission, I'll probably gain some more of her trust... Meteorite Sample 4031117/6
I gathered up the meteorite samples from the Kulan Field and gave them to Yellow Mesoranger, who was at a field around Omega Sector. Hopefully this will jumpstart the studies.

quests.name: Fuel for MT-09
quests.description:
I should go see Kay the engineer at the Omega Sector.
I met an engineer named Kay at the Omega Sector Silo. She said she'd been looking for an assistant, and asked if I could help her out. For my first task, since she's trying to develop a new machine that recycles MT-09's fuel, she wanted me to collect 5 MT-09's Fuels. MT-09's Fuel 4000126/5
I went around and collected the fuel for MT-09. This was for Kay the Engineer, who was at the Silo of the Omega Sector. I wonder what kind of a machine Kay will make with the fuel...

quests.name: The New Control Program
quests.description:
I should go see Kay the engineer at the Omega Sector.
I met Kay the Engineer again at the Silo of the Omega Sector. She first wanted to make sure that I didn't forget that I volunteered to be her assistant. Then, she said she needed a number of memory cards that contain Rombot Control Program, and asked me to collect 3 Rombot's Memory Cards, which can be found through Rombot the monster at the Eos Tower. Then, I'll have to pay a visit to Porter at the Command Center in the Omega Sector and have him decipher the memory cards, and then hand her the 3 Deciphered Memory Cards to her.
I defeated the Rombots that have been hidden in Eos Tower and got a hold of the Rombot's Memory Cards. I then handed them to Porter to decipher the code.

quests.name: Porter the Undependable
quests.description:
I need 3 of Rombot's Memory Cards so Porter of Omega Sector can decipher them.
Porter made a colossal mistake and destroyed one of Rombot's Memory Cards. I can't believe I just trusted this man to do this job!

quests.name: Porter's Mistake
quests.description:
I met Porter at the Command Center in the Omega Sector and gave him Rombot's 3 memory cards, but oh my... he was unable to decipher one of the three, and destroyed it. I'll need to find another one of Rombot's Memory Card for Porter.
I watched over Porter's deciphering with an uneasy feeling, but thankfully he didn't make any mistake this time around.

quests.name: The Brilliant Assistant
quests.description:
Once again, I gave Porter Rombot's Memory Cards. Fortunately, the deciphering worked this time around, and I was able to get a hold of 3 Deciphered Memory Cards for Kay. Now all I have to do is give them to her.
I gave Kay, who's at the Silo of Omega Sector, the Deciphered Memory Cards that she requested. I'm anxious to see what she makes out of them.

quests.name: Porter's Secret Letter
quests.description:
I should go see Porter of the Omega Sector.
Porter, who's at the Command Center in the Omega Sector, requested that I deliver a letter to Kay the Engineer at the Omega Sector Silo. This letter has to be delivered on time, so I'll have to hurry up and give it to her. I wonder what's written in this though... maybe it's a love letter. Hahaha.
I gave Kay the Engineer, who was at the Omega Sector Silo, the letter from Porter. Unfortunately, it doesn't look like a love letter. It's about a disappeared Dropship

quests.name: Where is the Dropship?
quests.description:
I was able to hand Porter's letter from the Command Center in the Omega Sector to Kay the Engineer, who was at the Omega Sector Silo, on time. I was expecting it to be a love letter, to no avail. Instead, it was about the missing dropship, and its current location. That's boring... anyway, Kay requested that I find the Dropship, which should be somewhere around Boswell Field, and check out the pilot's livelihood.
I found an empty dropship at the Boswell Field, and it appeared to have mislanded here. The pilot is nowhere to be found; a letter was found instead.

quests.name: The Pilot's Whereabouts...
quests.description:
I found what appeared to be a broken Dropship around Boswell Field, but the pilot is nowhere to be found, and instead, I was able to find a letter inside. I better give that letter to Kay.
I found a letter inside the broken Dropship, and gave it to Kay the Engineer at the Omega Sector Silo. With a sad look on her eyes, Kay said she was glad to find out the pilot was at least alive. Now, where would that pilot be...

quests.name: Collecting 100 Mateon Tentacles
quests.description:
I should go see Rice the Medic at the Omega Sector.
I met Rice the Medic at the Omega Sector, and he asked for my help to gather up some items to make various kinds of medicine. He said he needed 100 Mateon Tentacles, which can be obtained by taking out the aliens. It's quite amusing to think that the alien tentacles can be used as an ingredient to make medicines. Rice really wanted me to keep it a secret, since this was something even the famous Dr. Pepper was unaware of, and he's thinking of making a patent out of it. Well, time to collect some tentacles! Mateon's Tentacle 4000120/100
Rice the Medic of Omega Sector requested the 100 Mateon Tentacles, and I gathered up all of them. Will the research start now I wonder what kind of the antidote this will produce. I should go see Rice right about the time when the tentacles run out.

quests.name: Collecting 200 Mateon Tentacles
quests.description:
I should go see Rice the Medic at the Omega Sector.
Rice said the research has gone well, but realized it required much more materials than the ones I got for him, so I'll have to give him 200 Mateon Tentacles. Mateon's Tentacle 4000120/200
Rice the Medic of Omega Sector requested the 200 Mateon Tentacles, and I gathered up all of them. Will this prove to be a turning point on the research I should go see Rice right about the time when the tentacles run out.

quests.name: Collecting 300 Mateon Tentacles
quests.description:
I should go see Rice the Medic at the Omega Sector.
Rice said the research has gone well, but realized it required much more materials than the ones I got for him, so I'll have to give him 300 Mateon Tentacles. Mateon's Tentacle 4000120/300
Rice the Medic of Omega Sector requested the 300 Mateon Tentacles, and I gathered up all of them. Will this prove to be a turning point on the research I should go see Rice right about the time when the tentacles run out.

quests.name: Collecting 400 Mateon Tentacles
quests.description:
I should go see Rice the Medic at the Omega Sector.
Rice said the research has gone well, but realized it required much more materials than the ones I got for him, so I'll have to give him 400 Mateon Tentacles. Mateon's Tentacle 4000120/400
Rice the Medic of Omega Sector requested the 400 Mateon Tentacles, and I gathered up all of them. Will this prove to be a turning point on the research I should go see Rice right about the time when the tentacles run out.

quests.name: Collecting 500 Mateon Tentacles
quests.description:
I should go see Rice the Medic at the Omega Sector.
Rice said the research has gone well, but realized it required much more materials than the ones I got for him, so I'll have to give him 500 Mateon Tentacles. Mateon's Tentacle 4000120/500
I gathered up enough Mateon Tentacles for Rice the Medic at the Omega Sector to make the new antidote. Was that the reason It looks like Rice created the medicine that even the great Dr. Pepper couldn't make. Once he gets the patent on it and mass-produce it, he may be sitting on a huge pile of cash. Will he share a little bit of that with me~
quests.rewards_items: Blue Sneakers, Maroon Jangoon Shoes, Gold Moon Shoes, Yellow Pierre Shoes, Black Blue-Lines Shoes

quests.name: Eliminating Mateon
quests.description:
I better go see Green Mesoranger, who should be somewhere around Boswell Field.
I met Green Mesoranger at Boswell Field around Omega Sector. Green Mesoranger said he heard a lot about me through other Mesorangers, and asked if I wanted to tackle a Mesoranger mission. First I decided to help Green Mesoranger by helping his mission to eliminate 100 Mateons. Mateon 34351#
I took out 100 Mateons, just the way Green Mesoranger from Boswell Field asked. The duties of the Mesorangers don't seem to be over, though, so if I have some time to spare, then I maybe I should go check Green Mesoranger then.

quests.name: Eliminating Plateon
quests.description:
I better go see Green Mesoranger, who should be somewhere around Boswell Field.
I met up with Green Meoranger again at the Boswell Field of Omega Sector. This time, Green Mesoranger said that the Plateons, which are far more dangerous than the Mateons, are threatening the Omega Sector and that I'll have to take care of them, while bringing 100 Plateon's Helmets as evidence. Plateon's Helmet 4000121/100
I took out the Plateons and collected 100 Plateon Helmets, just the way Green Mesoranger from Boswell Field asked. The duties of the Mesorangers don't seem to be over, though, so if I have some time to spare, then I maybe I should go check Green Mesoranger then.

quests.name: Eliminating Plateon and Mecateon
quests.description:
I better go see Green Mesoranger, who should be somewhere around Boswell Field.
I met up with Green Meoranger again at the Boswell Field of Omega Sector. As a last task, Green Mesoranger asked me to eliminate the Plateons again, and collect Mecateon's weapons, which are very high-quality. I need to take out 200 Plateons and collect 150 Mecateon's Laser Guns for him. Plateon 34371# Mecateon's Laser Gun 4000122/150
Just the way the mission stated by Green Mesoranger of Boswell Field, I took out the Plateons and collected Mecateon's laser guns. Green Mesoranger seemed genuinely surprised by the fact that I took care of all the missions, and told me it'd be a pleasure to work with me again. Now, THAT felt good!
quests.requirements: Defeat Plateon x 200, Mecateon's Laser Gun x 150
quests.rewards_items: Work Gloves, Adamantium Knuckle, Blue Arten, Gold Brace, Gold Cleave

quests.name: The Ore of Dark Crystal
quests.description:
I should go visit General Maestro at the Omega Sector..
I met General Maestro, who's in command of a humongous army at the Omega Sector. The general said we'll be able to obtain the powerless, lightless Dull Crystal that have been used up at the Eos Tower from Drum Bunnies. While most would dismiss the item as nothing more than a useless crystal, the general believed it had something important hidden in it, and that he requested me to gather up 20 Dull crystals at the Eos Tower. I'll need to get those crystals from the Drum Bunnies at the tower. Dull Crystal 4031135/20
Just like the way General Mastro instructed, I went to Eos Tower, took out took out the Drum Bunnies, and gathered up 20 Dull crystals for him. While looking at the crystal, he mentioned that there must be something inside these crystals to turn these previously-adorable Drum Bunnies to something of a menace. I wonder exactly what's inside it.

quests.name: Where's the Power of Origin?
quests.description:
I should go visit General Maestro at the Omega Sector..
I met General Maestro, who's in command of a humongous army at the Omega Sector. The general said after investigating the dull crystals from the Drum Bunnies, he realized that the aliens may have a clue about this, and instructed me to find Alien Gray. There may be an item around Alien Gray that may provide clues for this. Of course, it won't just cough up the item, so I may have to look around the area where it's at. Gray's Document 4031136/1
Just like the way General Mastro instructed, I found a hidden document that appeared to have been purposely hidden Alien Gray. The general said, after putting the document through Alien Language Translator, it said a Dark Cryastal Ore with its dark force will turn a harmless doll into a monster. He wanted all the crystals gone before it gets too late.

quests.name: Terminating the Dark Force.
quests.description:
I should go visit General Maestro at the Omega Sector..
I met General Maestro, who's in command of a humongous army at the Omega Sector, again. The general said although a perfect solution hasn't been presented yet, there's something for me to do. He wanted me to bring back 30 Dull Crystals and 10 Dark Crystal Ores from the Drum Bunnies at the Eos Tower. Dull Crystal 4031140/30 Dark Crystal Ore 4004004/10
Just like the way General Mastro instructed, I gathered up the Dull Crystals and Dark Crystal Ores from the Drum Bunnies. Hopefully this'll stop the bunnies for a while, but this ain't over. I wonder when peace will actually settle on the Eos Tower.

quests.name: Help Kevin the Soldier's Vacation Plans
quests.description:
I heard Kevin the Soldier has something related with VIP ticket to Florina Beach at Omega Sector.
Kevin the Soldier was drafted into the army, but was never thrown in combat, and instead, is relegated to security duties at the Omega Sector. Feeling bored from all the security work, Kevin decided to earn some brownie-points for vacation by hunting down Mateons, and enlisted for my help. Mateon's Tentacle 04000120/30 Ripped Travel Ticket 1 04031206/1
What can I do with a Ripped Travel Ticket I better check on Nana the Tour Guide first, just the way the ticket said.
quests.requirements: Mateon's Tentacle x 30, Ripped Travel Ticket 1 x 1
quests.rewards_items: Ripped Travel Ticket 2, Ripped Travel Ticket 1

quests.name: A Chat with Nana the Tour Guide
quests.description:
Nana said a Ripped VIP pass will not work, nor can it be re-published, but the way to leave may be easier by paying a visit to Shuri, the the Tour Guide at Orbis.
Hmmm ... so something as simple as making a new ticket cannot be done, huh. Alright, since I'm here and all, why don't I just take a crack at it til the very end

quests.name: Recovering VIP Ticket to Florina Beach
quests.description:
I visited Shuri, and she mentioned that the VIP ticket cannot be re-issued, but it can be recovered. To recover the ripped VIP ticket, I'll need a few items... Star Pixie's Starpiece 04000059/50 Lunar Pixie's Moonpiece 04000060/30 Diamond 04021007/3
After recovering the ripped VIP Ticket to Florina Beach, I was given the VIP Ticket to Florina Beach, a lifetime pass, as a sign of thanks.nNow it's a matter of taking a vacation whenever I want.
quests.requirements: Ripped Travel Ticket 1 x 1, Diamond x 3, Ripped Travel Ticket 2 x 1, Star Pixie's Starpiece x 50, Lunar Pixie's Moonpiece x 30

quests.name: The Binding
quests.description:
The number of ghosts have increased dramatically, that it got to the point of Ghosthunter Bob being sent to Ludibrium to do something about it. I should go see him.
I was able to meet Ghosthunter Bob past the Path of Time of Ludibrium. He wanted me to eliminate the bindings of Master Death Teddy, and collect the bindings for him. Binding Bridle 4000148/20
I helped Ghosthunter Bob, who was hastily sent to Ludibrium, eliminate the bindings that enclosed Master Death Teddy.

quests.name: Free Spirit
quests.description:
The number of ghosts have increased dramatically, that it got to the point of Ghosthunter Bob being sent to Ludibrium to do something about it. I should go see him.
I was able to meet Ghosthunter Bob past the Path of Time of Ludibrium. He wanted me to free Master Soul Teddys and collect their souls. Free Spirit 4000144/100
I helped Ghosthunter Bob find freedom for Master Soul Teddys.

quests.name: The Soul Collector
quests.description:
Ghosthunter Bob of Ludibrium is complaining that he lost the vacuum that gathers up the spirits in it..
Apparently, once Ghosthunter Bob focuses on eating, he will never realize about anything and everything, including the thefts. This is the reason he had no idea his Soul Collector had been missing. I better help him find it back. Soul Collector 4031193/1 Spirit Viking Eliminate 34461#
I helped Ghosthunter Bob recover the lost Soul Collector.
quests.requirements: Defeat Spirit Viking x 20, Soul Collector x 1

quests.name: Destroying the Power of Evil
quests.description:
Dark Tachion is an altered version of Tachion, which is the source of power that forms the Time Sphere. It should be deemed dangerous now, and since a creepy, evil force keeps seeping out of it, it must be a dangerous time here. I should destroy this at the lava deep in El Nath.
After taking care of Papulatus, it coughed up Dark Tachion, emitting a dark force in the process. To destroy this, I went to the deepest part of El Nath where the lava flows. I better destroy this by dropping it in the boiling lava.
After entering a hidden area where the lava flows, I found a Suspicious Lava. This is where I threw the Dark Tachion to destroy it. The force of evil disappeared along with the Tachion itself.

quests.name: Mason the Collector
quests.description:
I should meet Mason, who newly moved into a previously-empty house at Ludibrium.
The bird with an odd way of talking, Mason the Collector is always busy looking for something to collect. It especially has a fondness for sparkling objects, and apparently found the Aurora Marble at the Warped Path of Time. Hmmm... wonder who has that item 4031189::# 4031189/1
At the Warped Path of Time, I took out the Lazy Buffys, collected the Aurora Marble, and handed it to Mason.

Just like Mason the collecting fanatic wanted, I managed to gather up more Lazy Buffy marbles and Aurora marbles. In return, I received an item from him that looks quite useful...

quests.name: The Lost Piece of the VIP Ticket
quests.description:
Where did the ripped piece of the VIP ticket go I better go see Kevin the Soldier.
The ripped piece of the VIP ticket is missing, so I went to Kevin the Soldier for its whereabouts. Kevin wound up picking up the ticket after I left.
I was looking for the ripped piece of the VIP ticket for a looong time, and I fund out that the ones I dropped, Kevin the Soldier managed to pick them up and save them. Phew~~~
quests.rewards_items: Ripped Travel Ticket 2, Ripped Travel Ticket 1

quests.name: The Lost Piece of the VIP Ticket
quests.description:
Where did the ripped piece of the VIP ticket go I better go see Kevin the Soldier.
The ripped piece of the VIP Ticket has disappeared, so I asked Kevin the Soldier for some help..
Fortunately, even after losing a ripped piece of VIP ticket, Kevin the Soldier was picking up after me. Phew... thanks a lot =)
quests.rewards_items: Ripped Travel Ticket 2, Ripped Travel Ticket 1

quests.name: Tae Gong's Love For His Wife
quests.description:
I should go visit Tae Gong, who's gone fishing floating around in the middle of Aqua Road.
Tae Gong, who's in the middle of the ocean fishing on a raft, was concerned that he couldn't gather up Shrimp Meat for his wife. I made a deal with him to gather up 20 Shrimp Meats for him and deliver them to his wife Grandma Yeon at the Korean Folk Town. Shrimp Meat 4000166/20
Tae Gong, who was busy fishing in the middle of the ocean, requested that I gather up 20 Shrimp Meats and deliver them to his wife Grandma Yeon, which I did. Grandma Yeon was very thankful, yet sorry that I had to go through all kinds of trouble just for her.

quests.name: The Brothers' Stack of Rice 1
quests.description:
I better go visit Chil Sung at the Korean Folk Town.
Chil Sung and Chil Nam are brothers living in Korean Folk Town. Chil Sung was worried that his brother Chil Nam didn't have much food with him, and asked me if I could secretly place his sack of rice on Chil Nam's stacks.
I received a sack of rice from Chil Sung, and placed it on top of a stack of rice in front of Chil Nam's house.

quests.name: The Brothers' Stack of Rice 2
quests.description:
Chil Nam insisted that his brother, who is the oldest child, should have more food than him, and stuck out a Sack of Rice from his stack. He then requested that I place it on top of Chil Sung's stack of rice in front of his house.
I received a Sack of Rice from Chil Nam, and placed it on top of a stack of rice in front of Chil Sung's house.

quests.name: The Brothers' Stack of Rice 3
quests.description:
Chil Sung was puzzled that his stack didn't seem to decrease, and asked me if I could place another Sack of Rice on his brother's stack.
I received a Sack of Rice from Chil Sung, and placed it on top of a stack of rice in front of Chil Nam's house.

quests.name: The Brothers' Stack of Rice 4
quests.description:
Chil Nam was puzzled that his stack didn't seem to decrease, and asked me if I could place another Sack of Rice on his brother's stack.
I received a Sack of Rice from Chil Nam, and placed it on top of a stack of rice in front of Chil Sung's house.

quests.name: Brotherly Love
quests.description:
While I was busy secretly placing sacks of rice on both Chil Sung's and Chil Nam's stacks back and forth, I was finally caught red-handed by Chil Sung. Chil Sung thanked me for strengthening the love and bond between the brothers even more. He also said that Chil Nam might have noticed it himself, and wanted me to go see him.
I was busy transfering multiple sacks of rice for Chil Sung and Chil Nam on each other's stacks, but was caught red-handed. The brothers seemed genuinely thankful for helping them strengthening the love and bond between the brothers even more. He also said that Chil Nam might have noticed it himself, and wanted me to go see him.

quests.name: The Lost Seed
quests.description:
Apparently, a Swallow hurt its wing and is laying down around the village shrine. I better go check it out ...
I met Swallow near the village shrine, its wings clipped. Swallow was on a delivery, but lost the item that it was suppose to deliver: a rare seed, and Swallow wanted me to find the seed for it. Apparently, it dropped the seed somewhere around where a bunch of suspicious rabbits looked on. Maybe the rabbits took it... Swallow's Lost Seed 4031241/1
I met Swallow near the village shrine, its wings clipped. Swallow was desperate to find the lost seed, and asked me for help. Swallow claimed to have lost the seed where a bunch of suspicious-looking rabbits gathered up, so I asked each and every one of them about the whereabouts of the seed. The seed was eventually found, and I gave them back to Swallow.

quests.name: Opening Nolbu's Gourd
quests.description:
I have this seed that Swallow gave me. Should I give this to Nolbu
I took this seed that Swallow gave me and gave it to Nolbu. When notified that the seed was indeed from Swallow, Nolbu requested that I plant the seed on his rooftop, and when it grows into a gourd, open it and give him whatever that maybe inside.
I gave Nolbu the seed that Swallow gave me. Nolbu requested that I plant the seed on his rooftop, and when it grows into a gourd, open it and give him whatever that maybe inside. When the gourd grew and was big enough to open, it contained the warrant of attachment. Greedy Nolbu collapsed and started bawling over his misfortune.
quests.rewards_items:
Storybook on Hongbu and Nolbu, Pick one:
Any Class: Blue Goldwind Shoes, Brown Steel-Tip Boots

quests.name: Opening Hongbu's Gourd
quests.description:
I have this seed that Swallow gave me. Should I give this to Hongbu
I took this seed that Swallow gave me and gave it to Hongbu. When notified that the seed was indeed from Swallow, Hongbu requested that I plant the seed on his rooftop, and when it grows into a gourd, open it and give him whatever that maybe inside.
I gave Hongbu the seed that Swallow gave me. Hongbu requested that I plant the seed on his rooftop, and when it grows into a gourd, open it and give him whatever that maybe inside. When the gourd grew and was big enough to open, it contained a chest full of treasures.
quests.rewards_items:
Storybook on Hongbu and Nolbu, Pick one:
Any Class: Mithril Hildon Boots, Green Goni Shoes

quests.name: The Seed That Swallow Lost
quests.description:
I lost the seed that Swallow gave. I better go visit again.
I lost the seed that Swallow gave, so I had to explain the circumstances to it. After some deliberation, it decided to look for another seed, and asked me to wait for a bit, then talk to it again.
I went to see Swallow because I have lost the seed myself, and it gave me a new one. Now, who should I give this to

quests.name: Preparing to Eliminate Goblins
quests.description:
Apparently, Chumji, who is the landlord of the Korean Folk Town, have a request for me.
Chumji, who resides in Korean Folk Town, requested that I take out the Goblins who have been appearing at the mountain. The Goblins that have appeared at the Black Mountain are the goblins that have run away from the storybook on the Goblin Story, and they have been hiding out at an abandoned home. In order to draw them out of the seclusion, he told me I needed three different types of baits: Roasted pork, Buckwheat paste, Rice Wine. I'll need to move around town and gather those items up. and then return to Chumji. Roasted pork 2022050/1 Buckwheat paste 2022051/1 Rice Wine 2022052/1
Chumji, who requested that I eliminate the Goblins that have run away from the storybook on Goblin Story and are currently hiding at an abandoned house in a mountain, told me that in order to draw them out, I'll need to have three things that they love : buckwheat paste, roasted pork, and rice wine, and he wanted me to gather them up for him. In the end, I was able to do so with help from Kong Ji, Hongbu, and Chil Nam.
quests.requirements: Roasted pork x 1, Buckwheat paste x 1, Rice Wine x 1

quests.name: Eliminate Goblins
quests.description:
Armed with 3 types of food that Goblins cannot resist, the quest to defeat the Goblins has now officially begun. Chumji advised that I drop the baits at various spots near the abandoned house in the Black Mountain to draw the Goblins out, and proceeded to give me the details on exactly where to drop them: roasted pork in front of a stack of rocks; buckwheat paste inside a tree hole; rice wine in a stone lantern Yellow King Goblin 36113# Blue King Goblin 36111# Green King Goblin 36112# Goblin Cap 4031232/1 Goblin Bat 4031233/1 Goblin Cape 4031234/1
I brought roasted pork, buckwheat paste, and rice wine and made my way up to the very top of the Black Mountain, where the abandoned house is located. I was able to successfully draw the 3 King Goblins out from the house and defeated all of them. When the Goblins were defeated, they dropped a bunch of jewelry, and after bringing them all to Chumji, he decided to give me one as a gift.
quests.requirements: Defeat Blue King Goblin x 1, Defeat Green King Goblin x 1, Defeat Yellow King Goblin x 1, Goblin Cape x 1, Goblin Cap x 1, Goblin Bat x 1
quests.rewards_items:
Storybook on the Goblin Story, Pick one:
Any Class: Goblin Cap, Goblin Bat, Goblin Cape

quests.name: Chil Sung's Roasted Pork
quests.description:
Apparently, the place that makes the best roasted pork in Korean Folk Town is Chil Sung's...
I went to Chil Sung's place because he was apparently the best at making roasted pork in Folk Town. He asked for 5 Moon Bunny's Pounders and 1,000 mesos in return for roasted pork. Pounder 4000169/5
I gave Chil Sung 5 Pounders and 1,000 mesos for 1 roasted pork.

quests.name: Chil Nam's Buckwheat Paste
quests.description:
Apparently, the place that makes the best buckwheat paste in Korean Folk Town is Chil Nam's...
I went to Chil Nam's place because he was apparently the best at making buckwheat paste in Folk Town. He asked for 4 Tiger Stamps and 1,000 mesos in return for some buckwheat paste. Tiger Stamp 4000170/4
I gave Chil Nam 4 Tiger Stamps and 1,000 mesos for 2 buckwheat pastes.

quests.name: Kong Ji's Rice Wine
quests.description:
Apparently, the place that makes the best Rice Wine in Korean Folk Town is Kong Ji's...
I went to Kong Ji's tavern because apparently her place was the best at making rice wine in Folk Town. She asked for 3 Three-Tailed Foxtails and 1,000 mesos in return for some rice wine. Three-Tailed Foxtail 4000172/3
I gave Kong Ji 3 Three-Tailed Foxtails and 1,000 mesos for 5 bottles of rice wine.

quests.name: Retrieving the Storybook : Hongbu and Nolbu
quests.description:

quests.name: Pot with a Hole
quests.description:
I heard that Kong Ji is in need of help. I should go check it out...
Kong Ji, who lives at a tavern in Folk Town with her stepmom, is a nice girl who does everything her stepmom asks her to do, however ludicrous the task may be. This time, the stepmom ordered her to fill up a pot with water, but the pot had a hole at the bottom, which made it impossible to fill up the pot. She asked me if I could get her a new New Pot. I heard that Grandma Yeon, who lives at the place where the water mill is, sells pots, and if I keep her up to date on his husband's whereabouts, then she may give me the pot. New Pot 4031230/1
I gave Kong Ji, who was panicking because her pot had a hole at the bottom, the New Pot that Grandma Yeon made at the water mill. Apparently, Grandma Yeon only sells these pots to the closest few. I should go check on Kong Ji again down the road.

quests.name: Extracting Artemesia
quests.description:
I heard that Kong Ji is in need of help. I should go check it out...
I went to see Kong Ji again. Kong Ji seemed swamped with work at home. Her stepmom wants some Artemesia Rice Cake, which means she had to extract Artemisia, but she is stuck at home trying to finish the laundry before the day is over. Obviously, she has no time to extract Artemesia, and that is why she's asking for my help. I've decided to extract some Artemisia for poor Kong Ji. Artemisia 4031231/12
I went through the town and mountains and extracted some Artemesia for Kong Ji, who was stuck at home doing house chores. Kong Ji seemed to be stuck at home working way too hard. I better go see her again down the road.

quests.name: The Wooden Hoe That Snapped
quests.description:
I heard that Kong Ji is in need of help. I should go check it out...
I went to visit Kong Ji again. She was sitting down, looking dejected. Her stepmom ordered her to plow the field by lunch, but her wooden hoe, which had been used for years and years, finally coudln't handle the pressure and snapped. Kong Ji felt that only a durable steel hoe can help her plow the field, so I have decided to get Steel Hoe for her. I heard that I can obtain the Steel Hoe by eliminating the Blins, who reside at the Black Mountain... Steel Hoe 4031222/1
I found a way to acquire Steel Hoe through Blins at the Black Mountain, and gave them to Kong Ji, who still seemed devastated by the 'snapping' of the wooden hoe. Needless to say, she was ecstatic when given the steel hoe. She was thankful for my work, and went out to start weeding the garden.. Kong Ji's been through a lot; hopefully something good happens to her down the road.

Apparently, his mother went out for a little bit, and while she was away from home, a tiger from the Black Mountain came to town and threatened to eat his sister and him. He said he has to leave town today before the tiger catches him tonight, and told me he needed 20 Tough Ropes from Hogul. And for reasons unknown, he also wanted me to get 1 Slippery Oil that Cico gives. Tough Rope 4031268 / 20 Slippery Oil 4031269 / 1

I should go visit Mr. Shim in Folk Town. I heard he hasn't been doing well lately...
At the Korean Folk Town, I met with Mr. Shim, who's a loving father to his only daughter, Shim Chung. Lately, however, he's been worried that his eyesight is rapidly failing him, and that he was worried he might one day become blind. He wanted to buy a pair of Reading Glasses, but the astronomical price tag calls for 300 State-held Rices per pair, he wanted to borrow them from me. How am I going to find State-held Rice, though Ahh, Mr. Shim said I can find it through Retz at Helios Tower... State-held Rice 4031279 / 300
I ran into Mr. Shim, who was concerned about his rapidly failing eyesight, at Korean Folk Town. After hearing his story, I promised to lend him 300 State-held Rices. The problem is, I don't have any rice ... but thankfully, after gettin Retz, I was able to get 300 State-held Rices. As a sign of thanks, Mr. Shim gave me Storybook on Shim Chung.

quests.description:

Chumji, the landlord of the Korean Folk Town, is concerned that the residents of the Folk Town is rapidly getting sick these days because of a bunch of Samihos from the Black Mountain that put curse on any person that crosses their path. In order to end the curse that is affecting the town, he said it requires 999 foxtails, and since each Three-Tailed Foxtail has 3 tails, I need to get 333 Three-Tailed Foxtails for him. Three-Tailed Foxtail 4000172 / 333
To cure the curse of the Three-Tailed Fox that is affecting the residents in Folk Town, I gathered up 333 Three-Tailed Foxtails like Chumji asked. Chumji thanked me for my work, and gave me an all-purpose medicine.

quests.name: The Story of Axes
quests.description:
Deep in the A Small Well of the Black Mountain, I heard God of Mountains is concerned about something. I better go check it out myself.
I met God of Mountains, who was heavily sighing at A Small Well with a big lump on his head. Apparently, he got hurt from a random axe that was thrown on his way. After throwing the axe out of the pond in disgust, the owner of the axe, Tree Cutter, came and asked for the axe. He requested that anyone that finds the Tree Cutter's Steel Axe return it to Tree Cutter. The Mountain God believes that the steel axe for the tree cutter might be taken by a monster, and that he has offered to look into the axe and see if it's legit. The axes will be available through Dark Axe Stumps, and he'll look into it and see if it's really Tree Cutter's Steel Axe.
Through the request from God of Mountains, who I met at A Small Well of the Black Mountain, I returned Tree Cutter's Steel Axe to its rightful owner, and received the storybook on 'The Story of the Axes'.

The Mountain God told me if I bring the axe that Dark Axe Stump had, then he'll look into it and see if it's indeed the steel axe of the tree cutter or not. I need to pick up an axe from Dark Stump and bring it back to the Mountain God.
The Mountain God carefully looked through the axe that I picked up, and told me what kind of axe that was. If I ever find the tree cutter's steel axe, then I'll have to return it to the tree cutter who lives somewhere around the Black Mountain.

quests.name: No Gong's Teaching3

Despite defeating 20 Straw Target Dummy like No Gong asked, No Gong still seemed uninterested in making me the Master. Seriously, is he really an instructor This is really getting on me, and I got to see him now, just to see what he'll ask me to d
I asked him about being the Master, but No Gong gave me this uninterested look and told me to defeat 40 Straw Target Dummys. First, 10... then 20... now 40 What am I, a training dog Despite my anger ready to spill over, I realized I couldn't stop now. Fine, I'll do what No Gong says. Straw Target Dummy 38021#
Despite defeating 40 Straw Target Dummys, No Gong still gave me that uninterested look and just nodded nonchalantly. I mean, he should be giving me some kind of a compliment for doing all that, but instead, No Gong iterated that I am still nowhere clos

quests.name: The Lost Document
quests.description:
Apparently at Mu Lung, there's someone by the name of Do Gong who is the meditation instructor on the Masters, and he knows a way to become the Legendary Being.
Do Gong stated that there's a scroll out there that should help one to become the Master. Unfortunately, the scroll that contains all the skills have been lost by Do Gong once at Foggy Forest around the Peach Farm, only to find it back later. Alas, the scroll is old and ragged, with ripped pages here and there. So, does that mean if I find the ripped The Book Ghost's Sheet of Paper, then I can become a Master myself The Book Ghost's Sheet of Paper The Book Ghost's Sheet of Paper 4000299/10
I managed to find The Book Ghost's Sheet of Paper, and brought it back to Do Gong. Unfortunately, Do Gong had the look of great concern as he rummaged through The Book Ghost...

quests.name: Eliminating the Spirited Cats
quests.description:
The document that contains all the mysterious skills necessary to become the Master. I found all the loose pages, but Do Gong looked concerned as he ran through The Book Ghost's Sheet of Paper. What's the problem now When will he make me a Master I better talk to Do Gong.
After looking through The Book Ghost's Sheet of Paper, Do Gong stated that there were cat footprints everywhere, and concluded that some street cats may have read the document and secretly obtained those skills. Do Gong stressed that there should not be cats like those roaming around the forest, for they'll present danger to all of us. He asked that I eliminate 20 Sage Cats for him, and bring back 5 Kitty Spirits… Kitty Spirit 4031433/5 Sage Cat 38041#
After eliminating Sage Cats and bringing back Kitty Spirits, Do Gong commended me for the job well done, but refused to hand me The Book Ghost. He mentioned that the document will allow me to obtain those skills, but learning the skills that way would make me no different than those street-cats-turned-monsters, and recommended that I train slowly but surely. That, and only that, he said, would allow me to become the true Master. Sigh... that all went for a naught, but he did say the right thing. When will I become the true Master

That was, before Lord Pirate kidnapped The King of Bellflowers, Wu Yang. The Bellflowers, worried that Wu Yang might be in danger, reluctantly followed the Lord Pirate's orders and started attacking humans.instead. How cowardly of the Lord Pirate to disturb the peace of the Bellflowers by kidnapping their King!! That's despicable! I better defeat Lord Pirate and save the King of Bellflowers, Wu Yang! quests.name: Pirate's Map
quests.description:
Vikin of Lith Harbor apparently has been waiting for the right time to do something big..
Vikin seemed eager to fight the stormy sea, and wanted me to find Pirate Map, the map that featured the secret path through the stormy sea. According to Vikin, the one that has all 6 divided pieces of Piece of the Pirate Map happens to be the only person that has survived the stormy sea, Lord Pirate… Hey, that means I have to go through the lair of Lord Pirate! Piece of the Pirate Map 4001118/6
I was able to gather up all the Piece of the Pirate Maps from the lair of Lord Pirate and gave them to Vikin. Obtaining the map, Vikin seemed ecstatic to finally be able to tackle on the stormy sea. I mean, he's acutely aware of the dangers that lurks over him, and yet he seemed to eager to attack the water. Vikin really must be one heck of a traveler.
quests.requirements: Piece of the Pirate Map x 6

requirements_list.name: Piece of the Pirate Map
requirements_list.label: Piece of the Pirate Map x 6

quests.name: Finding the Ingredients for Tae Sang
quests.description:
Tae Sang of Mu Lung was apprently searching for a better ingredient for medicines.
Tae Sang told me that he heard rumors that at the lair of the pirates at Herb Town, there are some herb concentrates available that cannot be obtained in ground. He asked me if I could get 50 Bellflower Concentrates and 100 Ginseng Concentrates for him. Bellflower Concentrate 2022132/50 Ginseng Concentrate 2022131/100
I found 50 Bellflower Concentrates and 50 Ginseng Concentrates, and gave them to Tae Sang.
quests.requirements: Bellflower Concentrate x 50, Ginseng Concentrate x 100

quests.name: Kino Konoko's Concern
quests.description:
Kino Konoko is responsible for taking care of a small altar over in Mushroom Shrine. She seems to be concerned about something...
Tired of cleaning up after those pesky Crows, Kino Konoko wants me to gather 100 Crow Feathers. I'd hate to see the Mushroom Shrine covered in filth, so I've decided to help her. Time to pluck some Crow Feathers! Crow Feather 4000064/100
I gave Kino Konoko a whole bunch of Crow Feathers. It felt good seeing her being ecstatic over a bunch of Kino Konokos. Hopefully this will restore Mushroom Shrine's beauty...

quests.name: Kino Konoko vs Fire Raccoon
quests.description:
Kino Konoko, who resides in the Mushroom Shrine, is having a bit of trouble with Fire Racoons. I should see if I can help!
Kino Konoko tells me that the food vendors and restaurants in Mushroom Shrine are suffering from Fire Raccoons attacking their places. I better help them out. I would not want to miss out on some great food around here! Now, where can I find Fire Raccoon Fire Raccoon 43011#
I let Kino Konoko know that I took care of 100 Fire Raccoons. She was ecstatic, to say the least. Hopefully that'll keep the Mushroom Shrine food from disappearing...

quests.name: Hanako's Foxtail Muffler 1
quests.description:
Hanako of Mushroom Shrine has an item she really would love to have. What must that be
It turns out that the item Hanako wants to have is a muffler made out of Cloud Foxtail. A muffler made out of Foxtails. Hmm…I don't get why she'd want to wear a muffler in such warm weather, but I did promise to get her Cloud Foxtails, She needs 100, so I'd better get started. So, that's 100 Cloud Foxtails... Cloud Foxtail 4000066/100
I gave Hanako 100 Cloud Foxtails. Hmmm, but this isn't as much as I thought. Can she really make a muffler out of this

quests.name: Hanako's Foxtail Muffler 2
quests.description:
Hanako, who wanted to make a Cloud Foxtail muffler, haven't finished making it. I wonder what she's lacking...
Hanako wanted to make a muffler out of Cloud Foxtail, so I gave her 100 Cloud Foxtails. Despite the work, Hanako flat-out insisted that she asked for 300 all along, and demanded that I get her 200 more. I didn't need to hear that from her, but I'll have to get her 200 more... 200 more Cloud Foxtails That's a lot! Cloud Foxtail 4000066/200
I gave Hanako 200 Cloud Foxtails. Hopefully this will do.

quests.name: Hanako's Foxtail Coat
quests.description:
Hanako seemed to be dissatisfied with just having a Cloud Foxtail muffler, and wants something more. What would that be...
It turns out Hanako wanted not just a Cloud Foxtail muffler, but a Cloud Foxtail coat. Seriously, why does she need a coat at Mushroom Shrine... This defies anyone's logic, but oh well... How am I going to gather up 400 Cloud Foxtails Cloud Foxtail 4000066/400
I gave Hanako 400 Cloud Foxtails. I understand her need for pretty things, but wearing a muffler AND a coat at Mushroom Shrine Hanako's just weird.

quests.name: Eliminating Dark Cloud Fox
quests.description:
The 'best-dressed' lady of Mushroom Shrine, Hanako, seems to be perturbed at something...
I found Hanako enraged - it appears her newly-purchased fabric was destroyed by a pack of Dark Cloud Foxes. For someone as vain as she is, this is devastating. As a result, I promised her to eliminate 100 Dark Cloud Foxes for her. The things I do for friends... Dark Cloud Fox 43051#
Hanako seemed thankful for me eliminating 100 Dark Cloud Foxs. She must have bought some new fabric already.

quests.name: The Lantern at Mushroom Shrine
quests.description:
Hikari, a proud resident of Mushroom Shrine, seems to be annoyed by something.
Hikari was indeed annoyed by something. She was disturbed that the Worn Paper Lanterns that are being used at Mushroom Shrine is apparently stuck with ghosts. This isn't annoying; this is downright creepy. I better kill 100 Paper Lantern Ghosts and get her some Worn Paper Lanterns, just the way Hikari said. Paper Lantern Ghost 43061# Worn Paper Lantern 4000222/50
I eliminated Paper Lantern Ghost and got some Worn Paper Lanterns for use. The more I think about it, I think Paper Lantern Ghost is much more of a dangerous presence than an unlit street at night.
quests.requirements: Defeat Paper Lantern Ghost x 100, Worn Paper Lantern x 50

quests.name: Eliminating Ghosts
quests.description:
Hikari of Mushroom Shrine seems to have something to tell me. I wonder what it is...
Hikari told me I have a whole bunch of Nightghosts around me. That's creepy, to say the least. I better kill off 100 Nightghosts right now. Nightghost 43071#
After letting Hikari know that I've killed 100 Nightghosts, she tells me that there aren't any Nightghosts hovering around me. Phew...

quests.name: Water Goblin's Cucumber
quests.description:
Hikari's farm, located at Mushroom Shrine, seems to have been robbed. What happened
Hikari states that the only items stolen at her farm are the Cucumbers, and she was very confident that it was the work of Water Goblin. She asked me to eliminate 100 Water Goblins and recover 50 Cucumbers in the process. A monster that prefers to eat Cucumber Interesting, especially since most kids hate that Water Goblin 43081# Cucumber 4000223/50
After eliminating Water Goblins and recovering a whole bunch of Cucumbers, Hikari had the look of satisfaction on her face.
quests.requirements: Defeat Water Goblin x 100, Cucumber x 50

quests.name: Eliminating Blue Mushmom
quests.description:
Mushroom Shrine is apparently in deep trouble. I better go see Hikari.
Apparently, out of numerous mushrooms that reside in Mushroom Shrine, a few of them turned into mutants, ultimately becoming Blue Mushmom. Hikari was worried that the town was going through a lot of trouble because of them, and wanted me to eliminate Blue Mushmoms. Blue Mushmoms are located at Hall of Mushroom. Blue Mushmom 43091#
I eliminated Blue Mushmoms as ordered and reported them to Hikari. Those mushrooms were indeed very hard to handle.

quests.name: Urban Jungle
quests.description:
There's a Masked Man in New Leaf City... what's his deal
I spoke with Jack Masque, he’s a bandit prince from Amoria. He’s in love with Princess Restless, and is trying to win her love from afar. He’s got a passionate hatred for Wolf Spiders, as one bit her just as she was giving him a kiss. So, I’ve agreed to hunt down 100 Wolf Spiders in return for his thanks and something special he picked up. I should be able to find them in the MesoGears...
+Phew* I wiped out 100 of those pesky Wolf Spiders, and in return, I received a Leaf Crystal from Jack Masque. I can come back every 72 hours to help him if I want. I wonder what he did to get kicked out of Amoria...

quests.name: Subani's Legacy - Discovery
quests.description:
I heard there's an adventurer over at the MesoGears underneath Bigger Ben. What mysteries does it hold I should find out!
I spoke with the famous John Barricades' one-half of the world famous Barricade Bros. Treasure Hunting Co. He spoke to me about Subani, the legendary mage responsible for the Dark Scrolls throughout the Maple World. He believes there is something within the MesoGears that may be a treasure of his. I’ve agreed to help clear the way. I’ll have to defeat 50 Killa Bees, 30 Mighty Maple Eaters and 40 Fire Tusks so I can explore deeper into the MesoGears...
I cleared a path straight through the MesoGears, and now I can explore there in peace. When I'm ready, I can see John Barricade to continue with the next part of this adventure!
quests.requirements: Defeat Killa Bee x 50, Defeat Mighty Maple Eater x 30, Defeat Fire Tusk x 40

quests.name: Subani's Legacy - Transgression
quests.description:
John Barricade is awaiting me at the Temple Hive! He's found something!
I spoke with John, and he's found a set of weird markings in the MesoGears that he can't decipher. He's mentioned that he'll need special crystals known as Hyper Glyphs. I've agreed to snag 50 of them so he can decipher the markings. Electrophants...John thinks that the mechanism on their heads may have those Hyper Glyphs inside. I'd better be careful-I don't want to get shocked!
I got the 50 Hyper Glyphs that John needed, and he's hard at work deciphering the markings. I should come back soon to see if he's finished!

quests.name: Subani's Legacy - Deliverance
quests.description:
John has finished deciphering the markings! I need to get back to the Temple Hive now!
John and I spoke again, and something unforeseen happened. I’ll have to track down 50 MesoGears Map Pieces so he can put together the map! He mentioned the robots he “borrowed” for some assistance went all crazy, kept saying “I.AM.ROBOT” as they scurried into the Krakian Jungle...
Finally done! I took the pieces back to John, and he's going to start piecing the map together. However, he did come across a strange ring that passed on to me. If this was the first treasure, I wonder where the rest is...

quests.name: Lost!
quests.description:
There's a mysterious traveler in New Leaf City-he doesn't look like he's from anywhere around here. I should ask him what's going on. It could be interesting...
I spoke with Elpam Gorlab, and he's a traveler from Versal, the mirror-world of MapleStory. He traveled here to observe us and our celebration, but due to the appearance of Amoria, he was thrown off-course and landed in New Leaf City. I've agreed to help get him home by collecting 30 Elpam Magnets. He's mentioned that the only creatures that have them here are the Barnard Grays. I'll have to head to Omega Sector and track them down. I didn't know that there was a mirror-world...I wonder if I have a double there...
I got the 30 Elpam Magnets and returned them to Elpam. In return, he gave me an Elpam Elixir, something that's sure to help me. It looks like he needs more help though...

quests.name: ReVersal
quests.description:
Elpam has adjusted his compass, but he still needs my help. I should travel back and see what he needs!
I went back to Elpam for more information, and he's explained that while he was able to adjust the compass, he needs to head back to the moment of his travel glitch to get back to his home safely. I have to hunt down 60 Temporal Fragments and hand them over. That's a full minute and the perfect amount of time for him to travel back. The Tick-Tock monsters should have them, since they tend to keep time. HA!
I got all 60 Temporal Fragments and returned them to Elpam. In return, he's given me a very nice prize he found floating in the rift...!

quests.rewards_items: Dark scroll for Gloves for ATT

quests.name: Featherweights
quests.description:
Icebyrd looks like he needs my help. I'd better get over to New Leaf City and see him!
I spoke with Icebyrd, and he was glad to see me. He's been trying to build the new areas, but the Gryphons have been wreaking havoc on the construction crews. If that wasn't enough, those pesky Boomers are also attacking the machines. I've agreed to help by taking out 100 Gryphons (located in the Highlands) and Boomers for 150 Boomer Core (located in the Badlands) to show them that this city is off-limits!
Man, what a day. I de-clawed the Gryphons and defused the Boomers. Now the city can continue building in peace. Icebyrd said that they may act up again, so I should come back to see if they've been rowdy...
quests.requirements: Defeat Gryphon x 100, Boomer Core x 150

quests.name: Cleaning Up The Streets
quests.description:
There's a new sheriff in New Leaf City. I should go see who it is!
I met the new sheriff, Lita Lawless. She's an old friend of Icebyrd's, and has taken over as the new sheriff. I've agreed to help her get this town in order, by wiping out 200 Electrophants and 200 Gryphons in New Leaf City. I'd better get started!
I...I did it! 200 of Electrophants and Gryphons has fallen to my might! In addition to that, I got a cool item from Lita as a ‘Thank You!’ I can return and help her anytime I want from now on...
quests.requirements: Defeat Gryphon x 200, Defeat Electrophant x 200
quests.rewards_items: Nocturnal Staff, 1000x Diamond Arrow for Bow, 1000x Diamond Arrow for Crossbow, White Identity, Onyx Blade

quests.name: Urban Warrior
quests.description:
This is Icebyrd Slimm, mayor of New Leaf City. I want to thank you for helping us get the city up and running. I have something for you, so come see me immediately!
As a bonus for helping get the city up and running, Icebyrd has given me a Warrior's Throne! This is sure to help me in the battles to come!
As a bonus for helping get the city up and running, Icebyrd has given me a Warrior's Throne! This is sure to help me in the battles to come!

quests.name: Urban Jungle - Continued
quests.description:
There's a Masked Man in New Leaf City... what's his deal
I spoke with Jack Masque, he's a bandit prince from Amoria. He's in love with Princess Restless, and is trying to win her love from afar. He's got a passionate hatred for Wolf Spiders, as one bit her just as she was giving him a kiss. So, I've agreed to hunt down 100 Wolf Spiders in return for his thanks and something special he picked up. I should be able to find them in the Temple Hive...
*Phew* I wiped out 100 of those pesky Wolf Spiders, and in return, I received a Leaf Crystal from Jack Masque. I can come back every 72 hours to help him if I want. I wonder what he did to get kicked out of Amoria...

There's a new sheriff in New Leaf City. I should go see who it is!
I met the new sheriff, Lita Lawless. She's an old friend of Icebyrd's, and has taken over as the new sheriff. I've agreed to help her get this town in order, by wiping out 200 Electrophants and 200 Gryphons in New Leaf City. I'd better get started!
I...I did it! 200 of Electrophants and Gryphons has fallen to my might! In addition to that, I got a cool item from Lita as a ‘Thank You!’ I can return and help her anytime I want from now on...
quests.requirements: Defeat Gryphon x 200, Defeat Electrophant x 200

quests.name: Welcome to New Leaf City Quiz - END
quests.description:
I've successfully solve all the questions but I am still curious of some things...
I was talking with Icebyrd Slimm and wow, there is more to this land of Masteria and New Leaf City than what I learned from the quiz. I want to know more of what happened in this place.
I've asked about the old fable of Masteria and Icebyrd Slimm didn't quite answer my question. Maybe when I become stronger, he will tell me more about it.

quests.name: Jay's Curiosity
quests.description:
It's weird... When I walked passed Jay from Henesys the other day, he didn't answer my greetings and didn't even notice me there. It looked like he was working on some kind of riddle by himself. Let's find out what Jay is up to these days.
I don't believe I actually offered to help him on finding a historical figure just out of curiosity! I guess it won't hurt to check out the dungeon as Jay requested... But I really doubt I would find anything there. It's a legend, myth, a fairy tale.
I found Bob from Drake's Meal Table and talked with bunch of people about him. He is famous around this world.
quests.rewards_items: Bob's Snail Shell, Bob's Snail Shell

quests.name: Gwin's Thanks
quests.description:
When I passed by, Gwin, someone I really never got to spoke with, looked like he had something to talk to me. Let's go and find out what he has to say to me.
Gwin was looking at Bob's Snail Shell very closely to see if I did anything to hurt him. I don't know what the deal is but he was scaring me. It makes me wonder why he is obsessed with this particular snail. I should find out by talking to Gwin again.
Gwin told me what happened between him and Bob. It's amazing that a simple snail actually tried to save human being... Those little monsters we hunt aren't really little at all...

quests.name: The Rememberer's Passion Part 1
quests.description:
The Rememberer sure would know who Bob is. He's the Rememberer! I should talk with The Rememberer to find out what he knows.
The Rememberer isn't relly being helpful today. Very slow talking, not really informative. I wonder why he is so... depres
He is MEAN! MEAN, MEAN, MEAN! He took away Bob's Snail Shell from me wtihout me letting him! Now, what do I have to do

quests.name: The Rememberer's Passion Part 2
quests.description:
I found it! I found Bob again! He must have escaped from The Rememberer by himself! I feel really terrible that I let this kind of things happen. I am going back to The Rememberer to tell him to lighten up.
I don't think The Rememberer gets the whole idea of me doing this. Bob may be just another monster but I know what is right or wrong. And I am going to pay back just the way he did to me. I need to get 1 Snail Shell other than Bob's to pull this off.
I got him! The Remeberer will always remember this day. The day he got tricked by me! Ok. I should stop doing things like this though.
quests.requirements: Snail Shell x 1, Bob's Snail Shell x 1

quests.name: Grendel The Really Old's Glorious Days
quests.description:
Grendel The Really Old... He lives deep in the forest of Ellinia. Since he's really old, he has to know SOMETHING about Bob. I shall see him now.
Grendel The Really Old was talking out of himself but I got to make him hear what I had to say. He is getting glasses. I hope his eyesight isn't too bad to recognize Bob... After all, Grendel is probably the oldest guy in this world.
Grendel The Really Old got very mad at me for hitting Bob to make him go into his shell. I knew he would know something but never would have guessed they were old friends. I guess I owe Bob a big apology. But how am I going to be able to do that to a snail, especially if he's not coming out from his shell

quests.name: Bruce's Research
quests.description:
Bruce, the monster researcher, might know something. Maybe he can tell me how old Bob actually is. If I get to know how old he is, wouldn't that be a discovery of something remarkable
He does seem to know something about his age but he looks spooked. I shouldn't hesitate to ask him what is wrong!
Wow... Bruce told me that Bob's age is incalculable. This is getting serious, isn't it. A snail that even professional monster researcher can't tell the age. Maybe he was right about asking me to go see Winston. Maybe an archeologist knows more about the history and the age issue than Bruce.

quests.name: Dances with Balrog's Barbarism Part 1
quests.description:
This is a wild guess but... Wouldn't Dances with Balrog know a little bit about Bob Who knows, I heard that he likes snails. Maybe I will go check with him.
I didn't know Dances with Balrog likes to EAT the snails... Now, what am I suppose to do ! It doesn't look like he is going to give me back Bob's Snail Shell anytime soon...
