quests.name: Protect Ludibrium
quests.description:
A mysterious power appeared in Ludibrium, then suddenly disappeared. Chaos ensued. Now is the time to straighten up the screwed-up time of Ludibrium. I'll need to go see Mr. Bouffon, who's at the Path of Time under Ludibrium.
I met up with Mr. Bouffon at the Path of Time. I promised him to find a new source of energy that may replace the original Time Sphere, which had been the main source of powerfor Ludibrium.
I gathered up enough Tachions and gave them to Mr. Bouffon as a replacement for the Time Sphere. I think he can make a new source of power with Tachion.

quests.name: The Replacement Time Energy
quests.description:
The source of energy has been swallowed a whole by Papulatus Clock with the disappearance of the time sphere. I need Mr. Bouffon to find a way for an alternative.
Thanks to Papulatus Clock with Time Sphere, the monsters below Path of Time have grown much stronger. There is, however, a way to recover the energy from those monsters; defeat them and they'll cough up the item that stores the energy. I'll need to gather up 300 Tachions and 100 Mysteriour Powers. 4031175:# 4031175/300 4031171:# 4031171/100
I gathered up Tachions and Mysterious Powders as the replacement energy to create the new Time Sphere.

quests.name: The Time Sphere
quests.description:
I may need to take care of some more business while creating the time sphere. I should go see Mr. Bouffon.
Mr. Bouffon wanted me to collect 4031179:# through Flo... 4031179:# 4031179/1
I found the 4031179:# that Mr. Bouffon was talking about. Apparently, to defeat Papulatus, we need to be at least lvl 80 or higher...

quests.name: Papulatus
quests.description:
Everything is ready. Now all we need to do is eliminate the evil force that is Papulatus Clock.
Enter the power-generating room by finding the 4031172:# by defeating the monsters guarding the gate. I also need to place 4031179:# at the crack to call Papulatus Clock out. 4031172:# 4031172/1 Eliminate Papulatus Clock 71031#
Finally got to eliminate Papulatus Clock, the evil force-dripping monster that was hogging the Time Sphere and stealing out all kinds of power through Ludarium! The Clocktower shall emit forces of nature, and Ludibrium shall be brought in peace.
quests.requirements: Defeat Papulatus x 1, Ludibrium Medal x 1

quests.name: A Piece of Crack
quests.description:
To block the cracked dimension that occurred at a vault, something is needed to block it. I should ask Flo at the tunnel of time for help.
I met up with Flo who told me about Papulatus. He's a monster that came through a crack in dimension to this world. I will need to get Piece of Cracked Dimension to seal up the cracked dimension. I'll need to eliminate Gigantic Spirit Viking and Grim Phantom Watch who might have entered this world with Papulatus Clock and collect the pieces of cracked dimension. Piece of Cracked Dimension A: 4031176/1 Piece of Cracked Dimension B: 4031177/1 Piece of Cracked Dimension C: 4031178/1
I gathered up 3 types of pieces of cracked dimension and gave it to Flo. I also gave Flo Piece of Cracked Dimension, which has something to do with Papulatus.
quests.requirements: Piece of Cracked Dimension A x 1, Piece of Cracked Dimension B x 1, Piece of Cracked Dimension C x 1

quests.name: The Lost Piece of Crack
quests.description:
If I ever lose the piece of cracked dimension, then I better go see Mr. Bouffon again.
I told Mr. Bouffon that I lost the piece of cracked dimension. He told me he was going to give me another chance and that I should go see Flo immediately.
I was able to regain the lost piece of dimension from Flo. I should seriously take care of Papulatus this time.

quests.name: The Lost Medal
quests.description:
If I lost the Ludibrium Medal, then I better go see Mr. Bouffon.
I told Mr. Bouffon that I lost the Ludibrium Medal. He told me he was going to give me another chance and that I should go see Flo immediately.
I was able to regain the lost Ludibrium Medal from Flo. I should seriously take care of Papulatus this time.

quests.name: The Lost Piece of Crack
quests.description:
I lost the Piece of Cracked Dimension that Flo gave me. I better go back to Mr. Bouffon and tell him the truth
I lost the Piece of Cracked Dimension that's been given to me by Flo. After telling Mr. Bouffon of the situation, he wanted me to talk to Flo again. I'm afraid Flo may be less than pleased by the fact that I lost a very valuable Piece of Cracked Dimension.
After telling Mr. Bouffon that I lost Piece of Cracked Dimension, he wanted me to go see Flo again and talk to him. Flo was pretty upset that I lost the valuable Piece of Cracked Dimension, but then wanted me to really make sure not to ever lose it again, while giving me the last remaining Piece of Cracked Dimension that he kept to himself. He warned me that this is the last one, and that if I ever lose it again, I won't be able to get it back ever again.. I better make sure not to lose it, and give it to Mr. Bouffon.

quests.name: Todd's How-to-Hunt
quests.description:
I hear Todd can teach us how to hunt.
Todd taught me to move towards upper right-hand side to attack by pressing Ctrl and kill 1 x Tutorial Leatty and 1 x Tutorial Drumming Rabbit, then talk to Peter... Tutorial Leatty 81421# Tutorial Drumming Rabbit 81422# Letty's hairball 4000300/1 Toy Drum 4000301/1
As Todd's taught me, I hunted down the monsters.
quests.requirements: Defeat Tutorial Leatty x 1, Defeat Tutorial Drumming Rabbit x 1, Letty's hairball x 1, Toy Drum x 1

quests.name: Pet's Evolution1
quests.description:
I heard there's a rumor that the Baby Dragons can be evolved. Unfortunately, the only way to find out is to meet up with the grotesque-looking Karnox. I better go see him...
I better protect the Dragon's egg from the vicious egg hunters such as Lupins and Cold Eyes and need to gather 50Lupin's Bananas and 50 Cold Eye Tails.
Thankfully, Karnox acknowledged my true love for the Baby Dragon and promised to help my pet evolve.
quests.requirements: Lupin's Banana x 50, Cold Eye Tail x 50

quests.name: Pet's Evolution2
quests.description:
I have sufficiently proved my love for the Baby Dragon. However, Karnox stated that special materials are required in order to evolve the Dragon...
In order to evolve the Baby Dragon, I'll need to deliver 1 The Rock of Evolution and 10,000 mesos to Karnox.
The Baby Dragon has successfully evolved and has grown up rather nicely.

quests.name: Pet's Re-Evolution
quests.description:
If I ever get tired of the Dragon's current look, then I can re-evolve the Dragon again for a different look.
The re-evolution requires 1 The Rock of Evolution and 10,000 mesos again, just like the first time.
The re-evolution had succeeded and now the Dragon sports a different look.

quests.name: 2006 Easter : Easter Basket
quests.description:
I better go check and see the Maple Administrator. She may have something in store for me...
The Maple Administrator needs 100 Tree Branches, 100 Squishy Liquids, and 1 Red ribbon to make me an Easter Basket. I better go get those right now! Tree Branch 4000003/100 Squishy Liquid 4000004/100 Red Ribbon 4031192/1
I got the Easter Basket from the Maple Administrator. Mad Bunny may need this for something... I should go see him now.
quests.requirements: Tree Branch x 100, Squishy Liquid x 100, Red Ribbon x 1

quests.name: 2006 Easter : Mad Bunny's Easter(Yellow)
quests.description:
I heard Mad Bunny isn't too happy with Easter. I should go talk to him and see what's up...
Mad Bunny needs 10 Yellow Easter Eggs and an Easter Basket from me. He may be one angry bunny, but he did promise to pay me well for my service... Yellow Easter Egg 2022065/10 Easter Basket 4031283/1
I gave him 10 Yellow Easter Eggs with the Easter Basket and he gave me an Easter Charm with some EXP. Not bad...
quests.requirements: Easter Basket x 1, Yellow Easter Egg x 10

quests.name: 2006 Easter : Mad Bunny's Easter(Green)
quests.description:
I heard Mad Bunny isn't too happy with Easter. I should go talk to him and see what's up...
Mad Bunny needs 10 Green Easter Eggs and an Easter Basket from me. He may be one angry bunny, but he did promise to pay me well for my service... Green Easter Egg 2022066/10 Easter Basket 4031283/1

quests.requirements: Easter Basket x 1, Green Easter Egg x 10

quests.name: Anniversary : Birthday Present (Red)
quests.description:
I should go visit the MapleStory Administrator. I heard MapleStory is celebrating its 1st birthday, and she may have something in store for me...
The MapleStory Administrator said we'll be celebrating the anniversary in style and that there is a RED birthday present for me to look for. Now, where must that be... Birthday Present (Red) 4031306/1
I found the RED birthday present and gave it to the Maple Administrator. She opened the present for me, and gave me what was inside. That was pretty sweet!

Weighted random:
Any Class: Birthday Cake (83.99%), Maple Bandana White (10%), Maple Bandana Yellow (5%), Maple Bandana Red (1%), Maple Bandana Blue (0.01%)

quests.name: Anniversary : Cody's Quest
quests.description:
Cody is supposedly in need of help. I should go see him at Henesys...
Cody said he's preparing a big party for the MapleStory staff with food and everything, but he forgot to buy the birthday candles for the cake! He seemed to be in a state of emergency, and asked me if I could gather up 10 Birthday Candles for him. Birthday Candles That's weird... Birthday Candle 4031305/10
I gave him the 10 Birthday Candles he requested. He seemed very much relieved by the fact that the party won't be ruined after all. He gave me a Maple Flag as a reward. Wow, I haven't seen these in a while!

quests.name: Anniversary : Birthday Present (Blue)
quests.description:
I should go visit the MapleStory Administrator. I heard MapleStory is celebrating its 1st birthday, and she may have something in store for me...

I found the BLUE Birthday Present, and gave it to the Maple Administrator. She opened the present for me and gave me what was inside. That was pretty sweet!

quests.name: Independence Day : Cody's Barbecue Party
quests.description:
Cody from Henesys is looking for my help. I hear that it is only for the limited time. Better go to Henesys and check out what he wants before time runs out!
Cody mentioned he is throwing a Barbecue party for Independence Day! He needs 50 Pigs' Heads, 50 Tree Branches and 50 Leathers to prepare for the Barbecue. I wonder what leather has to do with a Barbecue... Pig's Head 4000017/50 Tree Branch 4000003/50 Leather 4000021/50
I gave Cody the materials needed for the Barbecue! I got some delicious Barbecue and an Independence Day Hat for a reward!
quests.requirements: Pig's Head x 50, Tree Branch x 50, Leather x 50

quests.name: Independence Day : Alien Invasion
quests.description:
Agent Marco of the Omega Sector is looking for heroes to protect our World. I need to get to him before all hope is lost.
Agent Marco needs help on exterminating the Plateons on Boswell Fields. I heard that a tremendous number of Plateons are taking over the Boswell Fields and coming toward the Omega Sector. I need to take out bunch of Plateons and bring 100 Plateon Helmets to Agent Marco of the Omega Sector as a proof of my mission's success. Plateon's Helmet 4000121/100
After I gave Agent Marco all 100 Plateon Helmets, I received the Stars and Stripes. This flag represents my support for the independence of our World.

quests.name: Nanuke and the Chair
quests.description:
Nanuke apparently has something for everyone. He's way out there at the Whale Island. I should go see him...
Nanuke and his huskies greeted me with open arms. He proceeded to give me a resting chair as a way of celebrating the summer. Pretty ironic, considering he lives in perhaps the coldest place in MapleStory. Anyway, I should sit on this chair and relax for a bit...

quests.name: Thanksgiving : Turkey Yellow Egg hunt
quests.description:
It looks like Cody of Henesys needs help finding Turkey eggs...
I'm on a mission to find as many Yellow Turkey eggs as I can for Cody, who has a strange liking for Turkey Egg omelets. I'm going to find as many as I can and bring them back to Cody for prizes! I've heard tamed turkeys can be found around Victoria Island. Yellow Turkey Egg 4031416 / 1
The event is over, and I was able to help Cody find some Yellow eggs. He looked pretty happy, but I think he got so many eggs he'll start to chirp...ha!

quests.name: Thanksgiving : Turkey Green Egg hunt
quests.description:

The event is over, and I was able to help Cody find some eggs. He looked pretty happy, but I think he got so many eggs he'll start to chirp...ha!

quests.name: Thanksgiving : Pumpkin Pie
quests.description:
Hmm...there's an old woman over in Henesys...maybe she needs some help cooking
I spoke with that kind old woman, Grandma Benson, and she needs some help with baking the pies. I've agreed to gather the ingredients for her, maybe she'll give me a pie to take with me...I hope so! Pie Crust 4031418 / 1 Pumpkin 4031419 / 1 Flour 4031420 / 1 Powder Sugar 4031421 / 1
I finished gathering the ingredients for Grandma Benson, and she can finally bake the pies. I received a taste in return, and in something that can help me during a tough battle.
quests.requirements: Pie Crust x 1, Pumpkin x 1, Flour x 1, Powder Sugar x 1

quests.name: Festival of Lights - Building the Altar
quests.description:
Hmm, that woman looks like she's preparing some sort of celebration... I should check it out.
I spoke with Hannah, and she's preparing a Festival of Lights. I've agreed to help her build the Altar by gathering 25 Altar Pieces. She mentioned that the monsters would already have an axe stuck in them, so I should hunt those.
I collected the 25 Altar Pieces and returned to Hannah. She was happy, and began building the Altar. She also mentioned that I could come back for more work when I have a chance

quests.name: Festival of Lights - Blessing the Festival
quests.description:
I promised Hannah I'd return to her once I was rested up. I should head back soon.
Upon my return, Hannah was joyous, having finished the Altar. She now needs candles to signal the start of the ceremony. I'll have to get 9 candles (she mentioned Horned Mushrooms) and bring them back so the Festival of Lights can begin.
I acquired the nine candles and gave them to Hannah. The Festival of Lights has begun!

quests.name: Graham Cracked
quests.description:
What is that old man doing over there with all those Graham Crackers
I spoke with the old man, Mr. Kit Kat, and he wants to build a Graham Cracker house, but the monsters keep eating them...not that I blame them, they look delicious...despite my hunger, I've agreed to get 50 Graham Crackers for him so he can build his dream house.
I got all the Graham Cracker pieces (and resisted the temptation to eat them), returned to Mr. Kit Kat and he gave me something tasty Banana Graham Pie. 2 of them!

quests.name: New Year's Wishes 1
quests.description:
Can't believe its New Year's already! Looks like the Maple Administrator has something for me!
Can't believe its New Year's already! Looks like the Maple Administrator has something for me!
The Maple Administrator opened my present for me! Sweet!

It's New Year's! I should visit the Maple Administrator to get my present opened!

quests.name: Amoria : The Sakura Garden 1
quests.description:
I see Jacob, the garden caretaker over there! Why does he look so worried Maybe I can lend him a hand.
I talked with Jacob, who's trying to expand his garden. He's sent me to gather 25 Cherry Blossom seeds, 10 Silk Feathers and 10 Leather. I've heard that Sakura celions might have the blossom seeds. In return for this, he's agreed to give me some high-quality potions. I bet they taste delicious...
I got the materials that Jacob needed to expand the garden. He mentioned he might have more work for me if I needed it. I'll pay him a visit soon!
quests.requirements: Cherry Blossom Seed x 25, Silk Feather x 10, Leather x 10

quests.name: Amoria : The Sakura Garden 2 - Finishing Touches
quests.description:
Jacob mentioned he'd need more help. Perhaps I should pay him a visit
I went to see Jacob again, and his Sakura Garden is just about done. He wants to do something special for the first guests, so I've agreed to provide 20 White/Purple Gift Boxes, 10 Lupin Dolls and 10 Toy Baby Seals. Shouldn't be too tough, and he's mentioned something special if I finish...
I finished getting everything for Jacob and returned to him for my reward-Blossom Juice! It tastes great!
quests.requirements: Lupin Doll x 10, Toy Baby Seal x 10, White/Purple Ribbon Gift Box x 20

quests.name: Amoria : Cupid's Courier - Beginner
quests.description:
The wife of a sailor, eh I'll bet she needs some help.
I spoke with the lovely Angelique, and I'm going to deliver 25 Stiff Feathers to her husband, Richard, for her. He works on Tae Gong's ship in Aqua Road. Once I have everything, I'll head there, drop everything off, and let Angelique know her husband has everything.

quests.description:
I heard there's a new girl at the Amoria Hair Salon that needs material for her new hair gel. I wonder what she'd offer in return
I talked to Claudia, she needs 25 Squishy Liquids for her new hair gel. She's offered to give me a free EXP Hair Salon coupon in return. She seems like a nice enough gal...
I got the Squishy Liquids for Claudia and she gave me an EXP Hair Salon coupon for her shop. I can use it once to get my hair done for free!

quests.name: Amoria : Marriage
quests.description:
Congratulations! You're now married! Now go in peace and forever celebrate love!
Congratulations! You're now married! Now go in peace and forever celebrate love!

quests.name: Amoria : Red Dahlia - Warrior
quests.description:
Hmm, there's a man who looks a little distraught... should I help him
I went and spoke with Ben, and he's trying to make a special flower for his wife called the Red Dahlia. He got injured and needs someone to collect the materials for him. I agreed to help, and bring back 30 Stiff Feathers and 3 Diamond Ore he needs to make the flower. Seems like a nice enough guy, shame he got injured, but I can get him what he wants...
I retrieved all the materials Ben needed and he'll be able to make the Red Dahlia. In return for my help, he gave me a scroll that will help me in my travels.

quests.name: Spot On : An Interesting Chore
quests.description:
Mom and Dad need some help at home. I'd better go visit and see how I can help them.
I visited Mom and Dad and they looked pretty happy to see me. They need a Mouse for their new computer, and heard that Mr. Spot would have one. He's in Kerning City, so I'd better get a move on.
I returned to Mom and Dad with the Mouse, and they gave me Allowance. Now I can return to Mr. Spot and get a Nexon Cash Card!

quests.name: Spot On : Go See Mr. Spot
quests.description:
Mr. Spot is in Kerning City, and he has something that could help Mom and Dad. I'd better go see my parents first before I visit him.
I visited Mr. Spot and got the Mouse for Mom and Dad. I can get a Nexon Cash Card from Mr. Spot if I ask them for Allowance. I'll cross my fingers...
I got my Nexon Cash Card! I should keep it, because it will turn into Maple Points soon! SWEET!

quests.name: Circle of Trust - Repaired Ring
quests.description:
I've lost the Ring I got from Moony on the way back to Gary and Shatima. Maybe Moony can help me out...
Moony has the Ring! I am saved. This time I should be very careful.
I got the Repaired Ring from Moony again, and now Gary and Shatima can get married! Phew, a lot of work, but well worth it!

quests.name: Easter : Easter Basket
quests.description:
I better go check and see the Maple Administrator. She may have something in store for me...
The Maple Administrator needs 100 Tree Branches, 100 Squishy Liquids, and 1 Red ribbon to make me an Easter Basket. I better go get those right now! Tree Branch 4000003/100 Squishy Liquid 4000004/100 Red Ribbon 4031192/1
I got the Easter Basket from the Maple Administrator. Mad Bunny may need this for something... I should go see him now.
quests.requirements: Tree Branch x 100, Squishy Liquid x 100, Red Ribbon x 1

quests.name: Easter : Mad Bunny's Easter(Yellow)
quests.description:
I heard Mad Bunny isn't too happy with Easter. I should go talk to him and see what's up...
Mad Bunny needs 10 Yellow Easter Eggs and an Easter Basket from me. He may be one angry bunny, but he did promise to pay me well for my service... Yellow Easter Egg 2022065/10 Easter Basket 4031283/1
I gave him 10 Yellow Easter Eggs with the Easter Basket and he gave me an Easter Charm with some EXP. Not bad...
quests.requirements: Easter Basket x 1, Yellow Easter Egg x 10

quests.name: 2nd Anniversary : Birthday Present (Red)
quests.description:
I should go visit the MapleStory Administrator. I heard MapleStory is celebrating its 2nd birthday, and she may have something in store for me...
The MapleStory Administrator said we'll be celebrating the anniversary in style and that there is a RED birthday present for me to look for. Now, where must that be... Birthday Present (Red) 4031306/1
I found the RED birthday present and gave it to the Maple Administrator. She opened the present for me, and gave me what was inside. That was pretty sweet!

quests.name: 2nd Anniversary : Cody's Quest
quests.description:
Cody is supposedly in need of help. I should go see him at Henesys...
Cody said he's preparing a big party for the MapleStory staff with food and everything, but he forgot to buy the birthday candles for the cake! He seemed to be in a state of emergency, and asked me if I could gather up 10 Birthday Candles for him. Birthday Candles That's weird...
I gave him the 10 Birthday Candles he requested. He seemed very much relieved by the fact that the party won't be ruined after all. He gave me a Maple Flag as a reward. Wow, I haven't seen these in a while!

quests.name: About the Amorian Challenge!
quests.description:
mes the Wise has good news for me. It looks like his brother, Amos the Strong, has finished his hunting ground for married couples. I should stop by and get some more info!
I visited Ames the Wise, and he explained the Amoria Party Quest in detail I must visit Amos the Strong at the end of Purplewood Forest, and if I'm married, I can enter. I can either bring my spouse or go at it solo. I must team up with 5 other married people, and from there, the adventure begins!
That wasn't so bad! Amos the Strong seems much different from his brother Ames--he had muscles coming out of his muscles! To enter his hunting ground, I must be married, and can either bring my spouse or go at it with 5 other married people. I should visit Amoria more often...I wonder what else is in this land...

quests.name: Summer Break: Cody's BBQ - Start
quests.description:
Hooray for Summer! I heard Cody's having a barbecue! I better head over and see if I can help!
I spoke with Cody, and it looks like he needs help. I'll need to bring 10 Charcoals 10 BBQ Sauces and 10 Maple Raw Meat to Cody so he can finish cooking. Just the sound of all that makes me hungry!
I got all the ingredients Cody needed to start the barbecue! With the items he gave me, I can continue to enjoy the summer in style!
quests.requirements: Charcoal x 10, BBQ Sauce x 10, Maple Raw Meat x 10
quests.rewards_items: Maple BBQ, The Stars and Stripes

quests.name: Teo's reminiscence
quests.description:
I think I can get some help from Teo in Lith Harbor...
I met Teo at Lith Harbor. Teo told me I remind him of his youth when he went for many journeys. Reminiscing his past, Teo told me he wanted to help me. He said if I bring 50 Red Snail Shell and 30 Squishy Liquid, he will recognize my potentials and support me...ha! This is a Piece of cake!
I proved how good I am to Teo at Lith Harbor. Teo has acknowleged my abilities and financially supported me. With this support, I'll be a great adventurer.
quests.requirements: Red Snail Shell x 50, Squishy Liquid x 30

quests.name: Beat the Heat <Easy> - 1st Stage
quests.description:
Maple Administrator has come up with an event for the summer. Where must the admin be
As summer rolls on, The Maple Adminstrator has prepared an event called 'Beat the Heat' for the health of the users, most of which would be in front of the air-conditioner or a fan. As a warm up, the administrator requested that I defeat 50 Red Snails and 20 Orange Mushrooms... sounds like fun. Red Snail 90512# Orange Mushroom 90511#
I met the Maple Administrator, and passed the 1st Stage of the Easy level of Beat the Heat.
quests.requirements: Defeat Orange Mushroom x 20, Defeat Red Snail x 50

quests.name: Beat the Heat <Easy> - 2nd Stage
quests.description:
I should go visit Maple Administrator for Beat the Heat, 2nd Stage.
For the 2nd Stage task, the Maple Administrator asked me to gather up 10 Blue Present Box for Trainings#, which can be obtained by hunting Green Mushroom and Dark Stump. Blue Present Box for Training 4031167/10
I met the Maple Administrator, and passed the 2nd stage of the Easy level of Beat the Heat.
quests.requirements: Blue Present Box for Training x 10

quests.name: Beat the Heat <Easy> - 3rd Stage

I passed the 'Beat the Heat' Challenge that MapleStory prepared for us. Just like he/she said, I better stop spending so much time in front of air-conditioners and fans, and go out instead and lead an active life.
quests.requirements: Defeat Blue Mushroom x 25, Defeat Axe Stump x 25, Bubbling's Huge Bubble x 30

quests.name: Torr's Horn
quests.description:
I heard Torr of Happyville has lost something very important...
I heard Torr of Happyville has lost something very important, so I went to see her. I found her crying, and it turns out that... she lost her horn !!! How can you lose a horn She asked me to find her horn but...where must that be Torr's Horn 4031063/1
I found Torr's horn at the Cash Shop, and gave it back to her. She was ecstatic, to say the least. I hope she doesn't lose it anymore...

quests.name: Valentine's Day : Heart Chocolate
quests.description:
You can make a special chocolate for the special someone with the ingredients you can gather up yourself. Go see Ace of Hearts and make the Valentine's Day Chocolate full of love ~~
Ace of Hearts said he can make a nice package for a chocolate with a heart-shaped box, laden with a special spell full of love, as long as I gather up the materials for both the chocolate and the package. Dark Chocolate, and White Chocolate can be acquired through monsters, while Heart Box and Gold Ribbon can be acquired through Coco. Dark Chocolate 4031110 / 1 White Chocolate 4031109 / 1 Heart Box 4031111 / 1 Gold Ribbon 4031112 / 1
Ace of Hearts helped me make a Heart Chocolate laden with a spell full of love. "The power of love shall protect you..."
quests.requirements: White Chocolate x 1, Dark Chocolate x 1, Heart Box x 1, Gold Ribbon x 1

quests.name: Valentine's Day : Chocolate Basket
quests.description:
Apparently, Ace of Hearts can make a chocolate basket that extends the power of love using a number of Heart Chocolates.
[Ace of Hearts] said with Heart Chocolate and additional materials, he can make a Chocolate Basket that expires at a later date. Apparently, it's good for 5 days, longer than that of Heart Chocolate. I was able to make a chocolate basket for the person I dearly love for the Valentine's Day through [Ace of Hearts].
quests.requirements: Heart Chocolate x 1, White Chocolate x 1, Dark Chocolate x 1, Basket x 1, Cover Material x 1

quests.name: 지우개가 필요한 휴즈
quests.description:
휴즈를 찾아가보자. 도움이 필요한 것 같다.
휴즈가 연구를 진행하기 위해서 지우개가 필요하다고 했다.
휴즈가 필요한 지우개를 구해줬다.

아무 쓸모 없는 지우개들을 외계인 그레이에게 넘기고 좋은 물건을 받았다.
